`scripts/http_mcp.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Call the local Fortnite HTTP MCP endpoint from a shell.

Usage:
  python scripts/http_mcp.py --list
  python scripts/http_mcp.py http_status
  python scripts/http_mcp.py http_flows '{"limit":10}'
  python scripts/http_mcp.py http_flow '{"id":"00001-ab12cd"}'
"""

import http.client
import json
import os
import pathlib
import sys

TOKEN_PATH = pathlib.Path(os.path.expandvars(r"%LOCALAPPDATA%\FortniteMCP\http\http_token.txt"))
HOST = "127.0.0.1"
PORT = 26065


def rpc(method, params=None, timeout=180):
    token = TOKEN_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
    body = json.dumps({"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": method, "params": params or {}})
    conn = http.client.HTTPConnection(HOST, PORT, timeout=timeout)
    conn.request("POST", "/mcp", body,
                 {"Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": "Bearer " + token})
    response = conn.getresponse()
    data = response.read()
    conn.close()
    return response.status, json.loads(data)


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print(__doc__)
        return 1
    if sys.argv[1] in ("--list", "-l"):
        status, reply = rpc("tools/list")
        for tool in reply["result"]["tools"]:
            print(tool["name"])
        return 0
    tool = sys.argv[1]
    arguments = json.loads(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else {}
    status, reply = rpc("tools/call", {"name": tool, "arguments": arguments})
    if "error" in reply:
        print(json.dumps(reply, indent=2))
        return 2
    result = reply["result"]
    print(result["content"][0]["text"])
    return 3 if result.get("isError") else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

```

`scripts/mcp_smoke_test.py`:

```py
import argparse
import http.client
import json
import struct
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

FAILS = []


def check(name, condition, detail=""):
    print(("PASS " if condition else "FAIL ") + name + ((" :: " + str(detail)) if detail else ""))
    if not condition:
        FAILS.append(name)


class Rpc:
    def __init__(self, host, port, token):
        self.host = host
        self.port = port
        self.token = token
        self.next_id = 1

    def post(self, payload, auth=True, timeout=30):
        body = json.dumps(payload).encode()
        headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json", "Accept": "application/json"}
        if auth:
            headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + self.token
        conn = http.client.HTTPConnection(self.host, self.port, timeout=timeout)
        conn.request("POST", "/mcp", body=body, headers=headers)
        response = conn.getresponse()
        data = response.read()
        status = response.status
        conn.close()
        return status, data

    def call(self, name, arguments=None, timeout=30):
        payload = {
            "jsonrpc": "2.0",
            "id": self.next_id,
            "method": "tools/call",
            "params": {"name": name, "arguments": arguments or {}},
        }
        self.next_id += 1
        status, data = self.post(payload, timeout=timeout)
        if status != 200:
            return status, True, {"transport_error": data.decode(errors="replace")}
        reply = json.loads(data)
        if "error" in reply:
            return status, True, reply["error"]
        result = reply["result"]
        text = result["content"][0]["text"]
        try:
            parsed = json.loads(text)
        except Exception:
            parsed = {"text": text}
        return status, result.get("isError", False), parsed


def export_rva(pe_path, export_name):
    data = Path(pe_path).read_bytes()
    e_lfanew = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, 0x3C)[0]
    nt = e_lfanew
    num_sections = struct.unpack_from("<H", data, nt + 6)[0]
    opt_size = struct.unpack_from("<H", data, nt + 20)[0]
    opt = nt + 24
    export_dir_rva, export_dir_size = struct.unpack_from("<II", data, opt + 112)
    section_off = opt + opt_size
    sections = []
    for i in range(num_sections):
        off = section_off + i * 40
        virtual_size, virtual_address, raw_size, raw_ptr = struct.unpack_from("<IIII", data, off + 8)
        sections.append((virtual_address, virtual_size, raw_ptr, raw_size))

    def rva_to_off(rva):
        for va, vsize, raw_ptr, raw_size in sections:
            if va <= rva < va + max(vsize, raw_size):
                return raw_ptr + (rva - va)
        return rva

    exp = rva_to_off(export_dir_rva)
    number_of_names = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, exp + 24)[0]
    address_of_names = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, exp + 32)[0]
    address_of_ordinals = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, exp + 36)[0]
    address_of_functions = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, exp + 28)[0]

    for i in range(number_of_names):
        name_rva = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, rva_to_off(address_of_names) + i * 4)[0]
        name_off = rva_to_off(name_rva)
        end = data.index(b"\0", name_off)
        if data[name_off:end].decode(errors="ignore") == export_name:
            ordinal = struct.unpack_from("<H", data, rva_to_off(address_of_ordinals) + i * 2)[0]
            rva = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, rva_to_off(address_of_functions) + ordinal * 4)[0]
            return rva
    return None


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--token", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=26064)
    parser.add_argument("--dll", default=str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "build/release/bin/FortniteMCP.dll"))
    args = parser.parse_args()

    rpc = Rpc(args.host, args.port, args.token)

    status, data = rpc.post({"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "initialize",
                             "params": {"protocolVersion": "2025-06-18", "capabilities": {}}})
    init = json.loads(data)["result"]
    check("initialize", status == 200 and init["serverInfo"]["name"] == "FortniteMCP", init["protocolVersion"])

    status, data = rpc.post({"jsonrpc": "2.0", "method": "notifications/initialized"})
    check("notification is 202", status == 202 and not data, status)

    status, data = rpc.post({"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 2, "method": "tools/list"})
    tools = json.loads(data)["result"]["tools"]
    check("tools/list", len(tools) >= 39, len(tools))
    check("tools have schemas", all(isinstance(t.get("inputSchema"), dict) for t in tools))

    status, data = rpc.post({"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 90, "method": "ping"}, auth=False)
    check("auth required", status == 401, status)

    status, is_error, st = rpc.call("status")
    check("status", not is_error and st.get("server", {}).get("version") == "1.0.0")
    main_base = st["process"]["main_base"]
    main_name = st["process"]["main_module"]

    status, is_error, modules = rpc.call("memory_modules", {"filter": main_name})
    check("memory_modules", not is_error and modules.get("count", 0) >= 1, modules.get("count"))

    status, is_error, info = rpc.call("memory_module_info", {"name": "main"})
    check("memory_module_info", not is_error and len(info.get("sections", [])) > 0)

    status, is_error, alloc = rpc.call("memory_alloc", {"size": 256, "protection": "rw", "label": "smoke"})
    check("memory_alloc", not is_error and alloc.get("address", "").startswith("0x"), alloc)
    address = alloc.get("address")
    addr_int = int(address, 16)

    status, is_error, written = rpc.call("memory_write", {
        "address": address,
        "bytes_hex": "DEADBEEF11223344",
        "label": "smoke-write",
    })
    check("memory_write", not is_error and written.get("written") == 8, written)
    patch_id = written.get("patch_id")

    status, is_error, read = rpc.call("memory_read", {
        "address": address,
        "size": 16,
        "decode": [{"type": "u32", "offset": 0}, {"type": "u16", "offset": 4}, {"type": "u16", "offset": 6}],
    })
    check("memory_read", not is_error and read.get("hex", "").lower().startswith("deadbeef11223344"), read.get("hex"))
    values = {v["type"] + str(v["offset"]): v["value"] for v in read.get("values", [])}
    check("typed decode", values.get("u320") == 0xEFBEADDE, values)

    status, is_error, scan = rpc.call("memory_scan", {
        "pattern": "DE AD BE EF 11 22 33 44",
        "start": address,
        "end": hex(addr_int + 256),
        "max_results": 4,
    })
    check("memory_scan", not is_error and scan.get("matches_count") == 1, scan)

    ptr_hex = (addr_int + 0x10).to_bytes(8, "little").hex()
    status, is_error, _ = rpc.call("memory_write", {"address": address, "bytes_hex": ptr_hex})
    check("write pointer", not is_error)
    status, is_error, chain = rpc.call("memory_pointer_chain", {
        "base": address,
        "steps": [{"offset": 0, "deref": True}],
        "final_type": "u32",
    })
    check("pointer_chain", not is_error and int(chain.get("final_address", "0"), 16) == addr_int + 0x10, chain.get("final_address"))

    status, is_error, patches = rpc.call("patch_list")
    check("patch_list", not is_error and patches.get("count", 0) >= 1, patches.get("count"))

    if patch_id is not None:
        status, is_error, undo = rpc.call("patch_undo", {"id": patch_id})
        check("patch_undo", not is_error and undo.get("restored") == 1, undo)
        status, is_error, read2 = rpc.call("memory_read", {"address": address, "size": 8})
        check("patch restored", not is_error and read2.get("hex", "").startswith("0000000000000000"), read2.get("hex"))

    status, is_error, freed = rpc.call("memory_free", {"address": address})
    check("memory_free", not is_error and freed.get("freed") == address, freed)

    status, is_error, big = rpc.call("memory_alloc", {"size": 2 * 1024 * 1024, "protection": "rw", "label": "scan-boundary"})
    check("scan allocation", not is_error, big)
    big_addr = int(big.get("address", "0"), 16)
    marker = bytes([0x4D, 0x5A, 0xC3, 0x99, 0x01, 0x02, 0x03, 0x04])
    marker_target = big_addr + 1024 * 1024 - 3
    status, is_error, _ = rpc.call("memory_write", {"address": hex(marker_target), "bytes_hex": marker.hex()})
    check("scan marker write", not is_error)
    status, is_error, boundary = rpc.call("memory_scan", {
        "pattern": "4D 5A C3 99 01 02 03 04",
        "start": hex(big_addr),
        "end": hex(big_addr + 2 * 1024 * 1024),
        "max_results": 8,
    })
    check("scanner boundary", not is_error and boundary.get("matches_count") == 1 and
          int(boundary["matches"][0]["address"], 16) == marker_target, boundary)
    rpc.call("memory_free", {"address": hex(big_addr)})

    status, is_error, bad = rpc.call("memory_read", {"address": "0x10", "size": 8})
    check("invalid read rejected", is_error, bad)

    status, is_error, ue = rpc.call("ue_status")
    check("ue_status", not is_error and ue.get("resolved") is True)

    status, is_error, find = rpc.call("find_object", {"path": "Engine.Actor"})
    check("UE tools degrade gracefully", is_error, find)

    status, is_error, pe = rpc.call("process_event", {"object": "0x1000", "function": "0x1000"})
    check("process_event degrades gracefully", is_error, pe)

    status, is_error, cfg = rpc.call("ue_configure", {"game_thread": {"timeout_ms": 4000}})
    check("ue_configure", not is_error)
    status, is_error, ue2 = rpc.call("ue_status")
    check("runtime config applied", not is_error and ue2.get("game_thread", {}).get("timeout_ms") == 4000, ue2.get("game_thread"))
    rpc.call("ue_configure", {"game_thread": {"timeout_ms": 5000}})

    status, is_error, inp = rpc.call("input_window")
    check("input_window handled", is_error or inp.get("window"), inp)

    dll_rva = export_rva(args.dll, "FmcpAbiVersion")
    status, is_error, full_modules = rpc.call("memory_modules", {})
    dll_base = next((m for m in full_modules.get("modules", []) if "fortnitemcp.dll" in m["name"].lower()), None)
    check("find DLL module", dll_base is not None and dll_rva is not None, (dll_base, dll_rva))
    if dll_base and dll_rva is not None:
        target = int(dll_base["base"], 16) + dll_rva
        status, is_error, called = rpc.call("call_address", {
            "address": hex(target),
            "args": [],
            "return_type": "u32",
            "allow_direct": True,
        })
        check("call_address", not is_error and called.get("value") == 1, called)

        mix_rva = export_rva(args.dll, "FmcpAbiTest")
        check("find mixed-ABI export", mix_rva is not None)
        if mix_rva is not None:
            mix_target = int(dll_base["base"], 16) + mix_rva
            status, is_error, mixed = rpc.call("call_address", {
                "address": hex(mix_target),
                "args": [
                    {"type": "int", "value": 1},
                    {"type": "double", "value": 2.0},
                    {"type": "int", "value": 3},
                    {"type": "double", "value": 4.0},
                    {"type": "int", "value": 5},
                    {"type": "int", "value": 6},
                    {"type": "double", "value": 7.0},

                "return_type": "u64",
                "allow_direct": True,
            })

    status, is_error, loaded = rpc.call("load_dll", {"path": "C:\\Windows\\System32\\version.dll", "label": "smoke"})
    if is_error:
        check("load_dll (skipped/failed)", False, loaded)

    host_exe = str(Path(args.dll).with_name("FortniteMCPTestHost.exe"))
    fake_name_rva = export_rva(host_exe, "FmcpFakeNameToString")
    fake_engine_slot_rva = export_rva(host_exe, "g_fmcpFakeEngineSlot")
    fake_world_rva = export_rva(host_exe, "g_fmcpFakeWorld")

          fake_world_rva is not None, (fake_name_rva, fake_engine_slot_rva, fake_world_rva))
    if fake_name_rva is not None and fake_engine_slot_rva is not None and fake_world_rva is not None:
        status, is_error, configured = rpc.call("ue_configure", {"ue": {
            "names": {"style": "function", "resolve": "offset", "offset": hex(fake_name_rva),

            "gworld": {"resolve": "chain", "from": "gengine", "chain": [0xB70, 0x78], "decode": ""},

        status, is_error, fake_ue = rpc.call("ue_status")
        world_name = fake_ue.get("globals", {}).get("gworld", {}).get("name", "")
        check("FNameToString backend", not is_error and fake_ue.get("flags", {}).get("names") is True and

        chain = fake_ue.get("globals", {}).get("gworld", {}).get("chain", [])
        viewport_value = next((h.get("value") for h in chain if h.get("hop") == 1), None)

                "owner": viewport_value, "class": "FakeName_7", "max_offset": 256,

            check("find_pointer_field", not is_error and
                  any(m.get("offset") == 0x78 for m in found.get("matches", [])), found)
        status, is_error, globals_out = rpc.call("get_globals")
        world_entry = next((g for g in globals_out.get("globals", []) if g.get("name") == "gworld"), None)
        expected_world = int(main_base, 16) + fake_world_rva
        check("GEngine->GameViewport->World chain", not is_error and world_entry is not None and
              int(world_entry.get("value", "0"), 16) == expected_world,
              (world_entry, hex(expected_world)))
        rpc.call("ue_configure", {"ue": {
            "names": {"style": "off", "resolve": "off"},
            "gengine": {"resolve": "off"},
            "gworld": {"resolve": "off"},
        }})

    status, is_error, logdata = rpc.call("get_log", {"lines": 10})
    check("get_log", not is_error and len(logdata.get("text", "")) > 0)

    status, is_error, selftest = rpc.call("self_test")
    check("self_test", not is_error and selftest.get("ok") is True, [t["name"] for t in selftest.get("tests", []) if not t["ok"]])

    print()
    if FAILS:
        print("FAILED:", ", ".join(FAILS))
        return 1
    print("ALL SMOKE TESTS PASSED")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

`scripts/net_probe.py`:

```py
import json
import os
import pathlib
import struct
import time
import http.client

TOKEN_PATH = pathlib.Path(os.path.expandvars(r"%LOCALAPPDATA%\FortniteMCP\token.txt"))


def call(name, args=None, timeout=90):
    token = TOKEN_PATH.read_text().strip()
    body = json.dumps({"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call",
                       "params": {"name": name, "arguments": args or {}}})
    conn = http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", 26064, timeout=timeout)
    conn.request("POST", "/mcp", body,
                 {"Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": "Bearer " + token})
    resp = conn.getresponse()
    data = resp.read()
    conn.close()
    reply = json.loads(data)
    if "error" in reply:
        raise RuntimeError(reply["error"])
    result = reply["result"]
    text = result["content"][0]["text"]
    if result.get("isError"):
        raise RuntimeError(text)
    return json.loads(text)


def read(addr, size):
    r = call("memory_read_safe", {"address": hex(addr), "size": size})
    if not r.get("ok"):
        raise RuntimeError(r.get("error", "unreadable") + " @" + hex(addr))
    return bytes.fromhex(r["hex"])


def qword(addr):
    b = read(addr, 8)
    return struct.unpack("<Q", b)[0] if len(b) == 8 else 0


def name_of(addr):
    if not addr or addr < 0x10000:
        return None
    try:
        b = read(addr + 0x20, 8)
        index, number = struct.unpack("<II", b)
        r = call("resolve_fname", {"index": index, "number": number})
        return None if r.get("faulted") else r.get("name")
    except Exception:
        return None


def class_of(addr):
    if not addr or addr < 0x10000:
        return None
    try:
        return name_of(qword(addr + 0x10))
    except Exception:
        return None


def describe(addr):
    try:
        return {"address": hex(addr), "name": name_of(addr), "class": class_of(addr)}
    except Exception as exc:
        return {"address": hex(addr), "error": str(exc)}


def find_manager_in(owner, label, max_offset=0x2000):
    found = []
    try:
        data = read(owner, max_offset)
    except Exception as exc:
        return found
    for off in range(0, len(data) - 8, 8):
        ptr = struct.unpack_from("<Q", data, off)[0]
        if ptr < 0x10000 or ptr > 0x7FFFFFFEFFFF:
            continue
        try:
            block = read(ptr, 0x170)
        except Exception:
            continue
        if len(block) < 0x168:
            continue
        cap = struct.unpack_from("<i", block, 0x38)[0]
        cap_min = struct.unpack_from("<i", block, 0x3C)[0]
        cap_max = struct.unpack_from("<i", block, 0x40)[0]
        padding = struct.unpack_from("<i", block, 0x44)[0]
        loss = struct.unpack_from("<f", block, 0x4C)[0]
        ping = struct.unpack_from("<f", block, 0x50)[0]
        jitter = struct.unpack_from("<f", block, 0x54)[0]
        poll = struct.unpack_from("<f", block, 0x160)[0]
        if not (0 <= loss <= 100 and 0 <= ping <= 5000 and 0 <= jitter <= 5000):
            continue
        if not (1 <= cap <= 10000000 and 0 <= cap_min <= 10000000 and
                0 <= cap_max <= 10000000 and 0 <= padding <= 10000000):
            continue
        if not (0.0001 <= poll <= 120):
            continue
        found.append({"owner": label, "field": hex(off), "manager": hex(ptr),
                      "cap_kbps": cap, "cap_min": cap_min, "cap_max": cap_max,
                      "padding_kbps": padding, "loss_pct": round(loss, 3),
                      "baseline_ping_ms": round(ping, 3), "ping_variance_ms": round(jitter, 3),
                      "poll_s": round(poll, 4)})
    return found


def delta_scan(conn_addr, seconds=1.0):
    size = 0x19D0
    first = read(conn_addr, size)
    time.sleep(seconds)
    second = read(conn_addr, size)
    hits = []
    for off in range(0, size - 4, 4):
        a = struct.unpack_from("<I", first, off)[0]
        b = struct.unpack_from("<I", second, off)[0]
        d = (b - a) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        if 5 <= d <= 5000:
            hits.append({"offset": hex(off), "delta": d, "value": b, "class": "packets?"})
        elif 2000 <= d <= 50000000:
            hits.append({"offset": hex(off), "delta": d, "value": b, "class": "bytes?"})
    floats = []
    for off in range(0, size - 4, 4):
        v = struct.unpack_from("<f", second, off)[0]
        if 0.0005 <= v <= 2.0:
            floats.append({"offset": hex(off), "value": round(v, 5)})
    return hits, floats


def main():
    status = call("ue_status")
    world = int(status["globals"]["gworld"]["value"], 16)
    engine = int(status["globals"]["gengine"]["value"], 16)
    print("world", hex(world), status["globals"]["gworld"].get("name"))
    print("engine", hex(engine), status["globals"]["gengine"].get("name"))

    net_driver = qword(world + 0x48)
    print("netdriver@world+0x48", describe(net_driver) if net_driver else None)

    connection = 0
    if net_driver:
        for off in [0x118, 0x120, 0x110, 0x128]:
            cand = qword(net_driver + off)
            if cand and "onnection" in (class_of(cand) or ""):
                connection = cand
                print("connection@netdriver+0x%X" % off, describe(cand))
                break
        if not connection:
            for off in range(0x100, 0x180, 8):
                cand = qword(net_driver + off)
                if cand and "onnection" in (class_of(cand) or ""):
                    connection = cand
                    print("connection@netdriver+0x%X" % off, describe(cand))
                    break
    print("connection", describe(connection) if connection else None)

    owners = [("world", world), ("engine", engine), ("netdriver", net_driver)]
    viewport = qword(engine + 0xB70) if engine else 0
    if viewport:
        owners.append(("gameviewport", viewport))
    game_instance = qword(world + 0x250) if world else 0
    if game_instance:
        owners.append(("gameinstance", game_instance))

    managers = []
    for label, owner in owners:
        if owner:
            managers.extend(find_manager_in(owner, label))
    print("manager_candidates", json.dumps(managers, indent=1))

    if connection:
        packets, floats = delta_scan(connection)
        print("connection_deltas", json.dumps(packets[:40], indent=1))
        print("connection_floats", json.dumps(floats[:40], indent=1))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```py
import struct
import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

if len(sys.argv) < 2:
    print("usage: python scripts/parse_dump.py <path-to-minidump.dmp>")
    raise SystemExit(2)
DUMP = Path(sys.argv[1])
data = DUMP.read_bytes()

sig, ver, nstreams, dirrva, checksum, timestamp, flags = struct.unpack_from("<IIIIIIQ", data, 0)
streams = {}
for i in range(nstreams):
    stype, size, rva = struct.unpack_from("<III", data, dirrva + i * 12)
    streams[stype] = (size, rva)

modules = []
if 4 in streams:
    size, rva = streams[4]
    count = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, rva)[0]
    off = rva + 4
    for _ in range(count):
        base, msize, checksum, tds, nameRva = struct.unpack_from("<QIIII", data, off)
        nameOff = rva + nameRva
        # MINIDUMP_STRING: length u32 in bytes, then UTF-16
        slen = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, nameOff)[0]
        name = data[nameOff + 4:nameOff + 4 + slen].decode("utf-16-le", errors="replace")
        modules.append((base, msize, name.encode("ascii", "replace").decode("ascii")))
        off += 108

def module_for(addr):
    for base, size, name in modules:
        if base <= addr < base + size:
            return f"{Path(name).name}+0x{addr-base:X}"
    return None

# Exception stream 6
ctx_rva = None
exc_tid = None
exc_addr = None
exc_code = None
if 6 in streams:
    size, rva = streams[6]
    exc_tid = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, rva)[0]
    e = rva + 8
    exc_code, exc_flags = struct.unpack_from("<II", data, e)
    exc_record = struct.unpack_from("<Q", data, e + 8)[0]
    exc_addr = struct.unpack_from("<Q", data, e + 16)[0]
    nparams = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, e + 24)[0]
    info = struct.unpack_from("<15Q", data, e + 32)
    ctx_size, ctx_rva = struct.unpack_from("<II", data, e + 152)

# Thread list for contexts
threads = []
if 3 in streams:
    size, rva = streams[3]
    count = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, rva)[0]
    off = rva + 4
    for _ in range(count):
        tid, suspend, pclass, prio, teb = struct.unpack_from("<IIIIQ", data, off)
        stack_start, stack_size, stack_rva = struct.unpack_from("<QII", data, off + 24)
        ctx_size2, ctx_rva2 = struct.unpack_from("<II", data, off + 40)
        threads.append((tid, stack_start, stack_size, stack_rva, ctx_rva2, teb))
        off += 48
        # MINIDUMP_THREAD size is 48 on x64

ctx = None
ctx_thread = None
for t in threads:
    if t[0] == exc_tid:
        ctx_thread = t
        if ctx_rva is None:
            ctx_rva = t[4]
        break
if ctx_rva is None and ctx_thread:
    ctx_rva = ctx_thread[4]

regs = {}
if ctx_rva:
    base = ctx_rva
    names = ["Rax","Rcx","Rdx","Rbx","Rsp","Rbp","Rsi","Rdi","R8","R9","R10","R11","R12","R13","R14","R15","Rip"]
    for i, name in enumerate(names):
        regs[name] = struct.unpack_from("<Q", data, base + 0x78 + i * 8)[0]

# Memory segments: MemoryList (5) and Memory64List (9)
memranges = []
if 5 in streams:
    size, rva = streams[5]
    count = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, rva)[0]
    off = rva + 4
    for _ in range(count):
        start, msize, mrva = struct.unpack_from("<QII", data, off)
        memranges.append((start, msize, mrva))
        off += 16
if 9 in streams:
    size, rva = streams[9]
    count, baseRva = struct.unpack_from("<QQ", data, rva)
    off = rva + 16
    fileoff = baseRva
    for _ in range(count):
        start, msize = struct.unpack_from("<QQ", data, off)
        memranges.append((start, msize, fileoff))
        off += 16
        fileoff += msize

def read_virtual(addr, size):
    for start, msize, mrva in memranges:
        if start <= addr and addr + size <= start + msize:
            off = mrva + (addr - start)
            return data[off:off + size]
    return None

print("streams", sorted(streams))
print("modules", len(modules))
print("exception tid", hex(exc_tid) if exc_tid else None, "code", hex(exc_code) if exc_code else None,
      "addr", hex(exc_addr) if exc_addr else None, "read", hex(info[1]) if nparams > 1 else None)
print("regs", {k: hex(v) for k, v in regs.items()})
print("memranges", len(memranges))
print("stack module", module_for(regs.get("Rsp", 0)))

if "Rsp" in regs:
    rsp = regs["Rsp"]
    raw = read_virtual(rsp, 0x600)
    if raw:
        for i in range(0, min(len(raw), 0x400), 8):
            val = struct.unpack_from("<Q", raw, i)[0]
            loc = module_for(val)
            if loc is None and 0x180000000 <= val < 0x180200000:
                loc = f"MCP+0x{val-0x180000000:X}"
            if loc:
                print(f"stack+{i:03X} {rsp+i:016X} {val:016X} {loc}")
    else:
        print("no stack memory for Rsp", hex(rsp))

# Search stack for object-looking pointers near MCP/game module, and name indices maybe
if "Rsp" in regs:
    rsp = regs["Rsp"]
    raw = read_virtual(rsp - 0x400, 0x1000)
    if raw:
        print("stack around rsp written to dump_stack.bin")
        Path("build/dump_stack.bin").write_bytes(raw)
```

```cpp
#include "bootstrap.h"

namespace fmcp {

namespace {

extern "C" NTSYSAPI BOOLEAN NTAPI RtlAddFunctionTable(PRUNTIME_FUNCTION FunctionTable,
                                                      DWORD EntryCount, DWORD64 BaseAddress);
extern "C" NTSYSAPI PRUNTIME_FUNCTION NTAPI RtlLookupFunctionEntry(
    DWORD64 ControlPc, PDWORD64 ImageBase, PUNWIND_HISTORY_TABLE HistoryTable);

HMODULE g_module = nullptr;
HANDLE g_stopEvent = nullptr;
std::atomic<bool> g_stopSignaled{false};

std::string DefaultLogPath() {
    wchar_t* local = nullptr;
    size_t length = 0;
    std::string base;

    if (_wdupenv_s(&local, &length, L"LOCALAPPDATA") == 0 && local) {
        base = str::Narrow(local);
    }
    free(local);

    if (base.empty()) {
        base = "C:\\FortniteMCP";
    }
    return base + "\\FortniteMCP\\FortniteMCP.log";
}

void WriteClientConfig(const Config& config, uint16_t port) {
    nlohmann::json root;
    nlohmann::json server = {{"url", str::Format("http://127.0.0.1:%u/mcp", port)}};
    if (!config.server.token.empty()) {
        server["headers"] = {{"Authorization", "Bearer " + config.server.token}};
    }
    root["mcpServers"]["fortnite"] = std::move(server);

    const std::string path = config.directory + "\\mcp-client.json";
    std::ofstream out(path, std::ios::trunc);
    if (out) {
        out << root.dump(2) << "\n";
        FMCP_LOGI("Wrote MCP client config to %s", path.c_str());
    }
}

}

void RequestStop(bool unloadSelf, bool restorePatches) {
    g_unloadSelf = unloadSelf;
    g_restorePatches = restorePatches;
    g_stopSignaled = true;
    if (g_stopEvent) {
        SetEvent(g_stopEvent);
    }
}

uint64_t UptimeMs() {
    const uint64_t start = g_startTick.load();
    return start ? GetTickCount64() - start : 0;
}

bool IsManuallyMapped() {
    if (!g_module) {
        return false;
    }
    HMODULE module = nullptr;
    return !GetModuleHandleExW(
        GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_FROM_ADDRESS | GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_UNCHANGED_REFCOUNT,
        reinterpret_cast<LPCWSTR>(g_module), &module);
}

void RegisterExceptionTable(HMODULE module);

void EnsureExceptionTable(HMODULE module) {
    if (!module) {
        return;
    }

    DWORD64 imageBase = 0;
    PRUNTIME_FUNCTION existing = RtlLookupFunctionEntry(
        reinterpret_cast<DWORD64>(&EnsureExceptionTable), &imageBase, nullptr);
    if (existing && imageBase == reinterpret_cast<DWORD64>(module)) {
        FMCP_LOGI("Exception table already registered (entry=%p base=0x%llX)", existing,
                  static_cast<unsigned long long>(imageBase));
        return;
    }

    RegisterExceptionTable(module);

    imageBase = 0;
    PRUNTIME_FUNCTION check = RtlLookupFunctionEntry(
        reinterpret_cast<DWORD64>(&EnsureExceptionTable), &imageBase, nullptr);
    FMCP_LOGI("Exception lookup after registration: entry=%p base=0x%llX", check,
              static_cast<unsigned long long>(imageBase));
}


void RegisterExceptionTable(HMODULE module) {
    if (!module) {
        return;
    }

    auto* base = reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(module);
    auto* dos = reinterpret_cast<IMAGE_DOS_HEADER*>(base);
    if (dos->e_magic != IMAGE_DOS_SIGNATURE) {
        FMCP_LOGW("Exception table: invalid DOS header");
        return;
    }

    auto* nt = reinterpret_cast<IMAGE_NT_HEADERS*>(base + dos->e_lfanew);
    if (nt->Signature != IMAGE_NT_SIGNATURE) {
        FMCP_LOGW("Exception table: invalid NT header");
        return;
    }

    auto* section = IMAGE_FIRST_SECTION(nt);
    for (WORD i = 0; i < nt->FileHeader.NumberOfSections; ++i, ++section) {
        if (std::strncmp(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(section->Name), ".pdata", 6) != 0) {
            continue;
        }
        auto* table = reinterpret_cast<RUNTIME_FUNCTION*>(base + section->VirtualAddress);
        const DWORD count = section->Misc.VirtualSize / sizeof(RUNTIME_FUNCTION);
        const BOOLEAN ok =
            RtlAddFunctionTable(table, count, reinterpret_cast<DWORD64>(base));
        FMCP_LOGI("Exception table: %lu entries at %p (%s)", count, table,
                  ok ? "registered" : "failed");
        return;
    }

    FMCP_LOGW("Exception table: .pdata not found; exceptions may not unwind");
}

void BootstrapMain(HMODULE module) {
    g_module = module;
    g_startTick = GetTickCount64();
    log::Init("", log::Level::Info, 4 * 1024 * 1024, false);

    Sleep(100);

    Config& config = Config::Get();
    config.Load();

    const log::Level level = log::ParseLevel(config.log.level);
    log::Init(config.log_path, level, config.log.max_file_bytes, config.log.debug_output);

    FMCP_LOGI("FortniteMCP %s starting (pid %lu)", FMCP_VERSION, GetCurrentProcessId());
    const bool manualMap = IsManuallyMapped();
    FMCP_LOGI("Load mode: %s", manualMap ? "manual map (self-unload unavailable)" : "loader");
    if (manualMap) {
        EnsureExceptionTable(module);
    }
    FMCP_LOGI("Config: %s", config.path.c_str());
    FMCP_LOGI("Config directory: %s", config.directory.c_str());
    if (!config.server.token.empty()) {
        FMCP_LOGI("Token file: %s", config.server.token_file.c_str());
    }

    modules::Refresh();
    patches::Initialize(config.safety.undo_patches, config.safety.max_patches);

    g_stopEvent = CreateEventW(nullptr, TRUE, FALSE, nullptr);
    if (g_stopSignaled) {
        SetEvent(g_stopEvent);
    }

    McpServer mcp;
    ue::UeContext::Get().Resolve(true);

    HttpServer http;
    http.SetAfterResponse([] {
        bool unloadSelf = false;
        bool restorePatches = false;
        if (!lifecycle::Consume(unloadSelf, restorePatches)) {
            return false;
        }
        RequestStop(unloadSelf, restorePatches);
        return true;
    });

    std::string serverError;
    const bool started = http.Start(config.server.host, config.server.port,
                                    [&mcp](const HttpRequest& request) { return mcp.HandleHttp(request); },
                                    config.server.max_body_bytes, config.server.max_connections,
                                    config.server.idle_timeout_ms, &serverError);
    if (!started) {
        FMCP_LOGE("HTTP server failed to start: %s", serverError.c_str());
        ue::UeContext::Get().Shutdown();
        if (g_stopEvent) {
            CloseHandle(g_stopEvent);
            g_stopEvent = nullptr;
        }
        log::Shutdown();
        return;
    }

    const uint16_t port = http.Port();
    FMCP_LOGI("MCP endpoint: http://%s:%u/mcp", config.server.host.c_str(), port);
    WriteClientConfig(config, port);

    if (!g_stopEvent) {
        return;
    }

    WaitForSingleObject(g_stopEvent, INFINITE);

    FMCP_LOGI("Shutdown requested");
    if (http.Running()) {
        http.Stop();
    }

    if (g_restorePatches) {
        const size_t restored = patches::UndoAll();
        FMCP_LOGI("Restored %zu patches", restored);
    }

    ue::UeContext::Get().Shutdown();
    const bool gameThreadIdle = ue::GameThread::Get().WaitIdle(5000);
    if (!gameThreadIdle) {
        FMCP_LOGE("Game-thread calls are still active; refusing to unload FortniteMCP");
    }
    Allocator::Get().FreeAll();
    dll::Shutdown();

    if (g_stopEvent) {
        CloseHandle(g_stopEvent);
        g_stopEvent = nullptr;
    }

    const bool unload = g_unloadSelf.load() && gameThreadIdle && !manualMap;
    if (g_unloadSelf.load() && manualMap) {
        FMCP_LOGW("Skipping FreeLibrary for a manually mapped DLL; unload it with the injector "
                  "or terminate the process");
    }
    FMCP_LOGI("Cleanup complete (unload_self=%s)", unload ? "true" : "false");
    log::Shutdown();

    if (unload && g_module) {
        FreeLibraryAndExitThread(g_module, 0);
    }
}

}
```

```cpp
#include <windows.h>
#include <winhttp.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <io.h>
#include <fstream>
#include <iostream>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace {

struct Options {
    std::string url = "http://127.0.0.1:26064/mcp";
    std::string token;
    int timeoutSeconds = 30;
    int waitSeconds = 10;
    bool verbose = false;
};

std::string Narrow(const std::wstring& value) {
    if (value.empty()) return {};
    const int size = WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, value.data(), static_cast<int>(value.size()),
                                         nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr);
    if (size <= 0) return {};
    std::string out(static_cast<size_t>(size), '\0');
    WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, value.data(), static_cast<int>(value.size()),
                        out.data(), size, nullptr, nullptr);
    return out;
}

std::wstring Widen(const std::string& value) {
    if (value.empty()) return {};
    const int size = MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, value.data(), static_cast<int>(value.size()),
                                         nullptr, 0);
    if (size <= 0) return {};
    std::wstring out(static_cast<size_t>(size), L'\0');
    MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, value.data(), static_cast<int>(value.size()), out.data(), size);
    return out;
}

std::string Trim(std::string value) {
    while (!value.empty() && static_cast<unsigned char>(value.back()) <= ' ') value.pop_back();
    size_t start = 0;
    while (start < value.size() && static_cast<unsigned char>(value[start]) <= ' ') ++start;
    return value.substr(start);
}

std::string ReadFirstLine(const std::string& path) {
    std::ifstream file(path);
    std::string line;
    if (file && std::getline(file, line)) {
        return Trim(line);
    }
    return {};
}

std::string ParentPath(const std::string& path) {
    const size_t pos = path.find_last_of("\\/");
    return pos == std::string::npos ? std::string{} : path.substr(0, pos);
}

std::string DefaultTokenPath() {
    if (const char* configPath = std::getenv("FORTNITEMCP_CONFIG")) {
        const std::string parent = ParentPath(configPath);
        if (!parent.empty()) {
            return parent + "\\token.txt";
        }
    }

    wchar_t* local = nullptr;
    size_t length = 0;
    std::string base;
    if (_wdupenv_s(&local, &length, L"LOCALAPPDATA") == 0 && local) {
        base = Narrow(local);
    }
    free(local);
    if (base.empty()) base = "C:\\FortniteMCP";
    return base + "\\FortniteMCP\\token.txt";
}

void PrintUsage() {
    std::cerr
        << "FortniteMCPBridge - stdio to HTTP MCP bridge\n"
        << "Usage: FortniteMCPBridge [--url URL] [--token TOKEN] [--timeout SECONDS] "
           "[--wait SECONDS] [--verbose]\n"
        << "Defaults: --url http://127.0.0.1:26064/mcp, token from FORTNITEMCP_TOKEN or token.txt\n";
}

std::optional<Options> ParseOptions(int argc, char** argv) {
    Options options;
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        const std::string arg = argv[i];
        auto need = [&](const char* name) -> std::optional<std::string> {
            if (i + 1 >= argc) {
                std::cerr << "missing value for " << name << "\n";
                return std::nullopt;
            }
            return std::string(argv[++i]);
        };

        if (arg == "--url") {
            auto value = need("--url");
            if (!value) return std::nullopt;
            options.url = *value;
        } else if (arg == "--token") {
            auto value = need("--token");
            if (!value) return std::nullopt;
            options.token = *value;
        } else if (arg == "--timeout") {
            auto value = need("--timeout");
            if (!value) return std::nullopt;
            options.timeoutSeconds = std::max(1, std::atoi(value->c_str()));
        } else if (arg == "--wait") {
            auto value = need("--wait");
            if (!value) return std::nullopt;
            options.waitSeconds = std::max(0, std::atoi(value->c_str()));
        } else if (arg == "--verbose") {
            options.verbose = true;
        } else if (arg == "--help" || arg == "-h") {
            PrintUsage();
            std::exit(0);
        } else {
            std::cerr << "unknown argument: " << arg << "\n";
            return std::nullopt;
        }
    }

    if (options.token.empty()) {
        if (const char* env = std::getenv("FORTNITEMCP_TOKEN")) {
            options.token = env;
        }
    }
    if (options.token.empty()) {
        options.token = ReadFirstLine(DefaultTokenPath());
    }
    if (options.token.empty()) {
        options.token = Trim(ReadFirstLine("token.txt"));
    }

    return options;
}

struct UrlParts {
    std::wstring host;
    std::wstring path;
    uint16_t port = 80;
    bool secure = false;
};

std::optional<UrlParts> ParseUrl(const std::string& url) {
    const std::wstring wide = Widen(url);
    URL_COMPONENTS components{};
    components.dwStructSize = sizeof(components);
    components.dwHostNameLength = static_cast<DWORD>(-1);
    components.dwUrlPathLength = static_cast<DWORD>(-1);
    components.dwExtraInfoLength = static_cast<DWORD>(-1);
    components.dwSchemeLength = static_cast<DWORD>(-1);

    if (!WinHttpCrackUrl(wide.c_str(), 0, 0, &components)) {
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    UrlParts parts;
    parts.host.assign(components.lpszHostName, components.dwHostNameLength);
    parts.path.assign(components.lpszUrlPath, components.dwUrlPathLength);
    if (components.dwExtraInfoLength > 0) {
        parts.path.append(components.lpszExtraInfo, components.dwExtraInfoLength);
    }
    parts.port = components.nPort;
    parts.secure = components.nScheme == INTERNET_SCHEME_HTTPS;
    if (components.nScheme != INTERNET_SCHEME_HTTP && components.nScheme != INTERNET_SCHEME_HTTPS) {
        return std::nullopt;
    }
    if (parts.path.empty()) {
        parts.path = L"/mcp";
    }
    return parts;
}

class BridgeClient {
public:
    explicit BridgeClient(const Options& options) : options_(options) {}

    bool Open() {
        parts_ = ParseUrl(options_.url);
        if (!parts_) {
            std::cerr << "invalid URL: " << options_.url << "\n";
            return false;
        }

        session_ = WinHttpOpen(L"FortniteMCPBridge/1.0", WINHTTP_ACCESS_TYPE_NO_PROXY,
                               WINHTTP_NO_PROXY_NAME, WINHTTP_NO_PROXY_BYPASS, 0);
        if (!session_) {
            return false;
        }

        const int timeout = options_.timeoutSeconds * 1000;
        WinHttpSetTimeouts(session_, timeout, timeout, timeout, timeout);

        connection_ = WinHttpConnect(session_, parts_->host.c_str(), parts_->port, 0);
        return connection_ != nullptr;
    }

    void Close() {
        if (session_) {
            WinHttpCloseHandle(session_);
            session_ = nullptr;
            connection_ = nullptr;
        }
    }

    ~BridgeClient() {
        Close();
    }

    std::optional<std::string> Send(const std::string& body, int* statusOut) {
        if (!connection_ && !Open()) {
            return std::nullopt;
        }

        HINTERNET request = WinHttpOpenRequest(connection_, L"POST", parts_->path.c_str(), nullptr,
                                               WINHTTP_NO_REFERER, WINHTTP_DEFAULT_ACCEPT_TYPES,
                                               parts_->secure ? WINHTTP_FLAG_SECURE : 0);
        if (!request) {
            return std::nullopt;
        }

        std::wstring headers = L"Content-Type: application/json\r\nAccept: application/json\r\n";
        if (!options_.token.empty()) {
            headers += L"Authorization: Bearer " + Widen(options_.token) + L"\r\n";
        }

        BOOL ok = WinHttpSendRequest(request, headers.c_str(), static_cast<DWORD>(-1L),
                                     const_cast<char*>(body.data()), static_cast<DWORD>(body.size()),
                                     static_cast<DWORD>(body.size()), 0);
        if (ok) {
            ok = WinHttpReceiveResponse(request, nullptr);
        }

        DWORD status = 0;
        DWORD statusSize = sizeof(status);
        WinHttpQueryHeaders(request, WINHTTP_QUERY_STATUS_CODE | WINHTTP_QUERY_FLAG_NUMBER,
                            WINHTTP_HEADER_NAME_BY_INDEX, &status, &statusSize,
                            WINHTTP_NO_HEADER_INDEX);

        std::string response;
        if (ok) {
            DWORD available = 0;
            do {
                available = 0;
                if (!WinHttpQueryDataAvailable(request, &available)) {
                    ok = FALSE;
                    break;
                }
                if (available == 0) {
                    break;
                }
                std::vector<char> buffer(std::min<DWORD>(available, 1 << 20));
                DWORD read = 0;
                if (!WinHttpReadData(request, buffer.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(buffer.size()), &read)) {
                    ok = FALSE;
                    break;
                }
                response.append(buffer.data(), read);
                if (response.size() > 64 * 1024 * 1024) {
                    ok = FALSE;
                    break;
                }
            } while (available > 0);
        }

        WinHttpCloseHandle(request);

        if (statusOut) *statusOut = status;
        if (!ok) {
            if (options_.verbose) {
                std::cerr << "request failed, error " << GetLastError() << "\n";
            }
            Close();
            return std::nullopt;
        }

        return response;
    }

private:
    Options options_;
    std::optional<UrlParts> parts_;
    HINTERNET session_ = nullptr;
    HINTERNET connection_ = nullptr;
};

}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    auto options = ParseOptions(argc, argv);
    if (!options) {
        PrintUsage();
        return 2;
    }

    SetConsoleOutputCP(CP_UTF8);
    SetConsoleCP(CP_UTF8);
    _setmode(_fileno(stdout), _O_BINARY);
    _setmode(_fileno(stdin), _O_BINARY);

    BridgeClient client(*options);
    if (!client.Open()) {
        std::cerr << "failed to initialize WinHTTP\n";
        return 2;
    }

    bool connected = false;
    const ULONGLONG deadline = GetTickCount64() + static_cast<ULONGLONG>(options->waitSeconds) * 1000;
    do {
        int status = 0;
        auto response = client.Send(R"({"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":0,"method":"ping"})", &status);
        if (response && status == 200) {
            connected = true;
            break;
        }
        if (deadline <= GetTickCount64()) {
            break;
        }
        Sleep(250);
    } while (true);

    if (!connected && options->verbose) {
        std::cerr << "server not reachable yet; will retry per request\n";
    }

    std::string line;
    while (std::getline(std::cin, line)) {
        line = Trim(line);
        if (line.empty()) {
            continue;
        }

        int status = 0;
        auto response = client.Send(line, &status);
        if (!response) {
            std::cout << R"({"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":null,"error":{"code":-32000,"message":"FortniteMCP server unreachable"}})"
                      << '\n'
                      << std::flush;
            continue;
        }

        if (status == 401) {
            std::cerr << "unauthorized: set --token or FORTNITEMCP_TOKEN, or read the token file\n";
            std::cout << R"({"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":null,"error":{"code":-32001,"message":"unauthorized"}})"
                      << '\n'
                      << std::flush;
            continue;
        }

        if (!response->empty()) {
            std::cout << Trim(*response) << '\n' << std::flush;
        }
    }

    client.Close();
    return 0;
}
```

```cpp
#include "core/allocator.h"

#include "core/log.h"
#include "core/memory.h"

#include <windows.h>

namespace fmcp {

namespace {

uintptr_t FindNearbyFree(size_t size, uintptr_t nearAddress) {
    const uintptr_t granularity = 0x10000;
    const uintptr_t start = nearAddress & ~(granularity - 1);
    const uintptr_t minAddress = 0x10000;
    const uintptr_t maxAddress = 0x00007FFFFFFEFFFFull;
    const uintptr_t range = 0x40000000ull;

    for (uintptr_t delta = granularity; delta < range; delta += granularity) {
        for (int direction = 0; direction < 2; ++direction) {
            const uintptr_t candidate = direction == 0 ? start - delta : start + delta;
            if (candidate < minAddress || candidate > maxAddress || candidate + size > maxAddress) {
                continue;
            }
            MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mbi{};
            if (VirtualQuery(reinterpret_cast<LPCVOID>(candidate), &mbi, sizeof(mbi)) == 0) {
                continue;
            }
            if (mbi.State != MEM_FREE) {
                continue;
            }
            void* memory = VirtualAlloc(reinterpret_cast<LPVOID>(candidate), size,
                                        MEM_COMMIT | MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_READWRITE);
            if (memory) {
                return reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(memory);
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

}

namespace {
Allocator* g_allocator = nullptr;
}

Allocator& Allocator::Get() {
    if (!g_allocator) {
        g_allocator = new Allocator();
    }
    return *g_allocator;
}

uintptr_t Allocator::Allocate(size_t size, unsigned long protection, uintptr_t nearAddress,
                              const std::string& label, std::string* error) {
    if (size == 0 || size > 256ull * 1024 * 1024) {
        if (error) *error = "invalid allocation size";
        return 0;
    }

    uintptr_t address = 0;
    if (nearAddress) {
        address = FindNearbyFree(size, nearAddress);
    }
    if (!address) {
        void* memory = VirtualAlloc(nullptr, size, MEM_COMMIT | MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_READWRITE);
        if (!memory) {
            if (error) *error = "VirtualAlloc failed";
            return 0;
        }
        address = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(memory);
    }

    DWORD old = 0;
    if (protection != PAGE_READWRITE &&
        !VirtualProtect(reinterpret_cast<LPVOID>(address), size, protection, &old)) {
        VirtualFree(reinterpret_cast<LPVOID>(address), 0, MEM_RELEASE);
        if (error) *error = "VirtualProtect failed";
        return 0;
    }

    AllocationInfo info;
    info.address = address;
    info.size = size;
    info.protection = protection;
    info.timestamp = GetTickCount64();
    info.label = label;

    {
        std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
        allocations_[address] = info;
    }

    FMCP_LOGD("Allocated %zu bytes at %s (%s)", size, mem::FormatAddress(address).c_str(), label.c_str());
    return address;
}

bool Allocator::Free(uintptr_t address, bool allowUntracked, std::string* error) {
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
        auto it = allocations_.find(address);
        if (it != allocations_.end()) {
            const void* memory = reinterpret_cast<const void*>(address);
            if (!VirtualFree(const_cast<LPVOID>(memory), 0, MEM_RELEASE)) {
                if (error) *error = "VirtualFree failed for tracked allocation";
                return false;
            }
            allocations_.erase(it);
            return true;
        }
    }

    if (!allowUntracked) {
        if (error) *error = "address is not a tracked MCP allocation";
        return false;
    }

    MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mbi{};
    if (VirtualQuery(reinterpret_cast<LPCVOID>(address), &mbi, sizeof(mbi)) == 0 ||
        mbi.BaseAddress != reinterpret_cast<LPVOID>(address) || mbi.Type != MEM_PRIVATE ||
        mbi.State != MEM_COMMIT) {
        if (error) *error = "refusing to free an address that is not a private allocation base";
        return false;
    }

    if (!VirtualFree(reinterpret_cast<LPVOID>(address), 0, MEM_RELEASE)) {
        if (error) *error = "VirtualFree failed";
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

std::vector<AllocationInfo> Allocator::List() {
    std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
    std::vector<AllocationInfo> out;
    out.reserve(allocations_.size());
    for (const auto& [_, info] : allocations_) {
        out.push_back(info);
    }
    return out;
}

size_t Allocator::Count() {
    std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
    return allocations_.size();
}

void Allocator::FreeAll() {
    std::vector<AllocationInfo> items;
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
        for (const auto& [_, info] : allocations_) {
            items.push_back(info);
        }
        allocations_.clear();
    }
    for (const auto& info : items) {
        VirtualFree(reinterpret_cast<LPVOID>(info.address), 0, MEM_RELEASE);
    }
}

}
```

```h
struct AllocationInfo {

    size_t size = 0;
    unsigned long protection = 0;
    uint64_t timestamp = 0;

    uintptr_t Allocate(size_t size, unsigned long protection, uintptr_t nearAddress,
                       const std::string& label, std::string* error);
    bool Free(uintptr_t address, bool allowUntracked, std::string* error);
    std::vector<AllocationInfo> List();
```

`src/core/base64.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "core/base64.h"

namespace fmcp::b64 {

namespace {

constexpr char kAlphabet[] = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/";

int DecodeChar(char c) {
    if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') return c - 'A';
    if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') return c - 'a' + 26;
    if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') return c - '0' + 52;
    if (c == '+') return 62;
    if (c == '/') return 63;
    return -1;
}

}

std::string Encode(const void* data, size_t size) {
    const auto* bytes = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(data);
    std::string out;
    out.reserve(((size + 2) / 3) * 4);

    size_t i = 0;
    for (; i + 2 < size; i += 3) {
        uint32_t value = (static_cast<uint32_t>(bytes[i]) << 16) |
                         (static_cast<uint32_t>(bytes[i + 1]) << 8) |
                         static_cast<uint32_t>(bytes[i + 2]);
        out.push_back(kAlphabet[(value >> 18) & 0x3F]);
        out.push_back(kAlphabet[(value >> 12) & 0x3F]);
        out.push_back(kAlphabet[(value >> 6) & 0x3F]);
        out.push_back(kAlphabet[value & 0x3F]);
    }

    if (i < size) {
        uint32_t value = static_cast<uint32_t>(bytes[i]) << 16;
        if (i + 1 < size) {
            value |= static_cast<uint32_t>(bytes[i + 1]) << 8;
        }
        out.push_back(kAlphabet[(value >> 18) & 0x3F]);
        out.push_back(kAlphabet[(value >> 12) & 0x3F]);
        out.push_back(i + 1 < size ? kAlphabet[(value >> 6) & 0x3F] : '=');
        out.push_back('=');
    }

    return out;
}

std::optional<std::vector<uint8_t>> Decode(std::string_view text) {
    std::vector<uint8_t> out;
    out.reserve((text.size() / 4) * 3);

    uint32_t buffer = 0;
    int bits = 0;
    for (char c : text) {
        if (c == '=') {
            break;
        }
        if (c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\r' || c == '\n') {
            continue;
        }

        const int value = DecodeChar(c);
        if (value < 0) {
            return std::nullopt;
        }

        buffer = (buffer << 6) | static_cast<uint32_t>(value);
        bits += 6;
        if (bits >= 8) {
            bits -= 8;
            out.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>((buffer >> bits) & 0xFF));
        }
    }

    return out;
}

}
```

```asm
option casemap:none

.code

; uint64_t FmcpInvokeX64(void* fn,
;                        const uint64_t* ints, uint32_t intMask,
;                        const uint64_t* xmm, uint32_t xmmMask,
;                        const uint64_t* stackArgs, uint32_t stackCount,
;                        uint64_t* xmmOut)
FmcpInvokeX64 PROC FRAME
    push rbp
    .pushreg rbp
    mov rbp, rsp
    .setframe rbp, 0
    sub rsp, 120h
    .allocstack 120h
    .endprolog

    mov qword ptr [rbp-08h], rcx
    mov qword ptr [rbp-10h], rdx
    mov dword ptr [rbp-18h], r8d
    mov qword ptr [rbp-20h], r9

    mov eax, dword ptr [rbp+30h]
    mov dword ptr [rbp-28h], eax
    mov rax, qword ptr [rbp+38h]
    mov qword ptr [rbp-30h], rax
    mov eax, dword ptr [rbp+40h]
    mov dword ptr [rbp-38h], eax
    mov rax, qword ptr [rbp+48h]
    mov qword ptr [rbp-40h], rax

    mov r10, qword ptr [rbp-30h]
    mov ecx, dword ptr [rbp-38h]
    xor eax, eax
    test ecx, ecx
    jz copy_done
copy_loop:
    mov r11, qword ptr [r10 + rax*8]
    mov qword ptr [rsp + 20h + rax*8], r11
    inc eax
    cmp eax, ecx
    jb copy_loop
copy_done:

    xor ecx, ecx
    xor edx, edx
    xor r8d, r8d
    xor r9d, r9d

    mov r11, qword ptr [rbp-10h]
    mov r10d, dword ptr [rbp-18h]

    test r10d, 1
    jz int2
    mov rcx, qword ptr [r11]
int2:
    test r10d, 2
    jz int3
    mov rdx, qword ptr [r11+8]
int3:
    test r10d, 4
    jz int4
    mov r8, qword ptr [r11+16]
int4:
    test r10d, 8
    jz int_done
    mov r9, qword ptr [r11+24]
int_done:

    xorps xmm0, xmm0
    xorps xmm1, xmm1
    xorps xmm2, xmm2
    xorps xmm3, xmm3

    mov r11, qword ptr [rbp-20h]
    mov r10d, dword ptr [rbp-28h]

    test r10d, 1
    jz load_xmm1_done
    movq xmm0, qword ptr [r11]
load_xmm1_done:
    test r10d, 2
    jz load_xmm2_done
    movq xmm1, qword ptr [r11+8]
load_xmm2_done:
    test r10d, 4
    jz load_xmm3_done
    movq xmm2, qword ptr [r11+16]
load_xmm3_done:
    test r10d, 8
    jz load_xmm_done
    movq xmm3, qword ptr [r11+24]
load_xmm_done:

    xor eax, eax
    test r10d, 1
    jz var2
    inc eax
var2:
    test r10d, 2
    jz var3
    inc eax
var3:
    test r10d, 4
    jz var4
    inc eax
var4:
    test r10d, 8
    jz var_done
    inc eax
var_done:

    mov r11, qword ptr [rbp-08h]
    call r11

    mov r10, qword ptr [rbp-40h]
    test r10, r10
    jz no_xmm_out
    movq qword ptr [r10], xmm0
no_xmm_out:
    leave
    ret
FmcpInvokeX64 ENDP

end
```
