`src/core/config.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "core/config.h"

#include "core/log.h"
#include "core/strings.h"

#include <bcrypt.h>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <nlohmann/json.hpp>

namespace fs = std::filesystem;
using json = nlohmann::json;

namespace fmcp {

namespace {

std::string DefaultDirectory() {
    wchar_t* local = nullptr;
    size_t len = 0;
    std::string out;

    if (_wdupenv_s(&local, &len, L"LOCALAPPDATA") == 0 && local) {
        out = str::Narrow(local);
    }
    free(local);

    if (out.empty()) {
        out = "C:\\FortniteMCP";
    }

    return out + "\\FortniteMCP";
}

std::string RandomHex(size_t bytes) {
    std::string data(bytes, '\0');

    if (BCryptGenRandom(nullptr, reinterpret_cast<PUCHAR>(data.data()), static_cast<ULONG>(bytes),
                        BCRYPT_USE_SYSTEM_PREFERRED_RNG) != 0) {
        uint64_t seed = GetTickCount64() ^ (uintptr_t)&bytes;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < bytes; ++i) {
            seed = seed * 6364136223846793005ull + 1442695040888963407ull;
            data[i] = static_cast<char>((seed >> 33) & 0xFF);
        }
    }

    static constexpr char kHex[] = "0123456789abcdef";
    std::string out;
    out.reserve(bytes * 2);
    for (unsigned char c : data) {
        out.push_back(kHex[c >> 4]);
        out.push_back(kHex[c & 0xF]);
    }
    return out;
}

bool IsLoopbackHost(const std::string& host) {
    return host == "127.0.0.1" || host == "localhost" || host == "::1";
}

int IntOr(const json& j, const char* key, int fallback) {
    if (!j.is_object() || !j.contains(key) || !j[key].is_number_integer()) {
        return fallback;
    }
    return j[key].get<int>();
}

uint64_t UIntOr(const json& j, const char* key, uint64_t fallback) {
    if (!j.is_object() || !j.contains(key)) {
        return fallback;
    }
    if (j[key].is_number_unsigned()) {
        return j[key].get<uint64_t>();
    }
    if (j[key].is_number_integer()) {
        const int64_t value = j[key].get<int64_t>();
        return value >= 0 ? static_cast<uint64_t>(value) : fallback;
    }
    if (j[key].is_string()) {
        return str::ParseUint(j[key].get<std::string>()).value_or(fallback);
    }
    return fallback;
}

bool BoolOr(const json& j, const char* key, bool fallback) {
    if (!j.is_object() || !j.contains(key) || !j[key].is_boolean()) {
        return fallback;
    }
    return j[key].get<bool>();
}

std::string StringOr(const json& j, const char* key, const std::string& fallback) {
    if (!j.is_object() || !j.contains(key) || !j[key].is_string()) {
        return fallback;
    }
    return j[key].get<std::string>();
}

uint64_t ParseOffsetValue(const json& j) {
    if (j.is_number_unsigned()) {
        return j.get<uint64_t>();
    }
    if (j.is_number_integer()) {
        return static_cast<uint64_t>(j.get<int64_t>());
    }
    if (j.is_string()) {
        auto value = str::ParseUint(j.get<std::string>());
        return value.value_or(0);
    }
    return 0;
}

FunctionSpec ReadFunction(const json& j, const FunctionSpec& def) {
    FunctionSpec out = def;
    if (!j.is_object()) {
        return out;
    }
    out.resolve = StringOr(j, "resolve", out.resolve);
    out.offset = UIntOr(j, "offset", out.offset);
    out.signature = StringOr(j, "signature", out.signature);
    out.vtable_index = IntOr(j, "vtable_index", out.vtable_index);
    out.name_arg = StringOr(j, "name_arg", out.name_arg);
    out.hook = BoolOr(j, "hook", out.hook);
    return out;
}

GlobalSpec ReadGlobal(const json& j, const GlobalSpec& def) {
    GlobalSpec out = def;
    if (!j.is_object()) {
        return out;
    }
    out.resolve = StringOr(j, "resolve", out.resolve);
    out.offset = UIntOr(j, "offset", out.offset);
    out.signature = StringOr(j, "signature", out.signature);
    out.decode = StringOr(j, "decode", out.decode);
    out.from = StringOr(j, "from", out.from);
    if (j.contains("chain") && j["chain"].is_array()) {
        out.chain.clear();
        for (const auto& item : j["chain"]) {
            if (item.is_number_unsigned()) {
                out.chain.push_back(item.get<uint64_t>());
            } else if (item.is_number_integer()) {
                const int64_t value = item.get<int64_t>();
                if (value >= 0) out.chain.push_back(static_cast<uint64_t>(value));
            } else if (item.is_string()) {
                if (auto value = str::ParseUint(item.get<std::string>())) {
                    out.chain.push_back(*value);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return out;
}

void ApplyLayoutJson(ue::Layout& l, const json& j) {
    if (!j.is_object()) {
        return;
    }

#define FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(field, key) \
    if (j.contains(key) && j[key].is_number_integer()) l.field = j[key].get<int>()

    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(object_vtable, "object_vtable");
    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(object_flags, "object_flags");
    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(object_internal_index, "object_internal_index");
    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(object_class, "object_class");
    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(object_name, "object_name");
    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(object_outer, "object_outer");
    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(fname_size, "fname_size");
    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(ufield_next, "ufield_next");
    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(ustruct_super, "ustruct_super");
    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(ustruct_children, "ustruct_children");
    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(ustruct_child_properties, "ustruct_child_properties");
    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(ustruct_properties_size, "ustruct_properties_size");
    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(ustruct_min_alignment, "ustruct_min_alignment");
    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(uclass_class_cast_flags, "uclass_class_cast_flags");
    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(uclass_class_default_object, "uclass_class_default_object");
    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(ffield_class, "ffield_class");
    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(ffield_owner, "ffield_owner");
    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(ffield_next, "ffield_next");
    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(ffield_name, "ffield_name");
    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(ffieldclass_name, "ffieldclass_name");
    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(fproperty_array_dim, "fproperty_array_dim");
    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(fproperty_element_size, "fproperty_element_size");
    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(fproperty_flags, "fproperty_flags");
    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(fproperty_offset, "fproperty_offset");
    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(ufunction_flags, "ufunction_flags");
    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(ufunction_parms_size, "ufunction_parms_size");
    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(ufunction_return_offset, "ufunction_return_offset");
    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(ufunction_func, "ufunction_func");
    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(bool_field_size, "bool_field_size");
    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(bool_byte_offset, "bool_byte_offset");
    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(bool_byte_mask, "bool_byte_mask");
    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(bool_field_mask, "bool_field_mask");
    FMCP_LAYOUT_INT(property_payload, "property_payload");

#undef FMCP_LAYOUT_INT

    if (j.contains("fortnite_property_decoders") && j["fortnite_property_decoders"].is_boolean()) {
        l.fortnite_property_decoders = j["fortnite_property_decoders"].get<bool>();
    }
    if (j.contains("large_world_coords") && j["large_world_coords"].is_boolean()) {
        l.large_world_coords = j["large_world_coords"].get<bool>();
    }
    if (j.contains("children_is_array") && j["children_is_array"].is_boolean()) {
        l.children_is_array = j["children_is_array"].get<bool>();
    }
    if (j.contains("child_properties_is_array") && j["child_properties_is_array"].is_boolean()) {
        l.child_properties_is_array = j["child_properties_is_array"].get<bool>();
    }
}

json FunctionToJson(const FunctionSpec& f) {
    return json{{"resolve", f.resolve}, {"offset", f.offset}, {"signature", f.signature},
                {"vtable_index", f.vtable_index}, {"name_arg", f.name_arg}, {"hook", f.hook}};
}

json GlobalToJson(const GlobalSpec& g) {
    return json{{"resolve", g.resolve}, {"offset", g.offset}, {"signature", g.signature},
                {"decode", g.decode}, {"from", g.from}, {"chain", g.chain}};
}

json LayoutToJson(const ue::Layout& l) {
    return json{
        {"object_vtable", l.object_vtable}, {"object_flags", l.object_flags},
        {"object_internal_index", l.object_internal_index}, {"object_class", l.object_class},
        {"object_name", l.object_name}, {"object_outer", l.object_outer}, {"fname_size", l.fname_size},
        {"ufield_next", l.ufield_next}, {"ustruct_super", l.ustruct_super},
        {"ustruct_children", l.ustruct_children}, {"ustruct_child_properties", l.ustruct_child_properties},
        {"ustruct_properties_size", l.ustruct_properties_size}, {"ustruct_min_alignment", l.ustruct_min_alignment},
        {"uclass_class_cast_flags", l.uclass_class_cast_flags},
        {"uclass_class_default_object", l.uclass_class_default_object},
        {"ffield_class", l.ffield_class}, {"ffield_owner", l.ffield_owner}, {"ffield_next", l.ffield_next},
        {"ffield_name", l.ffield_name}, {"ffieldclass_name", l.ffieldclass_name},
        {"fproperty_array_dim", l.fproperty_array_dim}, {"fproperty_element_size", l.fproperty_element_size},
        {"fproperty_flags", l.fproperty_flags}, {"fproperty_offset", l.fproperty_offset},
        {"ufunction_flags", l.ufunction_flags}, {"ufunction_parms_size", l.ufunction_parms_size},
        {"ufunction_return_offset", l.ufunction_return_offset}, {"ufunction_func", l.ufunction_func},
        {"bool_field_size", l.bool_field_size}, {"bool_byte_offset", l.bool_byte_offset},
        {"bool_byte_mask", l.bool_byte_mask}, {"bool_field_mask", l.bool_field_mask},
        {"property_payload", l.property_payload},
        {"fortnite_property_decoders", l.fortnite_property_decoders},
        {"large_world_coords", l.large_world_coords},
        {"children_is_array", l.children_is_array},
        {"child_properties_is_array", l.child_properties_is_array}};
}

}

namespace {
Config* g_config = nullptr;
}

Config& Config::Get() {
    if (!g_config) {
        g_config = new Config();
    }
    return *g_config;
}

void Config::ResetDefaults() {
    server = ServerConfig{};
    log = LogConfig{};
    safety = SafetyConfig{};
    game_thread = GameThreadConfig{};
    ue = UeConfig{};
    ue.layout = ue::LayoutForProfile(ue.profile);
}

bool Config::Load() {
    ResetDefaults();

    wchar_t* env = nullptr;
    size_t envLen = 0;
    if (_wdupenv_s(&env, &envLen, L"FORTNITEMCP_CONFIG") == 0 && env && *env) {
        path = str::Narrow(env);
    }
    free(env);

    if (path.empty()) {
        directory = DefaultDirectory();
        path = directory + "\\config.json";
    } else {
        directory = fs::path(path).parent_path().string();
    }

    std::error_code ec;
    fs::create_directories(directory, ec);
    log_path = directory + "\\FortniteMCP.log";

    if (!fs::exists(path, ec)) {
        ResetDefaults();
        loaded = true;
        Save();
        log::Write(log::Level::Info, "Created default config at %s", path.c_str());
    }

    std::ifstream file(path);
    if (!file) {
        log::Write(log::Level::Error, "Cannot open config: %s", path.c_str());
        loaded = false;
        return false;
    }

    std::string text((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(file)), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
    ApplyJson(text);
    loaded = true;

    server.token_file = directory + "\\token.txt";
    server.token = server.auth_token;
    if (server.auth_token == "auto") {
        std::ifstream tokenFile(server.token_file);
        std::string token;
        if (tokenFile && std::getline(tokenFile, token)) {
            server.token = str::Trim(token);
        }
        if (server.token.empty() || server.token == "auto") {
            server.token = RandomHex(24);
            std::ofstream out(server.token_file, std::ios::trunc);
            if (out) {
                out << server.token;
            }
        }
    }

    if (!IsLoopbackHost(server.host) && server.token.empty()) {
        log::Write(log::Level::Warn, "Binding a non-loopback host without a token is unsafe; forcing 127.0.0.1");
        server.host = "127.0.0.1";
    }

    if (server.max_body_bytes < 1024) server.max_body_bytes = 1024;
    if (server.max_connections < 1 || server.max_connections > 256) server.max_connections = 32;
    if (game_thread.timeout_ms < 100) game_thread.timeout_ms = 100;
    if (game_thread.max_queued < 1) game_thread.max_queued = 1;

    return true;
}

void Config::ApplyJson(const std::string& text) {
    json j;
    try {
        j = json::parse(text, nullptr, true, true);
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        log::Write(log::Level::Error, "Config parse failed: %s", e.what());
        return;
    }

    if (j.contains("server") && j["server"].is_object()) {
        const auto& s = j["server"];
        server.host = StringOr(s, "host", server.host);
        const int port = IntOr(s, "port", server.port);
        if (port < 0 || port > 65535) {
            log::Write(log::Level::Warn, "Invalid server.port %d; using 26064", port);
        } else {
            server.port = static_cast<uint16_t>(port);
        }
        server.auth_token = StringOr(s, "auth_token", server.auth_token);
        server.max_body_bytes = static_cast<size_t>(UIntOr(s, "max_body_bytes", server.max_body_bytes));
        server.max_connections = IntOr(s, "max_connections", server.max_connections);
        server.idle_timeout_ms = IntOr(s, "idle_timeout_ms", server.idle_timeout_ms);
    }

    if (j.contains("log") && j["log"].is_object()) {
        log.level = StringOr(j["log"], "level", log.level);
        log.max_file_bytes = static_cast<size_t>(UIntOr(j["log"], "max_file_bytes", log.max_file_bytes));
        log.debug_output = BoolOr(j["log"], "debug_output", log.debug_output);
    }

    if (j.contains("safety") && j["safety"].is_object()) {
        const auto& s = j["safety"];
        safety.max_transfer_bytes = static_cast<size_t>(UIntOr(s, "max_transfer_bytes", safety.max_transfer_bytes));
        safety.max_read_bytes = static_cast<size_t>(UIntOr(s, "max_read_bytes", safety.max_read_bytes));
        safety.max_scan_results = static_cast<size_t>(UIntOr(s, "max_scan_results", safety.max_scan_results));
        safety.max_scan_bytes = UIntOr(s, "max_scan_bytes", safety.max_scan_bytes);
        safety.max_patches = IntOr(s, "max_patches", safety.max_patches);
        safety.undo_patches = BoolOr(s, "undo_patches", safety.undo_patches);
        safety.allow_raw_calls = BoolOr(s, "allow_raw_calls", safety.allow_raw_calls);
        safety.allow_any_free = BoolOr(s, "allow_any_free", safety.allow_any_free);
        safety.allow_self_unload = BoolOr(s, "allow_self_unload", safety.allow_self_unload);
        safety.allow_exec_alloc = BoolOr(s, "allow_exec_alloc", safety.allow_exec_alloc);
        safety.require_confirm = BoolOr(s, "require_confirm", safety.require_confirm);
    }

    if (j.contains("game_thread") && j["game_thread"].is_object()) {
        const auto& g = j["game_thread"];
        game_thread.enabled = BoolOr(g, "enabled", game_thread.enabled);
        game_thread.timeout_ms = IntOr(g, "timeout_ms", game_thread.timeout_ms);
        game_thread.max_queued = IntOr(g, "max_queued", game_thread.max_queued);
        game_thread.jobs_per_pump = IntOr(g, "jobs_per_pump", game_thread.jobs_per_pump);
        game_thread.pump_budget_us = IntOr(g, "pump_budget_us", game_thread.pump_budget_us);
        game_thread.direct_fallback = BoolOr(g, "direct_fallback", game_thread.direct_fallback);
    }

    if (j.contains("ue") && j["ue"].is_object()) {
        const auto& u = j["ue"];
        ue.profile = StringOr(u, "profile", ue.profile);
        ue.auto_tune = BoolOr(u, "auto_tune", ue.auto_tune);
        ue.layout = ue::LayoutForProfile(ue.profile);

        if (u.contains("static_find_object")) ue.static_find_object = ReadFunction(u["static_find_object"], ue.static_find_object);
        if (u.contains("get_objects_of_class")) ue.get_objects_of_class = ReadFunction(u["get_objects_of_class"], ue.get_objects_of_class);
        if (u.contains("process_event")) ue.process_event = ReadFunction(u["process_event"], ue.process_event);

        if (u.contains("names") && u["names"].is_object()) {
            const auto& n = u["names"];
            ue.names.style = StringOr(n, "style", ue.names.style);
            ue.names.resolve = StringOr(n, "resolve", ue.names.resolve);
            ue.names.offset = UIntOr(n, "offset", ue.names.offset);
            ue.names.signature = StringOr(n, "signature", ue.names.signature);
            ue.names.fname_size = IntOr(n, "fname_size", ue.names.fname_size);
            ue.names.block_table_offset = IntOr(n, "block_table_offset", ue.names.block_table_offset);
            ue.names.block_bits = IntOr(n, "block_bits", ue.names.block_bits);
            ue.names.stride = IntOr(n, "stride", ue.names.stride);
            ue.names.codec = StringOr(n, "codec", ue.names.codec);
            ue.names.abi = StringOr(n, "abi", ue.names.abi);
            ue.names.max_chars = IntOr(n, "max_chars", ue.names.max_chars);
            ue.names.game_thread = BoolOr(n, "game_thread", ue.names.game_thread);
            ue.names.validate = BoolOr(n, "validate", ue.names.validate);
            ue.names.pool_offset = UIntOr(n, "pool_offset", ue.names.pool_offset);
            ue.names.decrypt = StringOr(n, "decrypt", ue.names.decrypt);
            ue.names.decrypt_key = UIntOr(n, "decrypt_key", ue.names.decrypt_key);
        }

        if (u.contains("objects") && u["objects"].is_object()) {
            const auto& o = u["objects"];
            ue.objects.style = StringOr(o, "style", ue.objects.style);
            ue.objects.resolve = StringOr(o, "resolve", ue.objects.resolve);
            ue.objects.offset = UIntOr(o, "offset", ue.objects.offset);
            ue.objects.signature = StringOr(o, "signature", ue.objects.signature);
            ue.objects.objects_offset = UIntOr(o, "objects_offset", ue.objects.objects_offset);
            ue.objects.item_size = IntOr(o, "item_size", ue.objects.item_size);
            ue.objects.chunk_bits = IntOr(o, "chunk_bits", ue.objects.chunk_bits);
            ue.objects.item_object_offset = IntOr(o, "item_object_offset", ue.objects.item_object_offset);
            ue.objects.max_objects = IntOr(o, "max_objects", ue.objects.max_objects);
            ue.objects.empty_chunk_stop = IntOr(o, "empty_chunk_stop", ue.objects.empty_chunk_stop);
        }

        if (u.contains("gworld")) ue.gworld = ReadGlobal(u["gworld"], ue.gworld);
        if (u.contains("gengine")) ue.gengine = ReadGlobal(u["gengine"], ue.gengine);

        if (u.contains("extra_globals") && u["extra_globals"].is_object()) {
            for (auto it = u["extra_globals"].begin(); it != u["extra_globals"].end(); ++it) {
                ue.extra_globals[it.key()] = ReadGlobal(it.value(), GlobalSpec{});
            }
        }

        if (u.contains("layout")) {
            ApplyLayoutJson(ue.layout, u["layout"]);
        }

        if (ue.names.fname_size != 4 && ue.names.fname_size != 8) {
            ue.names.fname_size = ue.layout.fname_size;
        }
        ue.layout.fname_size = ue.names.fname_size;
    }

    if (ue.layout.fname_size != 4 && ue.layout.fname_size != 8) {
        ue.layout.fname_size = 8;
    }
}

std::string Config::Serialize() const {
    json j;
    j["server"] = {{"host", server.host},
                   {"port", server.port},
                   {"auth_token", server.auth_token == "auto" ? "auto" : server.auth_token},
                   {"max_body_bytes", server.max_body_bytes},
                   {"max_connections", server.max_connections},
                   {"idle_timeout_ms", server.idle_timeout_ms}};
    j["log"] = {{"level", log.level}, {"max_file_bytes", log.max_file_bytes}, {"debug_output", log.debug_output}};
    j["safety"] = {{"max_transfer_bytes", safety.max_transfer_bytes},
                   {"max_read_bytes", safety.max_read_bytes},
                   {"max_scan_results", safety.max_scan_results},
                   {"max_scan_bytes", safety.max_scan_bytes},
                   {"max_patches", safety.max_patches},
                   {"undo_patches", safety.undo_patches},
                   {"allow_raw_calls", safety.allow_raw_calls},
                   {"allow_any_free", safety.allow_any_free},
                   {"allow_self_unload", safety.allow_self_unload},
                   {"allow_exec_alloc", safety.allow_exec_alloc},
                   {"require_confirm", safety.require_confirm}};
    j["game_thread"] = {{"enabled", game_thread.enabled},
                        {"timeout_ms", game_thread.timeout_ms},
                        {"max_queued", game_thread.max_queued},
                        {"jobs_per_pump", game_thread.jobs_per_pump},
                        {"pump_budget_us", game_thread.pump_budget_us},
                        {"direct_fallback", game_thread.direct_fallback}};

    json extra = json::object();
    for (const auto& [name, spec] : ue.extra_globals) {
        extra[name] = GlobalToJson(spec);
    }

    j["ue"] = {{"profile", ue.profile},
               {"auto_tune", ue.auto_tune},
               {"static_find_object", FunctionToJson(ue.static_find_object)},
               {"get_objects_of_class", FunctionToJson(ue.get_objects_of_class)},
               {"process_event", FunctionToJson(ue.process_event)},
               {"names", {{"style", ue.names.style},
                          {"resolve", ue.names.resolve},
                          {"offset", ue.names.offset},
                          {"signature", ue.names.signature},
                          {"fname_size", ue.names.fname_size},
                          {"block_table_offset", ue.names.block_table_offset},
                          {"block_bits", ue.names.block_bits},
                          {"stride", ue.names.stride},
                          {"codec", ue.names.codec},
                          {"abi", ue.names.abi},
                          {"max_chars", ue.names.max_chars},
                          {"game_thread", ue.names.game_thread},
                          {"validate", ue.names.validate},
                          {"pool_offset", ue.names.pool_offset},
                          {"decrypt", ue.names.decrypt},
                          {"decrypt_key", ue.names.decrypt_key}}},
               {"objects", {{"style", ue.objects.style},
                            {"resolve", ue.objects.resolve},
                            {"offset", ue.objects.offset},
                            {"signature", ue.objects.signature},
                            {"objects_offset", ue.objects.objects_offset},
                            {"item_size", ue.objects.item_size},
                            {"chunk_bits", ue.objects.chunk_bits},
                            {"item_object_offset", ue.objects.item_object_offset},
                            {"max_objects", ue.objects.max_objects},
                            {"empty_chunk_stop", ue.objects.empty_chunk_stop}}},
               {"gworld", GlobalToJson(ue.gworld)},
               {"gengine", GlobalToJson(ue.gengine)},
               {"extra_globals", extra},
               {"layout", LayoutToJson(ue.layout)}};

    return j.dump(2);
}

void Config::ApplyRuntimeJson(const nlohmann::json& root) {
    if (!root.is_object()) {
        return;
    }

    if (root.contains("game_thread") && root["game_thread"].is_object()) {
        const auto& g = root["game_thread"];
        game_thread.enabled = BoolOr(g, "enabled", game_thread.enabled);
        game_thread.timeout_ms = IntOr(g, "timeout_ms", game_thread.timeout_ms);
        game_thread.max_queued = IntOr(g, "max_queued", game_thread.max_queued);
        game_thread.jobs_per_pump = IntOr(g, "jobs_per_pump", game_thread.jobs_per_pump);
        game_thread.pump_budget_us = IntOr(g, "pump_budget_us", game_thread.pump_budget_us);
        game_thread.direct_fallback = BoolOr(g, "direct_fallback", game_thread.direct_fallback);
    }

    if (root.contains("safety") && root["safety"].is_object()) {
        const auto& s = root["safety"];
        safety.allow_raw_calls = BoolOr(s, "allow_raw_calls", safety.allow_raw_calls);
        safety.allow_any_free = BoolOr(s, "allow_any_free", safety.allow_any_free);
        safety.allow_self_unload = BoolOr(s, "allow_self_unload", safety.allow_self_unload);
        safety.allow_exec_alloc = BoolOr(s, "allow_exec_alloc", safety.allow_exec_alloc);
        safety.require_confirm = BoolOr(s, "require_confirm", safety.require_confirm);
        safety.max_read_bytes = static_cast<size_t>(UIntOr(s, "max_read_bytes", safety.max_read_bytes));
        safety.max_transfer_bytes = static_cast<size_t>(UIntOr(s, "max_transfer_bytes", safety.max_transfer_bytes));
    }

    if (!root.contains("ue") || !root["ue"].is_object()) {
        return;
    }

    const auto& u = root["ue"];
    const bool profileChanged = u.contains("profile") && u["profile"].is_string();
    if (profileChanged) {
        ue.profile = u["profile"].get<std::string>();
        ue.layout = ue::LayoutForProfile(ue.profile);
    }
    ue.auto_tune = BoolOr(u, "auto_tune", ue.auto_tune);

    if (u.contains("static_find_object")) ue.static_find_object = ReadFunction(u["static_find_object"], ue.static_find_object);
    if (u.contains("get_objects_of_class")) ue.get_objects_of_class = ReadFunction(u["get_objects_of_class"], ue.get_objects_of_class);
    if (u.contains("process_event")) ue.process_event = ReadFunction(u["process_event"], ue.process_event);

    if (u.contains("names") && u["names"].is_object()) {
        const auto& n = u["names"];
        ue.names.style = StringOr(n, "style", ue.names.style);
        ue.names.resolve = StringOr(n, "resolve", ue.names.resolve);
        ue.names.offset = UIntOr(n, "offset", ue.names.offset);
        ue.names.signature = StringOr(n, "signature", ue.names.signature);
        ue.names.fname_size = IntOr(n, "fname_size", ue.names.fname_size);
        ue.names.block_table_offset = IntOr(n, "block_table_offset", ue.names.block_table_offset);
        ue.names.block_bits = IntOr(n, "block_bits", ue.names.block_bits);
        ue.names.stride = IntOr(n, "stride", ue.names.stride);
        ue.names.codec = StringOr(n, "codec", ue.names.codec);
        ue.names.abi = StringOr(n, "abi", ue.names.abi);
        ue.names.max_chars = IntOr(n, "max_chars", ue.names.max_chars);
        ue.names.game_thread = BoolOr(n, "game_thread", ue.names.game_thread);
        ue.names.validate = BoolOr(n, "validate", ue.names.validate);
        ue.names.pool_offset = UIntOr(n, "pool_offset", ue.names.pool_offset);
        ue.names.decrypt = StringOr(n, "decrypt", ue.names.decrypt);
        ue.names.decrypt_key = UIntOr(n, "decrypt_key", ue.names.decrypt_key);
    }

    if (u.contains("objects") && u["objects"].is_object()) {
        const auto& o = u["objects"];
        ue.objects.style = StringOr(o, "style", ue.objects.style);
        ue.objects.resolve = StringOr(o, "resolve", ue.objects.resolve);
        ue.objects.offset = UIntOr(o, "offset", ue.objects.offset);
        ue.objects.signature = StringOr(o, "signature", ue.objects.signature);
        ue.objects.objects_offset = UIntOr(o, "objects_offset", ue.objects.objects_offset);
        ue.objects.item_size = IntOr(o, "item_size", ue.objects.item_size);
        ue.objects.chunk_bits = IntOr(o, "chunk_bits", ue.objects.chunk_bits);
        ue.objects.item_object_offset = IntOr(o, "item_object_offset", ue.objects.item_object_offset);
        ue.objects.max_objects = IntOr(o, "max_objects", ue.objects.max_objects);
        ue.objects.empty_chunk_stop = IntOr(o, "empty_chunk_stop", ue.objects.empty_chunk_stop);
    }

    if (u.contains("gworld")) ue.gworld = ReadGlobal(u["gworld"], ue.gworld);
    if (u.contains("gengine")) ue.gengine = ReadGlobal(u["gengine"], ue.gengine);

    if (u.contains("extra_globals") && u["extra_globals"].is_object()) {
        for (auto it = u["extra_globals"].begin(); it != u["extra_globals"].end(); ++it) {
            ue.extra_globals[it.key()] = ReadGlobal(it.value(), ue.extra_globals[it.key()]);
        }
    }

    if (u.contains("layout")) {
        ApplyLayoutJson(ue.layout, u["layout"]);
    }

    if (ue.names.fname_size != 4 && ue.names.fname_size != 8) {
        ue.names.fname_size = ue.layout.fname_size;
    }
    ue.layout.fname_size = ue.names.fname_size;
}

bool Config::Save() {
    try {
        fs::create_directories(directory);
        const std::string temp = path + ".tmp";
        {
            std::ofstream out(temp, std::ios::trunc);
            if (!out) {
                return false;
            }
            out << Serialize();
        }
        std::error_code ec;
        fs::rename(temp, path, ec);
        if (ec) {
            fs::remove(path, ec);
            fs::rename(temp, path, ec);
        }
        return !ec;
    } catch (...) {
        return false;
    }
}

}
```

`src/core/lifecycle.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "core/lifecycle.h"

#include <atomic>

namespace fmcp::lifecycle {

namespace {

std::atomic<bool> g_pending{false};
std::atomic<bool> g_unload{true};
std::atomic<bool> g_restore{false};

}

void RequestShutdown(bool unloadSelf, bool restorePatches) {
    g_unload = unloadSelf;
    g_restore = restorePatches;
    g_pending = true;
}

bool Pending() {
    return g_pending.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
}

bool Consume(bool& unloadSelf, bool& restorePatches) {
    if (!g_pending.exchange(false, std::memory_order_acq_rel)) {
        return false;
    }
    unloadSelf = g_unload.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    restorePatches = g_restore.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    return true;
}

}
```

`src/core/log.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "core/log.h"

#include "core/strings.h"

#include <cstdarg>
#include <cstdio>
#include <deque>
#include <share.h>
#include <mutex>
#include <windows.h>

namespace fmcp::log {

namespace {

std::mutex g_mutex;
Level g_level = Level::Info;
FILE* g_file = nullptr;
std::string g_path;
std::string g_openPath;
size_t g_maxFileBytes = 4 * 1024 * 1024;
bool g_debugOutput = false;
std::deque<std::string> g_ring;
constexpr size_t kRingMax = 2000;

std::string Timestamp() {
    SYSTEMTIME st{};
    GetLocalTime(&st);
    return str::Format("%04u-%02u-%02u %02u:%02u:%02u.%03u", st.wYear, st.wMonth, st.wDay,
                       st.wHour, st.wMinute, st.wSecond, st.wMilliseconds);
}

void RotateIfNeeded(size_t incoming) {
    if (!g_file || g_maxFileBytes == 0) {
        return;
    }

    long size = ftell(g_file);
    if (size < 0 || static_cast<size_t>(size) + incoming <= g_maxFileBytes) {
        return;
    }

    fclose(g_file);
    g_file = nullptr;

    const std::string oldPath = g_openPath + ".1";
    DeleteFileA(oldPath.c_str());
    MoveFileA(g_openPath.c_str(), oldPath.c_str());

    g_file = _fsopen(g_openPath.c_str(), "ab", _SH_DENYNO);
}

void OpenFile() {
    if (g_openPath.empty()) {
        return;
    }
    if (g_file) {
        fclose(g_file);
        g_file = nullptr;
    }
    g_file = _fsopen(g_openPath.c_str(), "ab", _SH_DENYNO);
}

}

Level ParseLevel(const std::string& name) {
    const std::string lower = str::ToLower(name);
    if (lower == "trace") return Level::Trace;
    if (lower == "debug") return Level::Debug;
    if (lower == "info") return Level::Info;
    if (lower == "warn" || lower == "warning") return Level::Warn;
    if (lower == "error") return Level::Error;
    if (lower == "off" || lower == "none") return Level::Off;
    return Level::Info;
}

const char* LevelName(Level level) {
    switch (level) {
    case Level::Trace: return "TRACE";
    case Level::Debug: return "DEBUG";
    case Level::Info: return "INFO";
    case Level::Warn: return "WARN";
    case Level::Error: return "ERROR";
    default: return "OFF";
    }
}

void Init(const std::string& path, Level level, size_t maxFileBytes, bool debugOutput) {
    std::lock_guard lock(g_mutex);
    g_level = level;
    g_maxFileBytes = maxFileBytes;
    g_debugOutput = debugOutput;
    g_path = path;

    if (path != g_openPath) {
        if (g_file) {
            fclose(g_file);
            g_file = nullptr;
        }
        g_openPath = path;
        OpenFile();
    }
}

void Shutdown() {
    std::lock_guard lock(g_mutex);
    if (g_file) {
        fflush(g_file);
        fclose(g_file);
        g_file = nullptr;
    }
}

void SetLevel(Level level) {
    std::lock_guard lock(g_mutex);
    g_level = level;
}

bool Enabled(Level level) {
    std::lock_guard lock(g_mutex);
    return g_level != Level::Off && level >= g_level;
}

void Write(Level level, const char* fmt, ...) {
    std::lock_guard lock(g_mutex);
    if (g_level == Level::Off || level < g_level) {
        return;
    }

    va_list args;
    va_start(args, fmt);
    std::string message = str::VFormat(fmt, args);
    va_end(args);

    if (message.size() > 8192) {
        message.resize(8192);
        message += "...";
    }

    const std::string line = Timestamp() + " [" + LevelName(level) + "] " + message;

    g_ring.push_back(line);
    if (g_ring.size() > kRingMax) {
        g_ring.pop_front();
    }

    if (g_file) {
        RotateIfNeeded(line.size() + 2);
        if (g_file) {
            fwrite(line.data(), 1, line.size(), g_file);
            fputc('\n', g_file);
            fflush(g_file);
        }
    }

    if (g_debugOutput) {
        OutputDebugStringA((line + "\n").c_str());
    }
}

std::string Tail(size_t maxLines) {
    std::lock_guard lock(g_mutex);
    if (g_ring.empty() || maxLines == 0) {
        return {};
    }
    if (maxLines > g_ring.size()) {
        maxLines = g_ring.size();
    }

    std::string out;
    size_t start = g_ring.size() - maxLines;
    for (size_t i = start; i < g_ring.size(); ++i) {
        out += g_ring[i];
        out.push_back('\n');
    }
    return out;
}

const std::string& Path() {
    return g_path;
}

}
```

`src/core/memory.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "core/memory.h"

#include "core/strings.h"

#include <windows.h>

namespace fmcp::mem {

namespace {

bool CopyFrom(void* dst, uintptr_t src, size_t size) {
    __try {
        memcpy(dst, reinterpret_cast<const void*>(src), size);
        return true;
    } __except (EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) {
        return false;
    }
}

bool CopyTo(uintptr_t dst, const void* src, size_t size) {
    __try {
        memcpy(reinterpret_cast<void*>(dst), src, size);
        return true;
    } __except (EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) {
        return false;
    }
}

bool ReadableProtection(DWORD protection) {
    if (protection & (PAGE_GUARD | PAGE_NOACCESS)) {
        return false;
    }
    switch (protection & 0xFF) {
    case PAGE_READONLY:
    case PAGE_READWRITE:
    case PAGE_WRITECOPY:
    case PAGE_EXECUTE_READ:
    case PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE:
    case PAGE_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY:
        return true;
    default:
        return false;
    }
}

bool WritableProtection(DWORD protection) {
    if (protection & (PAGE_GUARD | PAGE_NOACCESS)) {
        return false;
    }
    switch (protection & 0xFF) {
    case PAGE_READWRITE:
    case PAGE_WRITECOPY:
    case PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE:
    case PAGE_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY:
        return true;
    default:
        return false;
    }
}

bool ExecutableProtection(DWORD protection) {
    if (protection & (PAGE_GUARD | PAGE_NOACCESS)) {
        return false;
    }
    switch (protection & 0xFF) {
    case PAGE_EXECUTE:
    case PAGE_EXECUTE_READ:
    case PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE:
    case PAGE_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY:
        return true;
    default:
        return false;
    }
}

template <typename Predicate>
bool CheckRange(uintptr_t address, size_t size, Predicate predicate) {
    if (size == 0) {
        return true;
    }
    if (!IsCanonical(address) || size > (UINTPTR_MAX - address)) {
        return false;
    }

    const uintptr_t end = address + size;
    uintptr_t cursor = address;

    while (cursor < end) {
        MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mbi{};
        if (VirtualQuery(reinterpret_cast<LPCVOID>(cursor), &mbi, sizeof(mbi)) == 0) {
            return false;
        }
        if (mbi.State != MEM_COMMIT || !predicate(mbi.Protect)) {
            return false;
        }

        const uintptr_t regionEnd = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(mbi.BaseAddress) + mbi.RegionSize;
        if (regionEnd <= cursor) {
            return false;
        }
        cursor = regionEnd;
    }

    return true;
}

}

bool IsCanonical(uintptr_t address) {
    return address >= 0x10000ull && address <= 0x00007FFFFFFEFFFFull;
}

bool IsReadable(uintptr_t address, size_t size) {
    return CheckRange(address, size, ReadableProtection);
}

bool IsWritable(uintptr_t address, size_t size) {
    return CheckRange(address, size, WritableProtection);
}

bool IsExecutable(uintptr_t address, size_t size) {
    return CheckRange(address, size, ExecutableProtection);
}

bool Protect(uintptr_t address, size_t size, DWORD protection, DWORD* oldProtection) {
    DWORD old = 0;
    if (!VirtualProtect(reinterpret_cast<LPVOID>(address), size, protection, &old)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (oldProtection) {
        *oldProtection = old;
    }
    return true;
}

bool Read(uintptr_t address, void* buffer, size_t size) {
    if (!buffer || size == 0) {
        return size == 0;
    }
    if (!IsReadable(address, size)) {
        return false;
    }
    return CopyFrom(buffer, address, size);
}

bool Write(uintptr_t address, const void* buffer, size_t size, bool force) {
    if (!buffer || size == 0) {
        return size == 0;
    }
    if (!IsCanonical(address) || size > (UINTPTR_MAX - address)) {
        return false;
    }

    if (!IsWritable(address, size)) {
        if (!force) {
            return false;
        }

        DWORD old = 0;
        const DWORD target = IsExecutable(address, size) ? PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE : PAGE_READWRITE;
        if (!VirtualProtect(reinterpret_cast<LPVOID>(address), size, target, &old)) {
            return false;
        }

        const bool ok = CopyTo(address, buffer, size);
        DWORD ignored = 0;
        VirtualProtect(reinterpret_cast<LPVOID>(address), size, old, &ignored);
        if (ok) {
            FlushInstructionCache(GetCurrentProcess(), reinterpret_cast<LPCVOID>(address), size);
        }
        return ok;
    }

    return CopyTo(address, buffer, size);
}

std::optional<std::string> ReadCString(uintptr_t address, size_t maxLength) {
    if (!IsCanonical(address) || maxLength == 0) {
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    std::string out;
    out.reserve(std::min<size_t>(maxLength, 64));

    for (size_t i = 0; i < maxLength; ++i) {
        char c = 0;
        if (!Read(address + i, c)) {
            return out.empty() ? std::nullopt : std::optional<std::string>(std::move(out));
        }
        if (c == '\0') {
            return out;
        }
        out.push_back(c);
    }

    return out;
}

std::optional<std::wstring> ReadWString(uintptr_t address, size_t maxChars) {
    if (!IsCanonical(address) || maxChars == 0) {
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    std::wstring out;
    out.reserve(std::min<size_t>(maxChars, 64));

    for (size_t i = 0; i < maxChars; ++i) {
        wchar_t c = 0;
        if (!Read(address + i * sizeof(wchar_t), c)) {
            return out.empty() ? std::nullopt : std::optional<std::wstring>(std::move(out));
        }
        if (c == L'\0') {
            return out;
        }
        out.push_back(c);
    }

    return out;
}

std::string ProtectionName(DWORD protection) {
    if (protection & PAGE_GUARD) return "guard";
    if (protection & PAGE_NOACCESS) return "noaccess";

    switch (protection & 0xFF) {
    case PAGE_READONLY: return "r";
    case PAGE_READWRITE: return "rw";
    case PAGE_WRITECOPY: return "rwc";
    case PAGE_EXECUTE: return "x";
    case PAGE_EXECUTE_READ: return "rx";
    case PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE: return "rwx";
    case PAGE_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY: return "rwxc";
    default: return "?";
    }
}

std::string FormatAddress(uintptr_t address) {
    return str::Format("0x%llX", static_cast<unsigned long long>(address));
}

bool AlignRange(uintptr_t& address, size_t& size) {
    if (size == 0) {
        return true;
    }
    const uintptr_t page = 0x1000;
    const uintptr_t end = address + size;
    const uintptr_t alignedStart = address & ~(page - 1);
    const uintptr_t alignedEnd = (end + page - 1) & ~(page - 1);
    if (alignedEnd < alignedStart) {
        return false;
    }
    address = alignedStart;
    size = static_cast<size_t>(alignedEnd - alignedStart);
    return true;
}

}
```

```h
#pragma once

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <type_traits>
#include <windows.h>

namespace fmcp::mem {

bool IsCanonical(uintptr_t address);
bool IsReadable(uintptr_t address, size_t size);
bool IsWritable(uintptr_t address, size_t size);
bool IsExecutable(uintptr_t address, size_t size = 1);
bool Protect(uintptr_t address, size_t size, DWORD protection, DWORD* oldProtection = nullptr);
bool Read(uintptr_t address, void* buffer, size_t size);
bool Write(uintptr_t address, const void* buffer, size_t size, bool force = false);

template <typename T>
bool Read(uintptr_t address, T& out) {
    static_assert(std::is_trivially_copyable_v<T>);
    return Read(address, &out, sizeof(T));
}

template <typename T>
T ReadOr(uintptr_t address, T fallback = T{}) {
    T value{};
    if (!Read(address, value)) {
        return fallback;
    }
    return value;
}

template <typename T>
bool Write(uintptr_t address, const T& value, bool force = false) {
    static_assert(std::is_trivially_copyable_v<T>);
    return Write(address, &value, sizeof(T), force);
}

std::optional<std::string> ReadCString(uintptr_t address, size_t maxLength = 512);
std::optional<std::wstring> ReadWString(uintptr_t address, size_t maxChars = 512);
std::string ProtectionName(DWORD protection);
std::string FormatAddress(uintptr_t address);
bool AlignRange(uintptr_t& address, size_t& size);

}
```

`src/core/modules.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "core/modules.h"

#include "core/memory.h"
#include "core/strings.h"

#include <TlHelp32.h>
#include <windows.h>

namespace fmcp::modules {

namespace {

std::vector<ModuleInfo> g_modules;
ModuleInfo g_main;
bool g_ready = false;

std::string ReadSectionName(const IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER& header) {
    char name[9]{};
    memcpy(name, header.Name, 8);
    return name;
}

ModuleInfo BuildModule(const MODULEENTRY32W& entry) {
    ModuleInfo info;
    info.name = str::Narrow(entry.szModule);
    info.path = str::Narrow(entry.szExePath);
    info.base = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(entry.modBaseAddr);
    info.size = entry.modBaseSize;

    if (!info.base || !info.size) {
        return info;
    }

    auto* dos = reinterpret_cast<IMAGE_DOS_HEADER*>(info.base);
    if (dos->e_magic != IMAGE_DOS_SIGNATURE) {
        return info;
    }

    auto* nt = reinterpret_cast<IMAGE_NT_HEADERS*>(info.base + static_cast<uintptr_t>(dos->e_lfanew));
    if (nt->Signature != IMAGE_NT_SIGNATURE) {
        return info;
    }

    auto* sections = IMAGE_FIRST_SECTION(nt);
    for (WORD i = 0; i < nt->FileHeader.NumberOfSections; ++i) {
        const auto& header = sections[i];
        SectionInfo section;
        section.name = ReadSectionName(header);
        section.address = info.base + header.VirtualAddress;
        section.size = header.Misc.VirtualSize ? header.Misc.VirtualSize : header.SizeOfRawData;
        section.characteristics = header.Characteristics;
        section.executable = (header.Characteristics & IMAGE_SCN_MEM_EXECUTE) != 0;
        section.writable = (header.Characteristics & IMAGE_SCN_MEM_WRITE) != 0;
        section.readable = (header.Characteristics & IMAGE_SCN_MEM_READ) != 0;
        info.sections.push_back(std::move(section));
    }

    return info;
}

bool NameMatches(std::string_view moduleName, std::string_view query) {
    if (str::IEquals(moduleName, query)) {
        return true;
    }

    std::string_view nameNoExt = moduleName;
    if (str::EndsWith(str::ToLower(moduleName), ".dll")) {
        nameNoExt = moduleName.substr(0, moduleName.size() - 4);
    }
    std::string_view queryNoExt = query;
    if (str::EndsWith(str::ToLower(query), ".dll")) {
        queryNoExt = query.substr(0, query.size() - 4);
    }
    return str::IEquals(nameNoExt, queryNoExt);
}

}

bool Refresh() {
    std::vector<ModuleInfo> modules;

    HANDLE snapshot = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPMODULE | TH32CS_SNAPMODULE32,
                                               GetCurrentProcessId());
    if (snapshot == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        return false;
    }

    MODULEENTRY32W entry{};
    entry.dwSize = sizeof(entry);

    if (Module32FirstW(snapshot, &entry)) {
        do {
            ModuleInfo info = BuildModule(entry);
            if (!info.base) {
                continue;
            }
            if (info.base == reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(GetModuleHandleW(nullptr))) {
                g_main = info;
            }
            modules.push_back(std::move(info));
        } while (Module32NextW(snapshot, &entry));
    }

    CloseHandle(snapshot);

    if (modules.empty()) {
        return false;
    }

    if (!g_main.base) {
        for (auto& module : modules) {
            if (module.base == reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(GetModuleHandleW(nullptr))) {
                g_main = module;
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    g_modules = std::move(modules);
    g_ready = true;
    return true;
}

const ModuleInfo* Main() {
    if (!g_ready) {
        Refresh();
    }
    return g_main.base ? &g_main : nullptr;
}

std::vector<ModuleInfo> All() {
    if (!g_ready) {
        Refresh();
    }
    return g_modules;
}

std::optional<ModuleInfo> Find(std::string_view name) {
    if (name == "main" || name == "base" || name == "exe") {
        if (const auto* main = Main()) {
            return *main;
        }
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    if (!g_ready) {
        Refresh();
    }
    for (const auto& module : g_modules) {
        if (NameMatches(module.name, name)) {
            return module;
        }
    }
    return std::nullopt;
}

const ModuleInfo* FindByAddress(uintptr_t address) {
    if (!g_ready) {
        Refresh();
    }
    for (const auto& module : g_modules) {
        if (module.Contains(address)) {
            return &module;
        }
    }
    return nullptr;
}

bool IsExecutableAddress(uintptr_t address, size_t size) {
    if (const auto* module = FindByAddress(address)) {
        for (const auto& section : module->sections) {
            if (!section.executable) {
                continue;
            }
            if (address >= section.address && size <= section.size &&
                address - section.address <= section.size - size) {
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    return mem::IsExecutable(address, size);
}

bool IsReadOnlyAddress(uintptr_t address, size_t size) {
    MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mbi{};
    if (VirtualQuery(reinterpret_cast<LPCVOID>(address), &mbi, sizeof(mbi)) == 0) {
        return false;
    }
    if (mbi.State != MEM_COMMIT || (mbi.Protect & (PAGE_GUARD | PAGE_NOACCESS))) {
        return false;
    }
    if (reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(mbi.BaseAddress) + mbi.RegionSize < address + size) {
        return false;
    }
    const DWORD protect = mbi.Protect & 0xFF;
    return protect == PAGE_READONLY || protect == PAGE_EXECUTE_READ;
}

std::optional<uintptr_t> Resolve(std::string_view expression, std::string* error) {
    std::string trimmed = str::Trim(expression);
    if (trimmed.empty()) {
        if (error) *error = "empty address";
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    if (auto direct = str::ParseUint(trimmed)) {
        return static_cast<uintptr_t>(*direct);
    }

    const size_t plus = trimmed.find_last_of('+');
    if (plus == std::string::npos) {
        if (error) *error = "address must be a number, module+offset, or base+offset";
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    std::string moduleName = str::Trim(trimmed.substr(0, plus));
    std::string offsetText = str::Trim(trimmed.substr(plus + 1));
    auto offset = str::ParseUint(offsetText);
    if (!offset) {
        if (error) *error = "invalid module offset";
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    auto module = Find(moduleName);
    if (!module) {
        if (error) *error = "module not found: " + moduleName;
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    return module->base + static_cast<uintptr_t>(*offset);
}

std::string NameFromAddress(uintptr_t address) {
    if (const auto* module = FindByAddress(address)) {
        return str::Format("%s+0x%llX", module->name.c_str(),
                           static_cast<unsigned long long>(address - module->base));
    }
    return mem::FormatAddress(address);
}

}
```

`src/core/patches.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "core/patches.h"

#include "core/log.h"
#include "core/memory.h"

#include <mutex>

namespace fmcp::patches {

namespace {

std::mutex g_mutex;
bool g_enabled = true;
int g_maxPatches = 128;
uint32_t g_nextId = 1;
std::vector<Patch> g_patches;

}

void Initialize(bool enabled, int maxPatches) {
    std::lock_guard lock(g_mutex);
    g_enabled = enabled;
    g_maxPatches = maxPatches < 1 ? 1 : maxPatches;
    g_patches.clear();
}

bool Enabled() {
    std::lock_guard lock(g_mutex);
    return g_enabled;
}

std::optional<uint32_t> Record(uintptr_t address, size_t size, std::string note) {
    if (!g_enabled || size == 0 || size > 0x10000) {
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    Patch patch;
    patch.original.resize(size);
    if (!mem::Read(address, patch.original.data(), size)) {
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    std::lock_guard lock(g_mutex);
    if (static_cast<int>(g_patches.size()) >= g_maxPatches) {
        g_patches.erase(g_patches.begin());
    }

    patch.id = g_nextId++;
    patch.address = address;
    patch.note = std::move(note);
    patch.timestamp = GetTickCount64();
    g_patches.push_back(std::move(patch));
    return g_patches.back().id;
}

std::vector<Patch> List() {
    std::lock_guard lock(g_mutex);
    return g_patches;
}

bool Undo(uint32_t id) {
    Patch patch;
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(g_mutex);
        auto it = std::find_if(g_patches.begin(), g_patches.end(),
                               [id](const Patch& p) { return p.id == id; });
        if (it == g_patches.end()) {
            return false;
        }
        patch = *it;
        g_patches.erase(it);
    }

    if (!mem::Write(patch.address, patch.original.data(), patch.original.size(), true)) {
        FMCP_LOGW("Failed to restore patch %u at %s", id, mem::FormatAddress(patch.address).c_str());
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

size_t UndoAll() {
    std::vector<Patch> patches;
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(g_mutex);
        patches = g_patches;
        g_patches.clear();
    }

    size_t restored = 0;
    for (auto it = patches.rbegin(); it != patches.rend(); ++it) {
        if (mem::Write(it->address, it->original.data(), it->original.size(), true)) {
            ++restored;
        }
    }
    return restored;
}

size_t Count() {
    std::lock_guard lock(g_mutex);
    return g_patches.size();
}

void Clear() {
    std::lock_guard lock(g_mutex);
    g_patches.clear();
}

}
```

`src/core/process.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "core/process.h"

#include "core/strings.h"

#include <cstring>
#include <limits>

namespace fmcp {

bool CallPlan::AddStack(uint64_t raw) {
    if (stack_.size() >= 32) {
        error_ = "too many stack arguments (max 32)";
        return false;
    }
    stack_.push_back(raw);
    return true;
}

bool CallPlan::AddInt(uint64_t value) {
    if (argIndex_ < 4) {
        ints_[argIndex_] = value;
        intMask_ |= (1u << argIndex_);
    } else if (!AddStack(value)) {
        return false;
    }
    ++argIndex_;
    return true;
}

bool CallPlan::AddPointer(uintptr_t value) {
    return AddInt(static_cast<uint64_t>(value));
}

bool CallPlan::AddFloat(float value) {
    uint32_t bits = 0;
    static_assert(sizeof(bits) == sizeof(value));
    memcpy(&bits, &value, sizeof(bits));

    if (argIndex_ < 4) {
        xmm_[argIndex_] = static_cast<uint64_t>(bits);
        xmmMask_ |= (1u << argIndex_);
    } else if (!AddStack(static_cast<uint64_t>(bits))) {
        return false;
    }
    ++argIndex_;
    return true;
}

bool CallPlan::AddDouble(double value) {
    uint64_t bits = 0;
    static_assert(sizeof(bits) == sizeof(value));
    memcpy(&bits, &value, sizeof(bits));

    if (argIndex_ < 4) {
        xmm_[argIndex_] = bits;
        xmmMask_ |= (1u << argIndex_);
    } else if (!AddStack(bits)) {
        return false;
    }
    ++argIndex_;
    return true;
}

CallResult CallPlan::Invoke(uintptr_t function) const {
    CallResult result;
    if (!function || !error_.empty()) {
        return result;
    }
    result.rax = FmcpInvokeX64(reinterpret_cast<void*>(function), ints_, intMask_, xmm_, xmmMask_,
                               stack_.data(), static_cast<uint32_t>(stack_.size()), &result.xmm0);
    return result;
}

extern "C" uint64_t FmcpSelfTestMix(uint64_t a, double b, uint64_t c, double d,
                                    uint64_t e, uint64_t f, double g) {
    const double sum = static_cast<double>(a + c + e + f) + b + d + g;
    return static_cast<uint64_t>(sum) ^ 0xA5A5A5A5ull;
}

extern "C" uint64_t FmcpSelfTestInts(uint64_t a, uint64_t b, uint64_t c, uint64_t d,
                                     uint64_t e, uint64_t f, uint64_t g, uint64_t h) {
    return a + b * 2 + c * 3 + d * 4 + e * 5 + f * 6 + g * 7 + h * 8;
}

extern "C" float FmcpSelfTestFloat(float a, float b) {
    return a * 3.0f + b;
}

bool SelfTestCallingConvention(std::string* error) {
    CallPlan ints;
    for (uint64_t i = 1; i <= 8; ++i) {
        if (!ints.AddInt(i)) {
            if (error) *error = ints.Error();
            return false;
        }
    }
    const CallResult r = ints.Invoke(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&FmcpSelfTestInts));
    if (r.rax != 204ull) {
        if (error) *error = str::Format("integer calling convention mismatch: 0x%llX",
                                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(r.rax));
        return false;
    }

    CallPlan mixed;
    mixed.AddInt(1);
    mixed.AddDouble(2.0);
    mixed.AddInt(3);
    mixed.AddDouble(4.0);
    mixed.AddInt(5);
    mixed.AddInt(6);
    mixed.AddDouble(7.0);
    const CallResult m = mixed.Invoke(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&FmcpSelfTestMix));
    const uint64_t expected = static_cast<uint64_t>(28.0) ^ 0xA5A5A5A5ull;
    if (m.rax != expected) {
        if (error) *error = str::Format("mixed calling convention mismatch: 0x%llX != 0x%llX",
                                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(m.rax),
                                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(expected));
        return false;
    }

    CallPlan flt;
    flt.AddFloat(4.0f);
    flt.AddFloat(2.0f);
    const CallResult f = flt.Invoke(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(&FmcpSelfTestFloat));
    uint32_t bits = static_cast<uint32_t>(f.xmm0);
    float value = 0.0f;
    memcpy(&value, &bits, sizeof(value));
    if (value != 14.0f) {
        if (error) *error = str::Format("float calling convention mismatch: %f", value);
        return false;
    }

    return true;
}

}
```

```h
#pragma once

#include <string>

extern "C" uint64_t FmcpInvokeX64(void* fn, const uint64_t* ints, uint32_t intMask,
                                  const uint64_t* xmm, uint32_t xmmMask,
                                  const uint64_t* stackArgs, uint32_t stackCount,
                                  uint64_t* xmmOut);

namespace fmcp {

struct CallResult {
    uint64_t rax = 0;
    uint64_t xmm0 = 0;
};

// Win64 assigns registers by argument position: RCX/XMM0 for arg 0, RDX/XMM1 for arg 1, etc.
class CallPlan {
public:
    bool AddInt(uint64_t value);
    bool AddPointer(uintptr_t value);
    bool AddFloat(float value);
    bool AddDouble(double value);
    CallResult Invoke(uintptr_t function) const;
    [[nodiscard]] const std::string& Error() const { return error_; }
    [[nodiscard]] size_t ArgumentCount() const { return argIndex_; }

private:
    bool AddStack(uint64_t raw);

    uint64_t ints_[4]{};
    uint32_t intMask_ = 0;
    uint64_t xmm_[4]{};
    uint32_t xmmMask_ = 0;
    std::vector<uint64_t> stack_;
    size_t argIndex_ = 0;
    std::string error_;
};

extern "C" uint64_t FmcpSelfTestMix(uint64_t a, double b, uint64_t c, double d,
                                    uint64_t e, uint64_t f, double g);
extern "C" uint64_t FmcpSelfTestInts(uint64_t a, uint64_t b, uint64_t c, uint64_t d,
                                     uint64_t e, uint64_t f, uint64_t g, uint64_t h);
extern "C" float FmcpSelfTestFloat(float a, float b);
bool SelfTestCallingConvention(std::string* error);

}
```

`src/core/scanner.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "core/scanner.h"

#include "core/memory.h"
#include "core/strings.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <windows.h>

namespace fmcp::scan {

namespace {

int HexValue(char c) {
    if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') return c - '0';
    if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f') return c - 'a' + 10;
    if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F') return c - 'A' + 10;
    return -1;
}

bool IsWritableProtection(DWORD protection) {
    switch (protection & 0xFF) {
    case PAGE_READWRITE:
    case PAGE_WRITECOPY:
    case PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE:
    case PAGE_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY:
        return true;
    default:
        return false;
    }
}

bool IsExecutableProtection(DWORD protection) {
    switch (protection & 0xFF) {
    case PAGE_EXECUTE:
    case PAGE_EXECUTE_READ:
    case PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE:
    case PAGE_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY:
        return true;
    default:
        return false;
    }
}

bool ReadableProtection(DWORD protection) {
    if (protection & (PAGE_GUARD | PAGE_NOACCESS)) {
        return false;
    }
    switch (protection & 0xFF) {
    case PAGE_READONLY:
    case PAGE_READWRITE:
    case PAGE_WRITECOPY:
    case PAGE_EXECUTE_READ:
    case PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE:
    case PAGE_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY:
        return true;
    default:
        return false;
    }
}

}

std::optional<std::vector<PatternByte>> ParsePattern(std::string_view text, std::string* error) {
    std::vector<PatternByte> pattern;

    std::string compact;
    compact.reserve(text.size());
    for (char c : text) {
        if (c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\r' || c == '\n') {
            continue;
        }
        if (c == '\\') {
            if (error) *error = "escaped patterns are not supported";
            return std::nullopt;
        }
        compact.push_back(c);
    }

    if (compact.empty()) {
        if (error) *error = "empty pattern";
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    if (compact.find('?') == std::string::npos && compact.size() <= 2) {
        compact.insert(0, 2 - compact.size(), '0');
    }

    if ((compact.size() % 2) != 0) {
        if (error) *error = "pattern must contain an even number of nibbles";
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    pattern.reserve(compact.size() / 2);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < compact.size(); i += 2) {
        const char high = compact[i];
        const char low = compact[i + 1];

        PatternByte byte{};
        if (high == '?') {
            byte.mask &= 0x0F;
        } else {
            const int value = HexValue(high);
            if (value < 0) {
                if (error) *error = str::Format("invalid hex character '%c'", high);
                return std::nullopt;
            }
            byte.value |= static_cast<uint8_t>(value << 4);
            byte.mask |= 0xF0;
        }

        if (low == '?') {
            byte.mask &= 0xF0;
        } else {
            const int value = HexValue(low);
            if (value < 0) {
                if (error) *error = str::Format("invalid hex character '%c'", low);
                return std::nullopt;
            }
            byte.value |= static_cast<uint8_t>(value);
            byte.mask |= 0x0F;
        }

        pattern.push_back(byte);
    }

    return pattern;
}

Result Search(const Request& request) {
    Result result;

    if (request.pattern.empty()) {
        result.error = "empty pattern";
        return result;
    }
    if (!mem::IsCanonical(request.start) || !mem::IsCanonical(request.end - 1) ||
        request.end <= request.start) {
        result.error = "invalid scan range";
        return result;
    }

    const size_t patternSize = request.pattern.size();
    size_t anchor = patternSize;
    uint8_t anchorMask = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < patternSize; ++i) {
        if (request.pattern[i].mask == 0xFF) {
            anchor = i;
            anchorMask = 0xFF;
            break;
        }
        if (anchor == patternSize && request.pattern[i].mask != 0) {
            anchor = i;
            anchorMask = request.pattern[i].mask;
        }
    }
    if (anchor == patternSize) {
        result.error = "pattern has no fixed bytes";
        return result;
    }

    constexpr size_t kChunk = 1024 * 1024;
    uintptr_t cursor = request.start;
    const uintptr_t end = request.end;

    while (cursor < end) {
        if (result.bytesScanned >= request.maxBytes) {
            result.limitHit = true;
            result.truncated = true;
            break;
        }

        MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mbi{};
        if (VirtualQuery(reinterpret_cast<LPCVOID>(cursor), &mbi, sizeof(mbi)) == 0) {
            break;
        }

        const uintptr_t regionBase = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(mbi.BaseAddress);
        const uintptr_t regionEnd = regionBase + mbi.RegionSize;
        if (regionEnd <= cursor) {
            cursor += 0x1000;
            continue;
        }

        const bool usable = mbi.State == MEM_COMMIT && ReadableProtection(mbi.Protect) &&
                            (!request.executableOnly || IsExecutableProtection(mbi.Protect)) &&
                            (!request.writableOnly || IsWritableProtection(mbi.Protect));
        if (!usable) {
            cursor = std::min(regionEnd, end);
            continue;
        }

        const uintptr_t scanEnd = std::min(regionEnd, end);
        while (cursor < scanEnd) {
            const size_t regionRemaining = static_cast<size_t>(scanEnd - cursor);
            const size_t readSize = std::min(kChunk + patternSize - 1, regionRemaining);
            if (readSize < patternSize) {
                cursor = scanEnd;
                break;
            }

            std::vector<uint8_t> buffer(readSize);
            if (!mem::Read(cursor, buffer.data(), readSize)) {
                cursor += std::min<size_t>(readSize, 0x1000);
                continue;
            }

            if (readSize < patternSize) {
                cursor += readSize;
                break;
            }

            const size_t maxStart = readSize - patternSize;
            const size_t startCount = maxStart + 1;
            size_t pos = 0;

            while (pos < startCount) {
                const uint8_t* base = buffer.data() + pos;
                const size_t candidates = startCount - pos;
                size_t hit = std::string::npos;

                if (anchorMask == 0xFF) {
                    const void* found = memchr(base + anchor, request.pattern[anchor].value,
                                               candidates);
                    if (!found) {
                        break;
                    }
                    hit = static_cast<size_t>(static_cast<const uint8_t*>(found) - base);
                } else {
                    for (size_t i = anchor; i < anchor + candidates; ++i) {
                        if ((base[i] & anchorMask) == request.pattern[anchor].value) {
                            hit = i;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (hit == std::string::npos) {
                        break;
                    }
                }

                if (hit < anchor) {
                    pos += 1;
                    continue;
                }

                const size_t startIndex = hit - anchor;
                if (startIndex >= candidates) {
                    break;
                }

                bool match = true;
                for (size_t i = 0; i < patternSize; ++i) {
                    if ((base[startIndex + i] & request.pattern[i].mask) !=
                        (request.pattern[i].value & request.pattern[i].mask)) {
                        match = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }

                if (match) {
                    const uintptr_t address = cursor + pos + startIndex;
                    if (request.alignment <= 1 || (address % request.alignment) == 0) {
                        if (result.matches.size() >= request.maxResults) {
                            result.truncated = true;
                            result.limitHit = true;
                            return result;
                        }
                        result.matches.push_back(address);
                    }
                }

                pos += startIndex + 1;
            }

            result.bytesScanned += readSize;
            cursor += readSize - (patternSize - 1);
        }
    }

    return result;
}

}
```

```h
namespace fmcp::scan {

    uint8_t value = 0;
    uint8_t mask = 0;

    uintptr_t start = 0;
    uintptr_t end = 0;
    std::vector<PatternByte> pattern;
    size_t alignment = 1;
    size_t maxResults = 64;
    uint64_t maxBytes = 512ull * 1024 * 1024;
    bool executableOnly = false;
    bool writableOnly = false;
};

    std::vector<uintptr_t> matches;
    uint64_t bytesScanned = 0;
    bool truncated = false;
    bool limitHit = false;
    std::string error;
```

`src/core/strings.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "core/strings.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdarg>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

namespace fmcp::str {

std::string VFormat(const char* fmt, va_list args) {
    va_list copy;
    va_copy(copy, args);
    int needed = std::vsnprintf(nullptr, 0, fmt, copy);
    va_end(copy);

    if (needed <= 0) {
        return {};
    }

    std::string out(static_cast<size_t>(needed), '\0');
    std::vsnprintf(out.data(), out.size() + 1, fmt, args);
    return out;
}

std::string Format(const char* fmt, ...) {
    va_list args;
    va_start(args, fmt);
    std::string out = VFormat(fmt, args);
    va_end(args);
    return out;
}

std::string ToLower(std::string_view value) {
    std::string out;
    out.reserve(value.size());
    for (char c : value) {
        out.push_back(static_cast<char>(c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z' ? c + 32 : c));
    }
    return out;
}

bool IEquals(std::string_view a, std::string_view b) {
    if (a.size() != b.size()) {
        return false;
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < a.size(); ++i) {
        char ca = a[i] >= 'A' && a[i] <= 'Z' ? static_cast<char>(a[i] + 32) : a[i];
        char cb = b[i] >= 'A' && b[i] <= 'Z' ? static_cast<char>(b[i] + 32) : b[i];
        if (ca != cb) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

bool IContains(std::string_view haystack, std::string_view needle) {
    if (needle.empty()) {
        return true;
    }
    if (needle.size() > haystack.size()) {
        return false;
    }
    const std::string h = ToLower(haystack);
    const std::string n = ToLower(needle);
    return h.find(n) != std::string::npos;
}

std::string Trim(std::string_view value) {
    size_t start = 0;
    while (start < value.size() && static_cast<unsigned char>(value[start]) <= ' ') {
        ++start;
    }
    size_t end = value.size();
    while (end > start && static_cast<unsigned char>(value[end - 1]) <= ' ') {
        --end;
    }
    return std::string(value.substr(start, end - start));
}

std::vector<std::string> Split(std::string_view value, char delim) {
    std::vector<std::string> out;
    size_t start = 0;
    while (start <= value.size()) {
        size_t end = value.find(delim, start);
        if (end == std::string_view::npos) {
            end = value.size();
        }
        std::string part = Trim(value.substr(start, end - start));
        if (!part.empty()) {
            out.push_back(std::move(part));
        }
        if (end == value.size()) {
            break;
        }
        start = end + 1;
    }
    return out;
}

std::string ReplaceAll(std::string value, std::string_view from, std::string_view to) {
    if (from.empty()) {
        return value;
    }
    size_t pos = 0;
    while ((pos = value.find(from, pos)) != std::string::npos) {
        value.replace(pos, from.size(), to);
        pos += to.size();
    }
    return value;
}

bool StartsWith(std::string_view value, std::string_view prefix) {
    return value.size() >= prefix.size() && value.substr(0, prefix.size()) == prefix;
}

bool EndsWith(std::string_view value, std::string_view suffix) {
    return value.size() >= suffix.size() && value.substr(value.size() - suffix.size()) == suffix;
}

std::string Hex(const void* data, size_t size, bool uppercase) {
    static constexpr char kLower[] = "0123456789abcdef";
    static constexpr char kUpper[] = "0123456789ABCDEF";
    const char* digits = uppercase ? kUpper : kLower;

    const auto* bytes = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(data);
    std::string out;
    out.resize(size * 2);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
        out[i * 2] = digits[bytes[i] >> 4];
        out[i * 2 + 1] = digits[bytes[i] & 0x0F];
    }
    return out;
}

std::optional<std::vector<uint8_t>> Unhex(std::string_view text) {
    std::vector<uint8_t> out;
    out.reserve(text.size() / 2);

    std::string trimmed = Trim(text);
    if (trimmed.size() >= 2 && trimmed[0] == '0' && (trimmed[1] == 'x' || trimmed[1] == 'X')) {
        trimmed.erase(0, 2);
    }

    int high = -1;
    for (char c : trimmed) {
        if (c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\r' || c == '\n' || c == ',' || c == '-' ||
            c == ':' || c == '_') {
            continue;
        }
        int value;
        if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') value = c - '0';
        else if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f') value = c - 'a' + 10;
        else if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F') value = c - 'A' + 10;
        else return std::nullopt;

        if (high < 0) {
            high = value;
        } else {
            out.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>((high << 4) | value));
            high = -1;
        }
    }

    if (high >= 0) {
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    return out;
}

std::optional<uint64_t> ParseUint(std::string_view text, uint64_t max) {
    const std::string trimmed = Trim(text);
    if (trimmed.empty()) {
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    size_t pos = 0;
    int base = 10;
    if (trimmed.size() > 2 && trimmed[0] == '0' && (trimmed[1] == 'x' || trimmed[1] == 'X')) {
        base = 16;
        pos = 2;
    }

    uint64_t value = 0;
    bool any = false;
    for (; pos < trimmed.size(); ++pos) {
        const char c = trimmed[pos];
        if (c == '\'' || c == '_') {
            continue;
        }
        int digit;
        if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') digit = c - '0';
        else if (base == 16 && c >= 'a' && c <= 'f') digit = c - 'a' + 10;
        else if (base == 16 && c >= 'A' && c <= 'F') digit = c - 'A' + 10;
        else return std::nullopt;

        if (value > (max - static_cast<uint64_t>(digit)) / static_cast<uint64_t>(base)) {
            return std::nullopt;
        }
        value = value * static_cast<uint64_t>(base) + static_cast<uint64_t>(digit);
        any = true;
    }

    return any ? std::optional<uint64_t>(value) : std::nullopt;
}

std::string Narrow(const std::wstring& wide) {
    if (wide.empty()) {
        return {};
    }
    int size = WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, wide.data(), static_cast<int>(wide.size()),
                                   nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr);
    if (size <= 0) {
        return {};
    }
    std::string out(static_cast<size_t>(size), '\0');
    WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, wide.data(), static_cast<int>(wide.size()),
                        out.data(), size, nullptr, nullptr);
    return out;
}

std::wstring Widen(const std::string& text) {
    if (text.empty()) {
        return {};
    }
    int size = MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, text.data(), static_cast<int>(text.size()),
                                   nullptr, 0);
    if (size <= 0) {
        size = MultiByteToWideChar(CP_ACP, 0, text.data(), static_cast<int>(text.size()),
                                   nullptr, 0);
        if (size <= 0) {
            return {};
        }
        std::wstring out(static_cast<size_t>(size), L'\0');
        MultiByteToWideChar(CP_ACP, 0, text.data(), static_cast<int>(text.size()),
                            out.data(), size);
        return out;
    }
    std::wstring out(static_cast<size_t>(size), L'\0');
    MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, text.data(), static_cast<int>(text.size()), out.data(), size);
    return out;
}

std::string Sanitize(std::string_view value, size_t maxLength) {
    std::string out;
    out.reserve(std::min(value.size(), maxLength));
    for (char c : value) {
        if (out.size() >= maxLength) {
            break;
        }
        unsigned char uc = static_cast<unsigned char>(c);
        out.push_back(uc >= 32 && uc <= 126 ? c : '_');
    }
    return out;
}

std::string Basename(std::string_view path) {
    size_t pos = path.find_last_of("\\/");
    return pos == std::string_view::npos ? std::string(path) : std::string(path.substr(pos + 1));
}

}
```

```cpp
#include "bootstrap.h"

#include <windows.h>

namespace {

DWORD WINAPI BootstrapThread(LPVOID parameter) {
    fmcp::BootstrapMain(static_cast<HMODULE>(parameter));
    return 0;
}

}

extern "C" __declspec(dllexport) uint32_t FmcpAbiVersion() {
    return 1;
}

extern "C" __declspec(dllexport) bool FmcpSelfTestMarker() {
    return true;
}

extern "C" __declspec(dllexport) unsigned long long FmcpAbiTest(
    unsigned long long a, double b, unsigned long long c, double d,
    unsigned long long e, unsigned long long f, double g) {
    return (a + c + e + f) * 1000ull + static_cast<unsigned long long>(b + d + g);
}

BOOL APIENTRY DllMain(HMODULE module, DWORD reason, LPVOID) {
    if (reason == DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH) {
        DisableThreadLibraryCalls(module);

        HANDLE thread = CreateThread(nullptr, 0, BootstrapThread, module, 0, nullptr);
        if (thread) {
            CloseHandle(thread);
        }
    }
    return TRUE;
}
```

`src/features/dll_manager.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "features/dll_manager.h"

#include "core/config.h"
#include "core/log.h"
#include "core/memory.h"
#include "core/strings.h"

#include <windows.h>

#include <filesystem>
#include <algorithm>

namespace fs = std::filesystem;

namespace fmcp::dll {

namespace {

std::mutex g_mutex;
std::unordered_map<uintptr_t, LoadedDll> g_loaded;

bool IsProtectedModule(HMODULE module) {
    const HMODULE self = GetModuleHandleW(L"FortniteMCP.dll");
    if (module == self) {
        return true;
    }
    if (module == GetModuleHandleW(nullptr)) {
        return true;
    }

    wchar_t path[MAX_PATH]{};
    if (GetModuleFileNameW(module, path, static_cast<DWORD>(std::size(path))) == 0) {
        return true;
    }

    const std::string lowered = str::ToLower(str::Narrow(path));
    for (const char* protectedName : {"\\windows\\system32\\ntdll.dll", "\\windows\\system32\\kernel32.dll",
                                      "\\windows\\system32\\kernelbase.dll", "\\windows\\system32\\user32.dll",
                                      "\\windows\\system32\\ws2_32.dll", "\\windows\\system32\\bcrypt.dll"}) {
        if (lowered.find(protectedName) != std::string::npos) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

}

bool Load(const std::string& path, const std::string& label, LoadedDll& out, std::string* error) {
    if (path.empty()) {
        if (error) *error = "path is empty";
        return false;
    }

    fs::path filePath = fs::path(path);
    if (filePath.is_relative()) {
        filePath = fs::path(Config::Get().directory) / filePath;
    }

    std::error_code ec;
    if (!fs::exists(filePath, ec) || !fs::is_regular_file(filePath, ec)) {
        if (error) *error = "DLL not found: " + filePath.string();
        return false;
    }

    const std::wstring wide = filePath.wstring();
    HMODULE module = LoadLibraryExW(wide.c_str(), nullptr, LOAD_WITH_ALTERED_SEARCH_PATH);
    if (!module) {
        if (error) *error = str::Format("LoadLibraryEx failed (error %lu)", GetLastError());
        return false;
    }

    LoadedDll info;
    info.base = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(module);
    info.path = filePath.string();
    info.timestamp = GetTickCount64();
    info.label = label;

    {
        std::lock_guard lock(g_mutex);
        g_loaded[info.base] = info;
    }

    out = info;
    FMCP_LOGI("Loaded DLL %s at %s", info.path.c_str(), mem::FormatAddress(info.base).c_str());
    return true;
}

bool Unload(const std::string& identifier, std::string* error) {
    if (identifier.empty()) {
        if (error) *error = "identifier is empty";
        return false;
    }

    HMODULE module = nullptr;
    uintptr_t base = 0;
    if (auto address = str::ParseUint(identifier)) {
        base = static_cast<uintptr_t>(*address);
        module = reinterpret_cast<HMODULE>(base);
    }

    {
        std::lock_guard lock(g_mutex);
        for (const auto& [loadedBase, info] : g_loaded) {
            if (module && loadedBase == base) {
                base = loadedBase;
                module = reinterpret_cast<HMODULE>(loadedBase);
                break;
            }
            if (!module) {
                const std::string fileName = str::Basename(info.path);
                if (str::IEquals(fileName, identifier) || str::IEquals(info.path, identifier) ||
                    str::IEquals(str::Basename(identifier), fileName)) {
                    base = loadedBase;
                    module = reinterpret_cast<HMODULE>(loadedBase);
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        if (!module || g_loaded.find(base) == g_loaded.end()) {
            if (error) *error = "DLL was not loaded through this MCP session";
            return false;
        }
    }

    if (IsProtectedModule(module)) {
        if (error) *error = "refusing to unload a protected module";
        return false;
    }

    const std::string path = g_loaded[base].path;
    if (!FreeLibrary(module)) {
        if (error) *error = str::Format("FreeLibrary failed (error %lu)", GetLastError());
        return false;
    }

    {
        std::lock_guard lock(g_mutex);
        g_loaded.erase(base);
    }
    FMCP_LOGI("Unloaded DLL %s", path.c_str());
    return true;
}

std::vector<LoadedDll> List() {
    std::lock_guard lock(g_mutex);
    std::vector<LoadedDll> out;
    out.reserve(g_loaded.size());
    for (const auto& [_, info] : g_loaded) {
        out.push_back(info);
    }
    return out;
}

void Shutdown() {
    std::lock_guard lock(g_mutex);
    g_loaded.clear();
}

}
```
