`src/mcp/http_server.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "mcp/http_server.h"

#include "core/log.h"
#include "core/strings.h"

#include <winsock2.h>
#include <ws2tcpip.h>
#include <windows.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <cstring>

namespace fmcp {

namespace {

constexpr size_t kMaxHeaderBytes = 64 * 1024;

std::string ReasonPhrase(int status) {
    switch (status) {
    case 200: return "OK";
    case 202: return "Accepted";
    case 204: return "No Content";
    case 400: return "Bad Request";
    case 401: return "Unauthorized";
    case 403: return "Forbidden";
    case 404: return "Not Found";
    case 405: return "Method Not Allowed";
    case 413: return "Payload Too Large";
    case 415: return "Unsupported Media Type";
    case 500: return "Internal Server Error";
    case 503: return "Service Unavailable";
    default: return "OK";
    }
}

bool SendAll(SOCKET socket, const char* data, size_t size) {
    size_t sent = 0;
    while (sent < size) {
        const int chunk = static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(size - sent, 1 << 20));
        const int result = send(socket, data + sent, chunk, 0);
        if (result <= 0) {
            return false;
        }
        sent += static_cast<size_t>(result);
    }
    return true;
}

void CloseSocket(uintptr_t handle) {
    if (handle == static_cast<uintptr_t>(INVALID_SOCKET)) {
        return;
    }
    SOCKET socket = static_cast<SOCKET>(handle);
    shutdown(socket, SD_BOTH);
    closesocket(socket);
}

bool ContainsToken(const std::string& value, const char* token) {
    const std::string lower = str::ToLower(value);
    return lower.find(str::ToLower(token)) != std::string::npos;
}

std::string BuildResponse(const HttpResponse& response, bool close, bool headOnly) {
    std::string out;
    out.reserve(response.body.size() + 512);
    out += "HTTP/1.1 " + std::to_string(response.status) + " " + ReasonPhrase(response.status) + "\r\n";
    out += "Server: FortniteMCP\r\n";
    out += "Content-Type: " + response.contentType + "\r\n";
    out += "Content-Length: " + std::to_string(response.body.size()) + "\r\n";
    out += std::string("Connection: ") + (close ? "close" : "keep-alive") + "\r\n";
    out += "Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *\r\n";
    out += "Access-Control-Expose-Headers: Mcp-Session-Id, MCP-Protocol-Version\r\n";
    out += "X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff\r\n";

    for (const auto& [key, value] : response.headers) {
        if (str::IEquals(key, "content-length") || str::IEquals(key, "connection") ||
            str::IEquals(key, "content-type") || str::IEquals(key, "server")) {
            continue;
        }
        out += key + ": " + value + "\r\n";
    }

    out += "\r\n";
    if (!headOnly) {
        out += response.body;
    }
    return out;
}

bool SendErrorResponse(SOCKET socket, int status, const std::string& message) {
    HttpResponse response;
    response.status = status;
    response.body = "{\"error\":\"" + message + "\"}";
    response.close = true;
    const std::string wire = BuildResponse(response, true, false);
    return SendAll(socket, wire.data(), wire.size());
}

}

HttpServer::~HttpServer() {
    Stop();
}

bool HttpServer::Start(const std::string& host, uint16_t port, HttpHandler handler,
                       size_t maxBodyBytes, int maxConnections, int idleTimeoutMs,
                       std::string* error) {
    std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
    if (running_) {
        return true;
    }
    if (!handler) {
        if (error) *error = "HTTP handler is empty";
        return false;
    }

    WSADATA wsa{};
    if (WSAStartup(MAKEWORD(2, 2), &wsa) != 0) {
        if (error) *error = "WSAStartup failed";
        return false;
    }
    wsaStarted_ = true;

    addrinfo hints{};
    hints.ai_family = AF_INET;
    hints.ai_socktype = SOCK_STREAM;
    hints.ai_protocol = IPPROTO_TCP;
    if (host.empty() || host == "localhost" || host == "127.0.0.1") {
        hints.ai_flags = AI_PASSIVE;
    }

    addrinfo* result = nullptr;
    const std::string portText = std::to_string(port);
    if (getaddrinfo(host.empty() ? nullptr : host.c_str(), portText.c_str(), &hints, &result) != 0 ||
        !result) {
        if (error) *error = str::Format("getaddrinfo failed for %s:%u", host.c_str(), port);
        WSACleanup();
        wsaStarted_ = false;
        return false;
    }

    SOCKET listenSocket = socket(result->ai_family, result->ai_socktype, result->ai_protocol);
    if (listenSocket == INVALID_SOCKET) {
        freeaddrinfo(result);
        if (error) *error = "socket creation failed";
        WSACleanup();
        wsaStarted_ = false;
        return false;
    }

    BOOL exclusive = TRUE;
    setsockopt(listenSocket, SOL_SOCKET, SO_EXCLUSIVEADDRUSE,
               reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&exclusive), sizeof(exclusive));

    if (bind(listenSocket, result->ai_addr, static_cast<int>(result->ai_addrlen)) != 0) {
        const int code = WSAGetLastError();
        closesocket(listenSocket);
        freeaddrinfo(result);
        WSACleanup();
        wsaStarted_ = false;
        if (error) *error = str::Format("bind failed on %s:%u (WSA %d)", host.c_str(), port, code);
        return false;
    }
    freeaddrinfo(result);

    if (listen(listenSocket, SOMAXCONN) != 0) {
        closesocket(listenSocket);
        WSACleanup();
        wsaStarted_ = false;
        if (error) *error = "listen failed";
        return false;
    }

    sockaddr_in bound{};
    int length = sizeof(bound);
    if (getsockname(listenSocket, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&bound), &length) == 0) {
        port_ = ntohs(bound.sin_port);
    } else {
        port_ = port;
    }

    listenSocket_ = static_cast<uintptr_t>(listenSocket);
    handler_ = std::move(handler);
    maxBodyBytes_ = maxBodyBytes;
    maxConnections_ = std::max(maxConnections, 1);
    idleTimeoutMs_ = std::max(idleTimeoutMs, 1000);
    stopping_ = false;
    running_ = true;

    try {
        acceptThread_ = std::thread(&HttpServer::AcceptLoop, this);
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        running_ = false;
        CloseSocket(listenSocket_);
        listenSocket_ = static_cast<uintptr_t>(INVALID_SOCKET);
        WSACleanup();
        wsaStarted_ = false;
        if (error) *error = str::Format("failed to start accept thread: %s", e.what());
        return false;
    }

    FMCP_LOGI("MCP HTTP server listening on %s:%u", host.c_str(), port_);
    return true;
}

void HttpServer::Stop() {
    std::vector<std::thread> connectionThreads;
    std::thread acceptThread;
    uintptr_t listenSocket = static_cast<uintptr_t>(INVALID_SOCKET);
    bool cleanupWsa = false;

    {
        std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
        if (!running_ && !wsaStarted_) {
            return;
        }
        if (stopping_) {
            return;
        }
        stopping_ = true;
        listenSocket = listenSocket_;
        listenSocket_ = static_cast<uintptr_t>(INVALID_SOCKET);

        for (uintptr_t socket : sockets_) {
            CloseSocket(socket);
        }
        sockets_.clear();

        if (acceptThread_.joinable()) {
            acceptThread = std::move(acceptThread_);
        }
        for (auto& worker : connectionWorkers_) {
            if (worker.thread.joinable()) {
                connectionThreads.push_back(std::move(worker.thread));
            }
        }
        connectionWorkers_.clear();
        cleanupWsa = wsaStarted_;
        wsaStarted_ = false;
    }

    CloseSocket(listenSocket);
    if (acceptThread.joinable()) {
        acceptThread.join();
    }
    for (auto& thread : connectionThreads) {
        if (thread.joinable()) {
            thread.join();
        }
    }

    if (cleanupWsa) {
        WSACleanup();
    }

    std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
    running_ = false;
    activeConnections_ = 0;
    handler_ = nullptr;
    afterResponse_ = nullptr;
}

void HttpServer::SetAfterResponse(AfterResponse callback) {
    std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
    afterResponse_ = std::move(callback);
}

bool HttpServer::Running() const {
    std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
    return running_;
}

uint16_t HttpServer::Port() const {
    std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
    return port_;
}

void HttpServer::AcceptLoop() {
    while (true) {
        std::vector<std::thread> finished;
        {
            std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
            if (stopping_) {
                break;
            }
            for (auto it = connectionWorkers_.begin(); it != connectionWorkers_.end();) {
                if (it->done && it->done->load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
                    if (it->thread.joinable()) {
                        finished.push_back(std::move(it->thread));
                    }
                    it = connectionWorkers_.erase(it);
                } else {
                    ++it;
                }
            }
        }
        for (auto& thread : finished) {
            if (thread.joinable()) {
                thread.join();
            }
        }

        const SOCKET client = accept(static_cast<SOCKET>(listenSocket_), nullptr, nullptr);
        if (client == INVALID_SOCKET) {
            std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
            if (stopping_) {
                break;
            }
            continue;
        }

        DWORD timeout = static_cast<DWORD>(idleTimeoutMs_);
        setsockopt(client, SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVTIMEO, reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&timeout), sizeof(timeout));
        setsockopt(client, SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDTIMEO, reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&timeout), sizeof(timeout));
        BOOL noDelay = TRUE;
        setsockopt(client, IPPROTO_TCP, TCP_NODELAY, reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&noDelay), sizeof(noDelay));

        std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
        if (stopping_) {
            CloseSocket(static_cast<uintptr_t>(client));
            break;
        }
        if (activeConnections_ >= maxConnections_) {
            SendErrorResponse(client, 503, "too many connections");
            closesocket(client);
            continue;
        }

        activeConnections_++;
        sockets_.insert(static_cast<uintptr_t>(client));
        auto done = std::make_shared<std::atomic<bool>>(false);
        try {
            ConnectionWorker worker;
            worker.thread = std::thread(&HttpServer::ConnectionLoop, this,
                                        static_cast<uintptr_t>(client), done);
            worker.done = std::move(done);
            connectionWorkers_.push_back(std::move(worker));
        } catch (...) {
            if (done) done->store(true, std::memory_order_release);
            sockets_.erase(static_cast<uintptr_t>(client));
            activeConnections_--;
            CloseSocket(static_cast<uintptr_t>(client));
        }
    }
}

void HttpServer::ConnectionLoop(uintptr_t socketHandle, std::shared_ptr<std::atomic<bool>> done) {
    struct DoneGuard {
        std::shared_ptr<std::atomic<bool>> flag;
        ~DoneGuard() {
            if (flag) flag->store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        }
    } doneGuard{std::move(done)};

    const SOCKET client = static_cast<SOCKET>(socketHandle);
    std::string buffer;
    buffer.reserve(8192);

    auto finish = [&] {
        std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
        sockets_.erase(socketHandle);
        activeConnections_--;
    };

    auto readMore = [&]() -> bool {
        char chunk[8192];
        const int received = recv(client, chunk, sizeof(chunk), 0);
        if (received <= 0) {
            return false;
        }
        buffer.append(chunk, static_cast<size_t>(received));
        return true;
    };

    auto findHeaderEnd = [&]() -> size_t {
        return buffer.find("\r\n\r\n");
    };

    auto readLine = [&](std::string& line) -> bool {
        while (true) {
            const size_t end = buffer.find("\r\n");
            if (end != std::string::npos) {
                line.assign(buffer.data(), end);
                buffer.erase(0, end + 2);
                return true;
            }
            if (buffer.size() > kMaxHeaderBytes) {
                return false;
            }
            if (!readMore()) {
                return false;
            }
        }
    };

    while (true) {
        {
            std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
            if (stopping_) {
                break;
            }
        }

        size_t headerEnd = findHeaderEnd();
        while (headerEnd == std::string::npos) {
            if (buffer.size() > kMaxHeaderBytes) {
                SendErrorResponse(client, 400, "header too large");
                finish();
                CloseSocket(socketHandle);
                return;
            }
            if (!readMore()) {
                finish();
                CloseSocket(socketHandle);
                return;
            }
            headerEnd = findHeaderEnd();
        }

        const std::string headerBlock = buffer.substr(0, headerEnd + 4);
        buffer.erase(0, headerEnd + 4);

        HttpRequest request;
        std::unordered_map<std::string, std::string> headers;
        std::string line;
        bool first = true;
        bool parseError = false;
        size_t cursor = 0;

        while (cursor < headerBlock.size()) {
            const size_t lineEnd = headerBlock.find("\r\n", cursor);
            if (lineEnd == std::string::npos) {
                break;
            }
            line.assign(headerBlock.data() + cursor, lineEnd - cursor);
            cursor = lineEnd + 2;

            if (first) {
                first = false;
                std::vector<std::string> parts = str::Split(line, ' ');
                if (parts.size() < 3) {
                    parseError = true;
                    break;
                }
                request.method = parts[0];
                request.target = parts[1];
                request.version = parts[2];
                const size_t query = request.target.find('?');
                request.path = query == std::string::npos ? request.target : request.target.substr(0, query);
                if (request.path.empty() || request.path[0] != '/') {
                    parseError = true;
                    break;
                }
                continue;
            }

            const size_t colon = line.find(':');
            if (colon == std::string::npos) {
                continue;
            }
            std::string name = str::ToLower(str::Trim(line.substr(0, colon)));
            std::string value = str::Trim(line.substr(colon + 1));
            if (name.empty()) {
                continue;
            }
            auto it = headers.find(name);
            if (it != headers.end()) {
                it->second += ", " + value;
            } else {
                headers.emplace(std::move(name), std::move(value));
            }
        }

        if (parseError) {
            SendErrorResponse(client, 400, "malformed request");
            finish();
            CloseSocket(socketHandle);
            return;
        }

        request.headers = headers;
        request.remote = RemoteAddress(socketHandle);

        if (ContainsToken(request.Header("expect"), "100-continue")) {
            static constexpr char kContinue[] = "HTTP/1.1 100 Continue\r\n\r\n";
            SendAll(client, kContinue, sizeof(kContinue) - 1);
        }

        const std::string transferEncoding = request.Header("transfer-encoding");
        const std::string contentLength = request.Header("content-length");
        bool badBody = false;

        if (ContainsToken(transferEncoding, "chunked")) {
            std::string body;
            while (true) {
                if (!readLine(line)) {
                    badBody = true;
                    break;
                }
                const size_t semicolon = line.find(';');
                const std::string sizeText = str::Trim(
                    semicolon == std::string::npos ? line : line.substr(0, semicolon));
                const auto chunkSize = str::ParseUint(sizeText, 64ull * 1024 * 1024);
                if (!chunkSize) {
                    badBody = true;
                    break;
                }
                if (*chunkSize == 0) {
                    while (true) {
                        if (!readLine(line)) {
                            badBody = true;
                            break;
                        }
                        if (line.empty()) {
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    break;
                }
                if (body.size() + *chunkSize > maxBodyBytes_) {
                    badBody = true;
                    break;
                }

                while (buffer.size() < *chunkSize + 2) {
                    if (!readMore()) {
                        badBody = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (badBody) {
                    break;
                }
                body.append(buffer.data(), static_cast<size_t>(*chunkSize));
                buffer.erase(0, static_cast<size_t>(*chunkSize) + 2);
            }
            request.body = std::move(body);
        } else if (!contentLength.empty()) {
            const auto length = str::ParseUint(contentLength, static_cast<uint64_t>(maxBodyBytes_));
            if (!length) {
                SendErrorResponse(client, 413, "body too large or invalid content-length");
                finish();
                CloseSocket(socketHandle);
                return;
            }
            while (buffer.size() < *length) {
                if (!readMore()) {
                    badBody = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!badBody) {
                request.body.assign(buffer.data(), static_cast<size_t>(*length));
                buffer.erase(0, static_cast<size_t>(*length));
            }
        }

        if (badBody) {
            SendErrorResponse(client, 400, "invalid request body");
            finish();
            CloseSocket(socketHandle);
            return;
        }

        HttpResponse response;
        try {
            HttpHandler handler;
            {
                std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
                handler = handler_;
            }
            if (handler) {
                response = handler(request);
            } else {
                response.status = 503;
                response.body = "{\"error\":\"server stopping\"}";
                response.close = true;
            }
        } catch (const std::exception& e) {
            FMCP_LOGE("HTTP handler exception: %s", e.what());
            response.status = 500;
            response.body = "{\"error\":\"internal error\"}";
            response.close = true;
        } catch (...) {
            response.status = 500;
            response.body = "{\"error\":\"internal error\"}";
            response.close = true;
        }

        bool closeConnection = response.close || ContainsToken(request.Header("connection"), "close") ||
                               (str::IEquals(request.version, "HTTP/1.0") &&
                                !ContainsToken(request.Header("connection"), "keep-alive"));

        const bool headOnly = str::IEquals(request.method, "HEAD");
        const std::string wire = BuildResponse(response, closeConnection, headOnly);
        if (!SendAll(client, wire.data(), wire.size())) {
            finish();
            CloseSocket(socketHandle);
            return;
        }

        AfterResponse after;
        {
            std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
            after = afterResponse_;
        }
        if (after && after()) {
            closeConnection = true;
        }

        {
            std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
            if (stopping_) {
                closeConnection = true;
            }
        }

        if (closeConnection) {
            break;
        }
    }

    finish();
    CloseSocket(socketHandle);
}

std::string HttpServer::RemoteAddress(uintptr_t socketHandle) const {
    sockaddr_in address{};
    int length = sizeof(address);
    if (getpeername(static_cast<SOCKET>(socketHandle), reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&address), &length) == 0) {
        char text[INET_ADDRSTRLEN]{};
        inet_ntop(AF_INET, &address.sin_addr, text, sizeof(text));
        return str::Format("%s:%u", text, ntohs(address.sin_port));
    }
    return "unknown";
}

}
```

`src/mcp/http_server.h`:

```h
#pragma once

#include <atomic>
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <vector>

namespace fmcp {

struct HttpRequest {
    std::string method;
    std::string target;
    std::string path;
    std::string version;
    std::string body;
    std::string remote;
    std::unordered_map<std::string, std::string> headers;

    [[nodiscard]] std::string Header(const std::string& name) const {
        auto it = headers.find(name);
        return it == headers.end() ? std::string{} : it->second;
    }
};

struct HttpResponse {
    int status = 200;
    std::string contentType = "application/json; charset=utf-8";
    std::string body;
    std::unordered_map<std::string, std::string> headers;
    bool close = false;
};

using HttpHandler = std::function<HttpResponse(const HttpRequest&)>;
using AfterResponse = std::function<bool()>;

class HttpServer {
public:
    HttpServer() = default;
    ~HttpServer();

    bool Start(const std::string& host, uint16_t port, HttpHandler handler, size_t maxBodyBytes,
               int maxConnections, int idleTimeoutMs, std::string* error);
    void Stop();
    void SetAfterResponse(AfterResponse callback);
    [[nodiscard]] bool Running() const;
    [[nodiscard]] uint16_t Port() const;

private:
    struct ConnectionWorker {
        std::thread thread;
        std::shared_ptr<std::atomic<bool>> done;
    };

    void AcceptLoop();
    void ConnectionLoop(uintptr_t socket, std::shared_ptr<std::atomic<bool>> done);
    std::string RemoteAddress(uintptr_t socket) const;

    std::thread acceptThread_;
    mutable std::mutex mutex_;
    std::vector<ConnectionWorker> connectionWorkers_;
    std::unordered_set<uintptr_t> sockets_;
    HttpHandler handler_;
    AfterResponse afterResponse_;
    uintptr_t listenSocket_ = static_cast<uintptr_t>(~0ull);
    uint16_t port_ = 0;
    size_t maxBodyBytes_ = 4 * 1024 * 1024;
    int maxConnections_ = 32;
    int idleTimeoutMs_ = 30000;
    bool running_ = false;
    bool stopping_ = false;
    int activeConnections_ = 0;
    bool wsaStarted_ = false;
};

}
```

`src/mcp/json_rpc.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "mcp/json_rpc.h"

#include "core/config.h"
#include "core/lifecycle.h"
#include "core/log.h"
#include "core/memory.h"
#include "core/strings.h"
#include "ue/context.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>

namespace fmcp {

namespace {

constexpr const char* kServerName = "FortniteMCP";

const char* kInstructions =
    "FortniteMCP controls the injected game process. Tools are grouped as memory_*, object/UE tools, "
    "input_*, dll tools, and shutdown. Addresses accept hex, decimal, or module+offset. "
    "UE tools require offsets in config.json or ue_configure; call status/ue_status first. "
    "ProcessEvent and call_address run on the game thread when the hook is available; otherwise "
    "they fail unless direct_fallback is enabled. Raw calls can crash the game: validate arguments "
    "and targets first. Use memory_read/memory_scan to inspect before writing. Use offline/private "
    "builds only.";

const char* ChooseProtocolVersion(const std::string& requested) {
    if (requested == "2024-11-05" || requested == "2025-03-26" || requested == "2025-06-18") {
        return requested == "2024-11-05" ? "2024-11-05"
              : requested == "2025-03-26" ? "2025-03-26" : "2025-06-18";
    }
    return "2025-06-18";
}

bool ConstantTimeEquals(const std::string& a, const std::string& b) {
    if (a.size() != b.size()) {
        return false;
    }
    unsigned char diff = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < a.size(); ++i) {
        diff |= static_cast<unsigned char>(a[i]) ^ static_cast<unsigned char>(b[i]);
    }
    return diff == 0;
}

std::string ExtractToken(const HttpRequest& request) {
    for (const char* name : {"authorization", "x-mcp-token"}) {
        std::string value = request.Header(name);
        if (value.empty()) {
            continue;
        }
        if (str::StartsWith(str::ToLower(value), "bearer ")) {
            value = str::Trim(value.substr(7));
        }
        return value;
    }
    return {};
}

}

McpServer::McpServer() {
    RegisterAllTools(tools_);
    startedAt_ = GetTickCount64();
}

bool McpServer::Authorized(const HttpRequest& request) const {
    const Config& config = Config::Get();
    if (config.server.token.empty()) {
        return true;
    }
    return ConstantTimeEquals(ExtractToken(request), config.server.token);
}

nlohmann::json McpServer::Error(const nlohmann::json& id, int code, const std::string& message) {
    nlohmann::json error = {{"jsonrpc", "2.0"},
                            {"id", id},
                            {"error", {{"code", code}, {"message", message}}}};
    return error;
}

RpcReply McpServer::Handle(const nlohmann::json& message) {
    RpcReply reply;

    if (message.is_array()) {
        if (message.empty()) {
            reply.hasResponse = true;
            reply.response = Error(nullptr, -32600, "empty batch");
            return reply;
        }
        nlohmann::json responses = nlohmann::json::array();
        for (const auto& item : message) {
            RpcReply itemReply = Handle(item);
            if (itemReply.hasResponse) {
                responses.push_back(std::move(itemReply.response));
            }
        }
        if (!responses.empty()) {
            reply.hasResponse = true;
            reply.response = std::move(responses);
        }
        return reply;
    }

    if (!message.is_object()) {
        reply.hasResponse = true;
        reply.response = Error(nullptr, -32600, "invalid request");
        return reply;
    }

    const bool hasId = message.contains("id");
    const nlohmann::json id = hasId ? message["id"] : nlohmann::json(nullptr);
    const bool isNotification = !hasId;

    if (!message.contains("method") || !message["method"].is_string()) {
        if (isNotification) {
            return reply;
        }
        reply.hasResponse = true;
        reply.response = Error(id, -32600, "missing method");
        return reply;
    }

    const std::string method = message["method"].get<std::string>();
    if (str::StartsWith(method, "notifications/")) {
        if (method == "notifications/initialized" || method == "notifications/cancelled") {
            FMCP_LOGD("MCP notification: %s", method.c_str());
        }
        return reply;
    }

    if (isNotification) {
        return reply;
    }

    const nlohmann::json params = message.contains("params") && !message["params"].is_null()
                                      ? message["params"]
                                      : nlohmann::json::object();

    const uint64_t start = GetTickCount64();
    nlohmann::json result;
    try {
        result = HandleRequest(method, params, id);
    } catch (const ToolError& e) {
        result = Error(id, -32602, e.what());
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        result = Error(id, -32603, e.what());
    } catch (...) {
        result = Error(id, -32603, "internal error");
    }

    FMCP_LOGD("MCP %s (%llu ms)", method.c_str(),
              static_cast<unsigned long long>(GetTickCount64() - start));
    reply.hasResponse = true;
    reply.response = std::move(result);
    return reply;
}

nlohmann::json McpServer::HandleRequest(const std::string& method, const nlohmann::json& params,
                                        const nlohmann::json& id) {
    if (method == "initialize") {
        const std::string requested = params.is_object() && params.contains("protocolVersion")
                                          ? params["protocolVersion"].get<std::string>()
                                          : std::string{};
        return {{"jsonrpc", "2.0"},
                {"id", id},
                {"result", {{"protocolVersion", ChooseProtocolVersion(requested)},
                            {"capabilities", {{"tools", {{"listChanged", false}}}}},
                            {"serverInfo", {{"name", kServerName}, {"version", FMCP_VERSION}}},
                            {"instructions", kInstructions}}}};
    }

    if (method == "ping") {
        return {{"jsonrpc", "2.0"}, {"id", id}, {"result", nlohmann::json::object()}};
    }

    if (method == "tools/list") {
        return {{"jsonrpc", "2.0"}, {"id", id}, {"result", {{"tools", tools_.List()}}}};
    }

    if (method == "tools/call") {
        if (!params.is_object() || !params.contains("name") || !params["name"].is_string()) {
            throw ToolError("tools/call requires a tool name");
        }
        const std::string name = params["name"].get<std::string>();
        if (!tools_.Find(name)) {
            throw ToolError("unknown tool: " + name);
        }
        const nlohmann::json arguments = params.contains("arguments") ? params["arguments"]
                                                                     : nlohmann::json::object();

        std::lock_guard lock(callMutex_);
        return {{"jsonrpc", "2.0"}, {"id", id}, {"result", tools_.Call(name, arguments)}};
    }

    if (method == "resources/list") {
        return {{"jsonrpc", "2.0"}, {"id", id}, {"result", {{"resources", nlohmann::json::array()}}}};
    }

    if (method == "resources/templates/list") {
        return {{"jsonrpc", "2.0"}, {"id", id},
                {"result", {{"resourceTemplates", nlohmann::json::array()}}}};
    }

    if (method == "prompts/list") {
        return {{"jsonrpc", "2.0"}, {"id", id}, {"result", {{"prompts", nlohmann::json::array()}}}};
    }

    if (method == "logging/setLevel") {
        return {{"jsonrpc", "2.0"}, {"id", id}, {"result", nlohmann::json::object()}};
    }

    return Error(id, -32601, "method not found: " + method);
}

HttpResponse McpServer::HandleHttp(const HttpRequest& request) {
    HttpResponse response;

    if (str::IEquals(request.method, "OPTIONS")) {
        response.status = 204;
        response.headers["Access-Control-Allow-Methods"] = "GET, POST, OPTIONS";
        response.headers["Access-Control-Allow-Headers"] =
            "Authorization, Content-Type, Accept, Mcp-Session-Id, MCP-Protocol-Version, X-MCP-Token";
        response.headers["Access-Control-Max-Age"] = "600";
        return response;
    }

    if (request.path == "/health" || request.path == "/") {
        if (!str::IEquals(request.method, "GET") && !str::IEquals(request.method, "HEAD")) {
            response.status = 405;
            response.headers["Allow"] = "GET, HEAD, OPTIONS";
            response.body = "{\"error\":\"method not allowed\"}";
            return response;
        }

        std::lock_guard lock(callMutex_);
        auto& ctx = ue::UeContext::Get();
        const ue::ResolveReport& report = ctx.Report();
        nlohmann::json health = {
            {"ok", true},
            {"name", kServerName},
            {"version", FMCP_VERSION},
            {"pid", GetCurrentProcessId()},
            {"uptime_ms", GetTickCount64() - startedAt_},
            {"ue_resolved", report.resolved},
            {"names", report.names},
            {"game_thread", report.game_thread},
            {"token_required", !Config::Get().server.token.empty()}};
        response.body = health.dump();
        return response;
    }

    if (request.path != "/mcp") {
        response.status = 404;
        response.body = "{\"error\":\"not found\"}";
        return response;
    }

    if (!str::IEquals(request.method, "POST")) {
        response.status = 405;
        response.headers["Allow"] = "POST, OPTIONS";
        response.body = "{\"error\":\"MCP requires POST\"}";
        return response;
    }

    if (!Authorized(request)) {
        response.status = 401;
        response.headers["WWW-Authenticate"] = "Bearer";
        response.body = "{\"error\":\"unauthorized\"}";
        return response;
    }

    nlohmann::json message;
    try {
        message = nlohmann::json::parse(request.body, nullptr, true, true);
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        response.status = 400;
        nlohmann::json error = {{"jsonrpc", "2.0"},
                                {"id", nullptr},
                                {"error", {{"code", -32700}, {"message", std::string("parse error: ") + e.what()}}}};
        response.body = error.dump();
        return response;
    }

    if (lifecycle::Pending()) {
        FMCP_LOGW("MCP request accepted while shutdown is pending");
    }

    const RpcReply reply = Handle(message);
    if (!reply.hasResponse) {
        response.status = 202;
        response.body.clear();
        response.contentType = "application/json; charset=utf-8";
        return response;
    }

    response.status = 200;
    response.body = reply.response.dump(-1, ' ', false, nlohmann::json::error_handler_t::replace);
    return response;
}

}
```

`src/mcp/tools.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "mcp/tools.h"

#include "core/base64.h"
#include "core/config.h"
#include "core/log.h"
#include "core/memory.h"
#include "core/modules.h"
#include "core/strings.h"
#include "ue/context.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>

namespace fmcp {

void RegisterMemoryTools(ToolRegistry& registry);
void RegisterSystemTools(ToolRegistry& registry);
void RegisterUeTools(ToolRegistry& registry);
void RegisterInputTools(ToolRegistry& registry);

void ToolRegistry::Add(Tool tool) {
    if (tool.name.empty() || !tool.handler) {
        return;
    }
    for (const auto& existing : tools_) {
        if (existing.name == tool.name) {
            return;
        }
    }
    tools_.push_back(std::move(tool));
}

const Tool* ToolRegistry::Find(const std::string& name) const {
    for (const auto& tool : tools_) {
        if (tool.name == name) {
            return &tool;
        }
    }
    return nullptr;
}

nlohmann::json ToolRegistry::List() const {
    nlohmann::json tools = nlohmann::json::array();
    for (const auto& tool : tools_) {
        tools.push_back({{"name", tool.name}, {"description", tool.description},
                         {"inputSchema", tool.schema}});
    }
    return tools;
}

nlohmann::json ToolRegistry::Call(const std::string& name, const nlohmann::json& arguments) {
    const Tool* tool = Find(name);
    if (!tool) {
        throw ToolError("unknown tool: " + name);
    }
    if (!arguments.is_object() && !arguments.is_null()) {
        throw ToolError("tool arguments must be an object");
    }

    const nlohmann::json args = arguments.is_null() ? nlohmann::json::object() : arguments;
    const uint64_t start = GetTickCount64();

    try {
        nlohmann::json result = tool->handler(args);
        if (result.is_null()) {
            result = nlohmann::json::object();
        }
        FMCP_LOGD("tool %s ok (%llu ms)", name.c_str(),
                  static_cast<unsigned long long>(GetTickCount64() - start));
        return {{"content", nlohmann::json::array({{{"type", "text"}, {"text", JsonDump(result)}}})},
                {"isError", false}};
    } catch (const ToolError& e) {
        FMCP_LOGW("tool %s failed: %s", name.c_str(), e.what());
        return {{"content", nlohmann::json::array({{{"type", "text"}, {"text", e.what()}}})},
                {"isError", true}};
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        FMCP_LOGE("tool %s exception: %s", name.c_str(), e.what());
        return {{"content", nlohmann::json::array({{{"type", "text"}, {"text", e.what()}}})},
                {"isError", true}};
    } catch (...) {
        FMCP_LOGE("tool %s exception: unknown", name.c_str());
        return {{"content", nlohmann::json::array({{{"type", "text"}, {"text", "unknown exception"}}})},
                {"isError", true}};
    }
}

void RegisterAllTools(ToolRegistry& registry) {
    RegisterSystemTools(registry);
    RegisterMemoryTools(registry);
    RegisterUeTools(registry);
    RegisterInputTools(registry);
}

uintptr_t AddressFromJson(const nlohmann::json& value, std::string* error) {
    if (value.is_number_unsigned()) {
        return static_cast<uintptr_t>(value.get<uint64_t>());
    }
    if (value.is_number_integer()) {
        const int64_t signedValue = value.get<int64_t>();
        if (signedValue < 0) {
            if (error) *error = "negative address";
            return 0;
        }
        return static_cast<uintptr_t>(signedValue);
    }
    if (value.is_string()) {
        std::string resolveError;
        auto address = modules::Resolve(value.get<std::string>(), &resolveError);
        if (!address) {
            if (error) *error = resolveError;
            return 0;
        }
        return *address;
    }
    if (value.is_object() && value.contains("address")) {
        return AddressFromJson(value["address"], error);
    }
    if (error) *error = "address expected";
    return 0;
}

uintptr_t AddressFromObject(const nlohmann::json& args, const char* key, std::string* error) {
    if (!args.is_object() || !args.contains(key)) {
        if (error) *error = std::string("missing '") + key + "'";
        return 0;
    }
    return AddressFromJson(args[key], error);
}

std::string JsonDump(const nlohmann::json& value) {
    const std::string compact = value.dump(-1, ' ', false, nlohmann::json::error_handler_t::replace);
    if (compact.size() <= 16384) {
        return value.dump(2, ' ', false, nlohmann::json::error_handler_t::replace);
    }
    return compact;
}

void RequireConfirmation(const nlohmann::json& args) {
    if (!Config::Get().safety.require_confirm) {
        return;
    }
    if (!args.is_object() || !args.contains("confirm") || !args["confirm"].is_boolean() ||
        !args["confirm"].get<bool>()) {
        throw ToolError("confirmation required: pass \"confirm\": true");
    }
}

std::vector<uint8_t> DataFromJson(const nlohmann::json& args) {
    if (args.contains("bytes_hex")) {
        auto data = str::Unhex(args["bytes_hex"].get<std::string>());
        if (!data) throw ToolError("invalid bytes_hex");
        return *data;
    }
    if (args.contains("data_base64")) {
        auto data = b64::Decode(args["data_base64"].get<std::string>());
        if (!data) throw ToolError("invalid data_base64");
        return *data;
    }
    if (args.contains("bytes")) {
        if (args["bytes"].is_array()) {
            std::vector<uint8_t> data;
            data.reserve(args["bytes"].size());
            for (const auto& item : args["bytes"]) {
                if (!item.is_number_unsigned() || item.get<uint32_t>() > 0xFF) {
                    throw ToolError("bytes array must contain 0..255");
                }
                data.push_back(static_cast<uint8_t>(item.get<uint32_t>()));
            }
            return data;
        }
        if (args["bytes"].is_string()) {
            auto data = str::Unhex(args["bytes"].get<std::string>());
            if (!data) throw ToolError("invalid bytes");
            return *data;
        }
    }
    throw ToolError("provide bytes_hex, data_base64, or bytes");
}

nlohmann::json ObjectSummary(uintptr_t object) {
    auto& ctx = ue::UeContext::Get();
    nlohmann::json result;
    result["address"] = mem::FormatAddress(object);
    if (!ctx.IsValidObject(object)) {
        result["valid"] = false;
        return result;
    }
    const ue::ObjectInfo info = ctx.DescribeObject(object);
    result["valid"] = true;
    result["name"] = info.name;
    result["class"] = info.class_name;
    result["class_address"] = mem::FormatAddress(info.class_address);
    result["outer"] = mem::FormatAddress(info.outer);
    result["path"] = info.path;
    result["flags"] = info.flags;
    return result;
}

}
```

```h
public:
    explicit ToolError(const std::string& message) : std::runtime_error(message) {}

    std::string name;
    std::string description;
    nlohmann::json schema;

    std::vector<Tool> tools_;
```

```cpp
#include "mcp/tools.h"

#include "core/strings.h"
#include "ue/input.h"

#include <algorithm>

namespace fmcp {

namespace {

nlohmann::json WindowJson(const input::WindowInfo& window) {
    return {{"handle", str::Format("0x%llX", static_cast<unsigned long long>(window.handle))},
            {"pid", window.pid},
            {"title", window.title},
            {"class", window.className},
            {"left", window.left},
            {"top", window.top},
            {"right", window.right},
            {"bottom", window.bottom},
            {"visible", window.visible},
            {"minimized", window.minimized},
            {"foreground", window.foreground}};
}

void RegisterWindow(ToolRegistry& registry) {
    registry.Add({"input_window",
                  "Describe the game window and whether it is foreground.",
                  nlohmann::json::parse(R"({"type":"object","properties":{},"additionalProperties":false})"),
                  [](const nlohmann::json&) -> nlohmann::json {
        std::string error;
        const auto window = input::GameWindow(&error);
        if (!window) throw ToolError(error);
        return nlohmann::json{{"window", WindowJson(*window)}};
    }});
}

void RegisterKey(ToolRegistry& registry) {
    registry.Add({"input_key",
                  "Send keyboard input to the game window. Keys: letters, digits, F1-F24, space, enter, "
                  "escape, tab, shift, ctrl, alt, arrows, etc. Use vk:N for raw virtual-key codes. "
                  "By default the game window must be foreground; key events are sent to whatever window "
                  "is foreground, so allow_background only uses window messages (best-effort).",
                  nlohmann::json::parse(R"({
                    "type":"object",
                    "properties":{
                      "keys":{"oneOf":[{"type":"string"},{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}}]},
                      "action":{"type":"string","enum":["press","down","up"],"default":"press"},
                      "hold_ms":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":10000,"default":40},
                      "allow_background":{"type":"boolean","default":false}
                    },
                    "required":["keys"],
                    "additionalProperties":false
                  })"),
                  [](const nlohmann::json& args) -> nlohmann::json {
        std::vector<std::string> keys;
        if (args["keys"].is_string()) {
            keys.push_back(args["keys"].get<std::string>());
        } else if (args["keys"].is_array()) {
            for (const auto& key : args["keys"]) {
                if (!key.is_string()) throw ToolError("keys must be strings");
                keys.push_back(key.get<std::string>());
            }
        }
        if (keys.empty()) throw ToolError("no keys provided");
        if (keys.size() > 32) throw ToolError("too many keys");

        const std::string action = args.value("action", "press");
        const int holdMs = std::clamp(args.value("hold_ms", 40), 1, 10000);
        const bool allowBackground = args.value("allow_background", false);

        nlohmann::json sent = nlohmann::json::array();
        for (const auto& key : keys) {
            std::string error;
            if (!input::SendKey(key, action, holdMs, allowBackground, &error)) {
                throw ToolError(key + ": " + error);
            }
            sent.push_back(key);
        }

        std::string error;
        const auto window = input::GameWindow(&error);
        nlohmann::json result = {{"sent", std::move(sent)},
                                 {"action", action},
                                 {"hold_ms", holdMs},
                                 {"background", allowBackground}};
        if (window) result["window"] = WindowJson(*window);
        return result;
    }});

    registry.Add({"input_text",
                  "Send unicode text to the focused game window. Useful for chat or debug fields. "
                  "The game window must be foreground.",
                  nlohmann::json::parse(R"({
                    "type":"object",
                    "properties":{
                      "text":{"type":"string","maxLength":1024},
                      "allow_background":{"type":"boolean","default":false}
                    },
                    "required":["text"],
                    "additionalProperties":false
                  })"),
                  [](const nlohmann::json& args) -> nlohmann::json {
        const std::string text = args["text"].get<std::string>();
        if (text.size() > 1024) throw ToolError("text is too long");
        std::string error;
        if (!input::SendText(text, args.value("allow_background", false), &error)) {
            throw ToolError(error);
        }
        return nlohmann::json{{"sent", true}, {"length", text.size()}};
    }});
}

void RegisterMouse(ToolRegistry& registry) {
    registry.Add({"input_mouse",
                  "Send mouse input to the game window. move_relative is recommended for camera rotation. "
                  "move_absolute uses normalized absolute screen coordinates (raw-input games may ignore it).",
                  nlohmann::json::parse(R"({
                    "type":"object",
                    "properties":{
                      "action":{"type":"string","enum":["move_relative","move_absolute","click","down","up","wheel"]},
                      "dx":{"type":"integer","default":0},
                      "dy":{"type":"integer","default":0},
                      "x":{"type":"integer"},
                      "y":{"type":"integer"},
                      "button":{"type":"string","enum":["left","right","middle","x1","x2"],"default":"left"},
                      "delta":{"type":"integer","default":120},
                      "allow_background":{"type":"boolean","default":false}
                    },
                    "required":["action"],
                    "additionalProperties":false
                  })"),
                  [](const nlohmann::json& args) -> nlohmann::json {
        const std::string action = args["action"].get<std::string>();
        const bool allowBackground = args.value("allow_background", false);
        std::string error;

        bool ok = false;
        if (action == "move_relative") {
            const int dx = std::clamp(args.value("dx", 0), -100000, 100000);
            const int dy = std::clamp(args.value("dy", 0), -100000, 100000);
            ok = input::MouseMoveRelative(dx, dy, allowBackground, &error);
        } else if (action == "move_absolute") {
            if (!args.contains("x") || !args.contains("y")) {
                throw ToolError("x and y are required for move_absolute");
            }
            const int x = args["x"].get<int>();
            const int y = args["y"].get<int>();
            ok = input::MouseMoveAbsolute(x, y, allowBackground, &error);
        } else if (action == "click" || action == "down" || action == "up") {
            ok = input::MouseButton(args.value("button", "left"), action, allowBackground, &error);
        } else if (action == "wheel") {
            const int delta = std::clamp(args.value("delta", 120), -1200, 1200);
            ok = input::MouseWheel(delta, allowBackground, &error);
        } else {
            throw ToolError("unknown mouse action");
        }

        if (!ok) throw ToolError(error);

        std::string windowError;
        const auto window = input::GameWindow(&windowError);
        nlohmann::json result = {{"action", action}, {"sent", true}};
        if (window) result["window"] = WindowJson(*window);
        return result;
    }});
}

}

void RegisterInputTools(ToolRegistry& registry) {
    RegisterWindow(registry);
    RegisterKey(registry);
    RegisterMouse(registry);
}

}
```

`src/mcp/tools_memory.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "mcp/tools.h"

#include "core/allocator.h"
#include "core/base64.h"
#include "core/config.h"
#include "core/log.h"
#include "core/memory.h"
#include "core/modules.h"
#include "core/patches.h"
#include "core/scanner.h"
#include "core/strings.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>

namespace fmcp {

namespace {

nlohmann::json DecodeTyped(const uint8_t* data, size_t size, const std::string& type) {
    using nlohmann::json;
    const auto check = [&](size_t bytes) { return data && size >= bytes; };

    if (type == "u8") return check(1) ? json(*reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(data)) : json("out of range");
    if (type == "i8") return check(1) ? json(*reinterpret_cast<const int8_t*>(data)) : json("out of range");
    if (type == "u16") { uint16_t v{}; if (!check(2)) return "out of range"; memcpy(&v, data, 2); return json(v); }
    if (type == "i16") { int16_t v{}; if (!check(2)) return "out of range"; memcpy(&v, data, 2); return json(v); }
    if (type == "u32") { uint32_t v{}; if (!check(4)) return "out of range"; memcpy(&v, data, 4); return json(v); }
    if (type == "i32") { int32_t v{}; if (!check(4)) return "out of range"; memcpy(&v, data, 4); return json(v); }
    if (type == "u64") { uint64_t v{}; if (!check(8)) return "out of range"; memcpy(&v, data, 8); return json(v); }
    if (type == "i64") { int64_t v{}; if (!check(8)) return "out of range"; memcpy(&v, data, 8); return json(v); }
    if (type == "f32") {
        float v = NAN;
        if (!check(4)) return "out of range";
        memcpy(&v, data, 4);
        if (!std::isfinite(v)) return json("non-finite");
        return json(v);
    }
    if (type == "f64") {
        double v = NAN;
        if (!check(8)) return "out of range";
        memcpy(&v, data, 8);
        if (!std::isfinite(v)) return json("non-finite");
        return json(v);
    }
    if (type == "bool") return check(1) ? json(*data != 0) : json("out of range");
    if (type == "ptr") {
        uintptr_t pointer = 0;
        if (!check(sizeof(pointer))) return "out of range";
        memcpy(&pointer, data, sizeof(pointer));
        return json{{"address", mem::FormatAddress(pointer)},
                    {"location", modules::NameFromAddress(pointer)}};
    }
    if (type == "cstr") {
        std::string text;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
            if (data[i] == 0) break;
            text.push_back(static_cast<char>(data[i]));
        }
        return json(text);
    }
    if (type == "wstr") {
        std::wstring text;
        for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < size; i += 2) {
            wchar_t c = 0;
            memcpy(&c, data + i, 2);
            if (!c) break;
            text.push_back(c);
        }
        return json(str::Narrow(text));
    }
    if (type == "guid") {
        if (!check(16)) return "out of range";
        const uint32_t* dwords = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(data);
        return json{{"a", dwords[0]}, {"b", dwords[1]}, {"c", dwords[2]}, {"d", dwords[3]}};
    }
    if (type == "vec2f" || type == "vec3f" || type == "vec4f") {
        const size_t count = type == "vec2f" ? 2 : (type == "vec3f" ? 3 : 4);
        if (!check(count * 4)) return "out of range";
        json array = json::array();
        for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
            float v = 0;
            memcpy(&v, data + i * 4, 4);
            array.push_back(v);
        }
        return array;
    }
    if (type == "vec2d" || type == "vec3d" || type == "vec4d") {
        const size_t count = type == "vec2d" ? 2 : (type == "vec3d" ? 3 : 4);
        if (!check(count * 8)) return "out of range";
        json array = json::array();
        for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
            double v = 0;
            memcpy(&v, data + i * 8, 8);
            array.push_back(v);
        }
        return array;
    }

    return "unknown type";
}

DWORD ProtectionFromName(const std::string& name, bool* valid) {
    *valid = true;
    const std::string lower = str::ToLower(name);
    if (lower == "rw" || lower == "readwrite") return PAGE_READWRITE;
    if (lower == "r" || lower == "read" || lower == "readonly") return PAGE_READONLY;
    if (lower == "rx" || lower == "execute_read") return PAGE_EXECUTE_READ;
    if (lower == "rwx" || lower == "execute_readwrite") return PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE;
    if (lower == "x" || lower == "execute") return PAGE_EXECUTE;
    *valid = false;
    return PAGE_READWRITE;
}

void RegisterRead(ToolRegistry& registry) {
    registry.Add({"memory_read",
                  "Read process memory. Supports hex/base64 output and optional typed decoding. "
                  "Addresses accept 0x..., decimal, or module+offset.",
                  nlohmann::json::parse(R"({
                    "type":"object",
                    "properties":{
                      "address":{"type":["string","integer"],"description":"Target address or module+offset"},
                      "size":{"type":"integer","minimum":1},
                      "format":{"type":"string","enum":["auto","hex","base64"],"default":"auto"},
                      "include_hex":{"type":"boolean","default":true},
                      "decode":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{
                        "type":{"type":"string","description":"u8,i8,u16,i16,u32,i32,u64,i64,f32,f64,bool,ptr,cstr,wstr,guid,vec2f,vec3f,vec4f,vec2d,vec3d,vec4d"},
                        "offset":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"default":0}},
                        "required":["type"]}}
                    },
                    "required":["address","size"],
                    "additionalProperties":false
                  })"),
                  [](const nlohmann::json& args) -> nlohmann::json {
        std::string error;
        const uintptr_t address = AddressFromObject(args, "address", &error);
        if (!address) throw ToolError(error);

        const uint64_t sizeValue = args["size"].get<uint64_t>();
        const auto& safety = Config::Get().safety;
        if (sizeValue == 0 || sizeValue > safety.max_read_bytes) {
            throw ToolError(str::Format("size must be 1..%zu", safety.max_read_bytes));
        }
        const size_t size = static_cast<size_t>(sizeValue);
        if (!mem::IsReadable(address, size)) {
            throw ToolError("memory range is not readable");
        }

        std::vector<uint8_t> data(size);
        if (!mem::Read(address, data.data(), size)) {
            throw ToolError("read failed");
        }

        std::string format = args.value("format", "auto");
        const bool includeHex = args.value("include_hex", true);
        if (!includeHex) {
            format = "base64";
        } else if (format == "auto") {
            format = size <= 65536 ? "hex" : "base64";
        }

        nlohmann::json result;
        result["address"] = mem::FormatAddress(address);
        result["location"] = modules::NameFromAddress(address);
        result["size"] = size;
        result["format"] = format;

        if (format == "base64") {
            result["data_base64"] = b64::Encode(data.data(), data.size());
        } else {
            if (data.size() > 262144) {
                throw ToolError("hex output is limited to 256 KiB; use format=base64 or read a smaller range");
            }
            result["hex"] = str::Hex(data.data(), data.size());
        }

        if (args.contains("decode") && args["decode"].is_array()) {
            nlohmann::json values = nlohmann::json::array();
            for (const auto& field : args["decode"]) {
                if (!field.is_object() || !field.contains("type")) continue;
                const int64_t offset = field.value("offset", 0);
                const std::string type = field["type"].get<std::string>();
                nlohmann::json entry = {{"type", type}, {"offset", offset}};
                if (offset < 0 || static_cast<uint64_t>(offset) > size) {
                    entry["error"] = "offset out of range";
                } else {
                    entry["value"] = DecodeTyped(data.data() + offset, size - static_cast<size_t>(offset), type);
                }
                values.push_back(std::move(entry));
            }
            result["values"] = std::move(values);
        }

        return result;
    }});

    registry.Add({"memory_read_safe",
                  "Non-throwing memory read. Returns ok=false with an error instead of raising a "
                  "tool error; used by diagnostics that probe unknown addresses.",
                  nlohmann::json::parse(R"({
                    "type":"object",
                    "properties":{
                      "address":{"type":["string","integer"]},
                      "size":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":65536}
                    },
                    "required":["address","size"],
                    "additionalProperties":false
                  })"),
                  [](const nlohmann::json& args) -> nlohmann::json {
        nlohmann::json result{{"ok", false}};
        std::string error;
        const uintptr_t address = AddressFromObject(args, "address", &error);
        if (!address) {
            result["error"] = error;
            return result;
        }

        const uint64_t sizeValue = args["size"].get<uint64_t>();
        if (sizeValue == 0 || sizeValue > 65536) {
            result["error"] = "size must be 1..65536";
            return result;
        }
        const size_t size = static_cast<size_t>(sizeValue);

        result["address"] = mem::FormatAddress(address);
        result["size"] = size;
        if (!mem::IsReadable(address, size)) {
            result["error"] = "memory range is not readable";
            return result;
        }

        std::vector<uint8_t> data(size);
        if (!mem::Read(address, data.data(), size)) {
            result["error"] = "read failed";
            return result;
        }

        result["ok"] = true;
        result["hex"] = str::Hex(data.data(), data.size());
        return result;
    }});
}

void RegisterWrite(ToolRegistry& registry) {
    registry.Add({"memory_write",
                  "Write process memory. Set force=true to change non-writable pages (code patches). "
                  "The original bytes are recorded for patch_undo when safety.undo_patches is enabled.",
                  nlohmann::json::parse(R"({
                    "type":"object",
                    "properties":{
                      "address":{"type":["string","integer"]},
                      "bytes_hex":{"type":"string"},
                      "data_base64":{"type":"string"},
                      "bytes":{"type":["string","array"]},
                      "force":{"type":"boolean","default":false},
                      "label":{"type":"string"}
                    },
                    "required":["address"],
                    "additionalProperties":false
                  })"),
                  [](const nlohmann::json& args) -> nlohmann::json {
        std::string error;
        const uintptr_t address = AddressFromObject(args, "address", &error);
        if (!address) throw ToolError(error);

        auto data = DataFromJson(args);
        if (data.empty()) throw ToolError("no bytes provided");
        if (data.size() > Config::Get().safety.max_transfer_bytes) {
            throw ToolError("write exceeds max_transfer_bytes");
        }

        const bool force = args.value("force", false);
        if (!mem::IsWritable(address, data.size()) && !force) {
            throw ToolError("memory is not writable; pass force=true to patch it");
        }
        if (!mem::IsCanonical(address) || data.size() > UINTPTR_MAX - address) {
            throw ToolError("invalid write range");
        }

        std::optional<uint32_t> patchId;
        if (Config::Get().safety.undo_patches) {
            patchId = patches::Record(address, data.size(), args.value("label", "memory_write"));
        }

        if (!mem::Write(address, data.data(), data.size(), force)) {
            throw ToolError("write failed");
        }

        nlohmann::json result = {{"address", mem::FormatAddress(address)},
                                 {"location", modules::NameFromAddress(address)},
                                 {"written", data.size()},
                                 {"forced", force}};
        if (patchId) result["patch_id"] = *patchId;

        std::vector<uint8_t> verify(std::min<size_t>(data.size(), 256));
        if (mem::Read(address, verify.data(), verify.size())) {
            result["readback_hex"] = str::Hex(verify.data(), verify.size());
        }

        return result;
    }});
}

void RegisterScan(ToolRegistry& registry) {
    registry.Add({"memory_scan",
                  "Scan a module or address range for an IDA-style byte pattern (e.g. \"48 8B ?? 4C\"). "
                  "Useful for locating signatures and offsets.",
                  nlohmann::json::parse(R"({
                    "type":"object",
                    "properties":{
                      "pattern":{"type":"string"},
                      "module":{"type":"string","default":"main"},
                      "start":{"type":["string","integer"]},
                      "end":{"type":["string","integer"]},
                      "max_results":{"type":"integer","default":64,"minimum":1},
                      "alignment":{"type":"integer","default":1,"minimum":1},
                      "executable_only":{"type":"boolean","default":false},
                      "writable_only":{"type":"boolean","default":false},
                      "max_bytes":{"type":"integer"}
                    },
                    "required":["pattern"],
                    "additionalProperties":false
                  })"),
                  [](const nlohmann::json& args) -> nlohmann::json {
        const auto& safety = Config::Get().safety;
        std::string error;
        auto pattern = scan::ParsePattern(args["pattern"].get<std::string>(), &error);
        if (!pattern) throw ToolError("invalid pattern: " + error);

        uintptr_t start = 0;
        uintptr_t end = 0;
        if (args.contains("start") || args.contains("end")) {
            if (!args.contains("start") || !args.contains("end")) {
                throw ToolError("start and end must be provided together");
            }
            start = AddressFromJson(args["start"], &error);
            end = AddressFromJson(args["end"], &error);
        } else {
            std::string moduleName = args.value("module", "main");
            auto module = modules::Find(moduleName);
            if (!module) throw ToolError("module not found: " + moduleName);
            start = module->base;
            end = module->base + module->size;
        }

        if (!start || end <= start) throw ToolError("invalid scan range");

        size_t maxResults = static_cast<size_t>(args.value("max_results", 64));
        maxResults = std::clamp<size_t>(maxResults, 1, std::min<size_t>(safety.max_scan_results, 4096));
        size_t alignment = static_cast<size_t>(args.value("alignment", 1));
        alignment = std::clamp<size_t>(alignment, 1, 0x10000);

        uint64_t maxBytes = safety.max_scan_bytes;
        if (args.contains("max_bytes")) {
            maxBytes = std::min<uint64_t>(args["max_bytes"].get<uint64_t>(), safety.max_scan_bytes);
        }

        scan::Request request;
        request.start = start;
        request.end = end;
        request.pattern = std::move(*pattern);
        request.maxResults = maxResults;
        request.alignment = alignment;
        request.maxBytes = maxBytes;
        request.executableOnly = args.value("executable_only", false);
        request.writableOnly = args.value("writable_only", false);

        const scan::Result result = scan::Search(request);
        if (!result.error.empty()) throw ToolError(result.error);

        nlohmann::json matches = nlohmann::json::array();
        for (uintptr_t match : result.matches) {
            matches.push_back({{"address", mem::FormatAddress(match)},
                               {"location", modules::NameFromAddress(match)}});
        }

        return nlohmann::json{{"pattern", args["pattern"]},
                              {"range", {{"start", mem::FormatAddress(start)},
                                         {"end", mem::FormatAddress(end)}}},
                              {"matches", std::move(matches)},
                              {"matches_count", result.matches.size()},
                              {"bytes_scanned", result.bytesScanned},
                              {"truncated", result.truncated},
                              {"limit_hit", result.limitHit}};
    }});
}

void RegisterAlloc(ToolRegistry& registry) {
    registry.Add({"memory_alloc",
                  "Allocate memory inside the game process. Tracked allocations can be freed with memory_free.",
                  nlohmann::json::parse(R"({
                    "type":"object",
                    "properties":{
                      "size":{"type":"integer","minimum":1},
                      "protection":{"type":"string","enum":["rw","r","rx","rwx","x"],"default":"rw"},
                      "near":{"type":["string","integer"],"description":"Preferred address / module+offset"},
                      "label":{"type":"string"}
                    },
                    "required":["size"],
                    "additionalProperties":false
                  })"),
                  [](const nlohmann::json& args) -> nlohmann::json {
        const uint64_t sizeValue = args["size"].get<uint64_t>();
        if (sizeValue == 0 || sizeValue > 256ull * 1024 * 1024) throw ToolError("invalid size");

        bool protectionValid = false;
        const DWORD protection = ProtectionFromName(args.value("protection", "rw"), &protectionValid);
        if (!protectionValid) throw ToolError("invalid protection");

        const bool executable = (protection & (PAGE_EXECUTE | PAGE_EXECUTE_READ |
                                               PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE | PAGE_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY)) != 0;
        if (executable && !Config::Get().safety.allow_exec_alloc) {
            throw ToolError("executable allocations are disabled in config");
        }

        uintptr_t nearAddress = 0;
        if (args.contains("near")) {
            nearAddress = AddressFromJson(args["near"]);
            if (!nearAddress) throw ToolError("invalid near address");
        }

        std::string error;
        const uintptr_t address = Allocator::Get().Allocate(
            static_cast<size_t>(sizeValue), protection, nearAddress,
            args.value("label", "memory_alloc"), &error);
        if (!address) throw ToolError(error);

        return nlohmann::json{{"address", mem::FormatAddress(address)},
                              {"size", sizeValue},
                              {"protection", mem::ProtectionName(protection)},
                              {"location", modules::NameFromAddress(address)}};
    }});

    registry.Add({"memory_free",
                  "Free memory allocated through memory_alloc. "
                  "Untracked frees require force_untracked=true, confirm=true, and safety.allow_any_free.",
                  nlohmann::json::parse(R"({
                    "type":"object",
                    "properties":{
                      "address":{"type":["string","integer"]},
                      "force_untracked":{"type":"boolean","default":false},
                      "confirm":{"type":"boolean","default":false}
                    },
                    "required":["address"],
                    "additionalProperties":false
                  })"),
                  [](const nlohmann::json& args) -> nlohmann::json {
        std::string error;
        const uintptr_t address = AddressFromObject(args, "address", &error);
        if (!address) throw ToolError(error);

        const bool force = args.value("force_untracked", false);
        if (force) {
            if (!Config::Get().safety.allow_any_free) {
                throw ToolError("untracked frees are disabled in config");
            }
            RequireConfirmation(args);
        }

        if (!Allocator::Get().Free(address, force, &error)) {
            throw ToolError(error);
        }
        return nlohmann::json{{"freed", mem::FormatAddress(address)}};
    }});

    registry.Add({"memory_allocations",
                  "List memory allocations tracked by this MCP session.",
                  nlohmann::json::parse(R"({"type":"object","properties":{},"additionalProperties":false})"),
                  [](const nlohmann::json&) -> nlohmann::json {
        nlohmann::json items = nlohmann::json::array();
        for (const auto& info : Allocator::Get().List()) {
            items.push_back({{"address", mem::FormatAddress(info.address)},
                             {"size", info.size},
                             {"protection", mem::ProtectionName(info.protection)},
                             {"timestamp", info.timestamp},
                             {"label", info.label}});
        }
        const size_t count = items.size();
        return nlohmann::json{{"allocations", std::move(items)}, {"count", count}};
    }});
}

void RegisterPointerChain(ToolRegistry& registry) {
    registry.Add({"memory_pointer_chain",
                  "Resolve a pointer chain: base + offset, dereference, repeat. "
                  "Each step may be a number offset or {offset, deref}.",
                  nlohmann::json::parse(R"({
                    "type":"object",
                    "properties":{
                      "base":{"type":["string","integer"]},
                      "steps":{"type":"array","items":{"type":["integer","object"]},"minItems":1,"maxItems":64},
                      "final_type":{"type":"string","description":"Optional typed read at final address"}
                    },
                    "required":["base","steps"],
                    "additionalProperties":false
                  })"),
                  [](const nlohmann::json& args) -> nlohmann::json {
        std::string error;
        uintptr_t address = AddressFromObject(args, "base", &error);
        if (!address) throw ToolError(error);
        if (!args["steps"].is_array() || args["steps"].empty()) throw ToolError("steps required");

        nlohmann::json trace = nlohmann::json::array();
        int index = 0;
        for (const auto& step : args["steps"]) {
            int64_t offset = 0;
            bool deref = true;
            if (step.is_number_integer()) {
                offset = step.get<int64_t>();
            } else if (step.is_object()) {
                if (!step.contains("offset") || !step["offset"].is_number_integer()) {
                    throw ToolError("step " + std::to_string(index) + " needs an integer offset");
                }
                offset = step["offset"].get<int64_t>();
                deref = step.value("deref", true);
            } else {
                throw ToolError("invalid step " + std::to_string(index));
            }

            address = static_cast<uintptr_t>(static_cast<int64_t>(address) + offset);
            nlohmann::json entry = {{"step", index},
                                    {"offset", offset},
                                    {"address", mem::FormatAddress(address)},
                                    {"location", modules::NameFromAddress(address)},
                                    {"deref", deref}};

            if (deref) {
                if (!mem::IsReadable(address, sizeof(uintptr_t))) {
                    entry["error"] = "unreadable";
                    trace.push_back(std::move(entry));
                    throw ToolError("chain dereference failed at step " + std::to_string(index));
                }
                const uintptr_t value = mem::ReadOr<uintptr_t>(address, 0);
                entry["value"] = mem::FormatAddress(value);
                entry["value_location"] = modules::NameFromAddress(value);
                address = value;
            }

            trace.push_back(std::move(entry));
            ++index;
        }

        nlohmann::json result = {{"final_address", mem::FormatAddress(address)},
                                 {"trace", std::move(trace)}};

        if (args.contains("final_type")) {
            const std::string type = args["final_type"].get<std::string>();
            uint8_t buffer[16]{};
            const size_t readSize = type == "u8" || type == "i8" || type == "bool" ? 1
                                  : type == "u16" || type == "i16" ? 2
                                  : type == "u32" || type == "i32" || type == "f32" ? 4
                                  : type == "guid" ? 16 : 8;
            if (mem::Read(address, buffer, readSize)) {
                result["value"] = DecodeTyped(buffer, readSize, type);
            } else {
                result["value_error"] = "unreadable";
            }
        }

        return result;
    }});
}

void RegisterPatches(ToolRegistry& registry) {
    registry.Add({"patch_list",
                  "List memory patches recorded for undo.",
                  nlohmann::json::parse(R"({"type":"object","properties":{},"additionalProperties":false})"),
                  [](const nlohmann::json&) -> nlohmann::json {
        nlohmann::json items = nlohmann::json::array();
        for (const auto& patch : patches::List()) {
            items.push_back({{"id", patch.id},
                             {"address", mem::FormatAddress(patch.address)},
                             {"location", modules::NameFromAddress(patch.address)},
                             {"size", patch.original.size()},
                             {"original_hex", str::Hex(patch.original.data(), std::min<size_t>(patch.original.size(), 256))},
                             {"truncated", patch.original.size() > 256},
                             {"note", patch.note},
                             {"timestamp", patch.timestamp}});
        }
        const size_t count = items.size();
        return nlohmann::json{{"patches", std::move(items)}, {"count", count}};
    }});

    registry.Add({"patch_undo",
                  "Restore original bytes for a recorded patch, or all patches.",
                  nlohmann::json::parse(R"({
                    "type":"object",
                    "properties":{
                      "id":{"type":"integer"},
                      "all":{"type":"boolean","default":false}
                    },
                    "additionalProperties":false
                  })"),
                  [](const nlohmann::json& args) -> nlohmann::json {
        if (args.value("all", false)) {
            const size_t restored = patches::UndoAll();
            return nlohmann::json{{"restored", restored}};
        }
        if (!args.contains("id") || !args["id"].is_number_integer()) {
            throw ToolError("provide id or all=true");
        }
        const uint32_t id = args["id"].get<uint32_t>();
        if (!patches::Undo(id)) throw ToolError("patch not found or restore failed");
        return nlohmann::json{{"restored", 1}, {"id", id}};
    }});
}

void RegisterModules(ToolRegistry& registry) {
    registry.Add({"memory_modules",
                  "List loaded modules in the game process.",
                  nlohmann::json::parse(R"({
                    "type":"object",
                    "properties":{
                      "filter":{"type":"string"},
                      "limit":{"type":"integer","default":512}
                    },
                    "additionalProperties":false
                  })"),
                  [](const nlohmann::json& args) -> nlohmann::json {
        modules::Refresh();
        const std::string filter = args.value("filter", "");
        const size_t limit = std::clamp<size_t>(args.value("limit", 512), 1, 1024);

        nlohmann::json items = nlohmann::json::array();
        for (const auto& module : modules::All()) {
            if (!filter.empty() && !str::IContains(module.name, filter) &&
                !str::IContains(module.path, filter)) {
                continue;
            }
            items.push_back({{"name", module.name},
                             {"base", mem::FormatAddress(module.base)},
                             {"size", module.size},
                             {"path", module.path}});
            if (items.size() >= limit) break;
        }
        const size_t count = items.size();
        return nlohmann::json{{"modules", std::move(items)},
                              {"count", count},
                              {"main", modules::Main() ? modules::Main()->name : std::string{}}};
    }});

    registry.Add({"memory_module_info",
                  "Return sections and metadata for a loaded module.",
                  nlohmann::json::parse(R"({
                    "type":"object",
                    "properties":{"name":{"type":"string","default":"main"}},
                    "additionalProperties":false
                  })"),
                  [](const nlohmann::json& args) -> nlohmann::json {
        modules::Refresh();
        const std::string name = args.value("name", "main");
        auto module = modules::Find(name);
        if (!module) throw ToolError("module not found: " + name);

        nlohmann::json sections = nlohmann::json::array();
        for (const auto& section : module->sections) {
            sections.push_back({{"name", section.name},
                                {"address", mem::FormatAddress(section.address)},
                                {"size", section.size},
                                {"characteristics", section.characteristics},
                                {"readable", section.readable},
                                {"writable", section.writable},
                                {"executable", section.executable}});
        }

        return nlohmann::json{{"name", module->name},
                              {"path", module->path},
                              {"base", mem::FormatAddress(module->base)},
                              {"size", module->size},
                              {"end", mem::FormatAddress(module->base + module->size)},
                              {"sections", std::move(sections)}};
    }});
}

}

void RegisterMemoryTools(ToolRegistry& registry) {
    RegisterRead(registry);
    RegisterWrite(registry);
    RegisterScan(registry);
    RegisterAlloc(registry);
    RegisterPointerChain(registry);
    RegisterPatches(registry);
    RegisterModules(registry);
}
```

```cpp
void RegisterStatus(ToolRegistry& registry) {
    registry.Add({"status",
                  "High-level server, process, config, safety, DLL, and UE status.",
                  nlohmann::json::parse(R"({"type":"object","properties":{},"additionalProperties":false})"),
                  [](const nlohmann::json&) -> nlohmann::json {
        const Config& config = Config::Get();
        modules::Refresh();

        nlohmann::json safety = {{"max_transfer_bytes", config.safety.max_transfer_bytes},
                                 {"max_read_bytes", config.safety.max_read_bytes},

                        {"uptime_ms", UptimeMs()},
                        {"endpoint", str::Format("http://%s:%u/mcp", config.server.host.c_str(), config.server.port)},
                        {"auth_required", !config.server.token.empty()},
                        {"token_file", config.server.token_file}}},
```
