`src/ue/game_thread.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "ue/game_thread.h"

#include "core/log.h"
#include "core/memory.h"
#include "core/modules.h"
#include "core/strings.h"

#include <MinHook.h>

#include <chrono>
#include <thread>

namespace fmcp::ue {

namespace {

bool g_mhInitialized = false;

uint64_t NowUs() {
    return static_cast<uint64_t>(
        std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(
            std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch())
            .count());
}

}

namespace {
GameThread* g_gameThread = nullptr;
}

GameThread& GameThread::Get() {
    if (!g_gameThread) {
        g_gameThread = new GameThread();
    }
    return *g_gameThread;
}

GameThread::~GameThread() {
    RemoveHook();
}

bool GameThread::Install(uintptr_t processEvent, int timeoutMs, int maxQueued, int jobsPerPump,
                         int pumpBudgetUs, std::string* error) {
    if (!processEvent) {
        if (error) *error = "process_event address is not resolved";
        return false;
    }
    if (!modules::IsExecutableAddress(processEvent, 1)) {
        if (error) *error = "process_event address is not executable";
        return false;
    }

    SetDirectTarget(processEvent);
    Configure(timeoutMs, maxQueued, jobsPerPump, pumpBudgetUs);

    if (hooked_.load()) {
        if (target_ == processEvent) {
            return true;
        }
        if (!RemoveHook()) {
            if (error) *error = "previous hook is still busy; cannot switch process_event target";
            return false;
        }
    }

    if (!hooked_.load() && target_ == processEvent && original_) {
        const MH_STATUS status = MH_EnableHook(reinterpret_cast<LPVOID>(processEvent));
        if (status == MH_OK) {
            hooked_ = true;
            return true;
        }
    }

    if (!g_mhInitialized) {
        const MH_STATUS status = MH_Initialize();
        if (status != MH_OK && status != MH_ERROR_ALREADY_INITIALIZED) {
            if (error) *error = str::Format("MH_Initialize failed: %d", static_cast<int>(status));
            return false;
        }
        g_mhInitialized = true;
    }

    FMCP_LOGI("Installing ProcessEvent hook at %s", mem::FormatAddress(processEvent).c_str());
    void* trampoline = nullptr;
    MH_STATUS status = MH_CreateHook(reinterpret_cast<LPVOID>(processEvent),
                                     reinterpret_cast<LPVOID>(&GameThread::HookThunk), &trampoline);
    if (status == MH_ERROR_ALREADY_CREATED) {
        MH_RemoveHook(reinterpret_cast<LPVOID>(processEvent));
        status = MH_CreateHook(reinterpret_cast<LPVOID>(processEvent),
                               reinterpret_cast<LPVOID>(&GameThread::HookThunk), &trampoline);
    }
    if (status != MH_OK) {
        if (error) *error = str::Format("MH_CreateHook failed: %d", static_cast<int>(status));
        return false;
    }

    status = MH_EnableHook(reinterpret_cast<LPVOID>(processEvent));
    if (status != MH_OK) {
        MH_RemoveHook(reinterpret_cast<LPVOID>(processEvent));
        if (error) *error = str::Format("MH_EnableHook failed: %d", static_cast<int>(status));
        return false;
    }

    {
        std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
        target_ = processEvent;
        original_ = trampoline;
        stopping_ = false;
    }

    hooked_ = true;
    FMCP_LOGI("ProcessEvent hook installed at %s", mem::FormatAddress(processEvent).c_str());
    return true;
}

bool GameThread::RemoveHook() {
    uintptr_t target = 0;
    bool wasHooked = false;
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
        wasHooked = hooked_.load();
        target = target_;
        stopping_ = true;
    }

    if (wasHooked) {
        const MH_STATUS status = MH_DisableHook(reinterpret_cast<LPVOID>(target));
        if (status != MH_OK && status != MH_ERROR_NOT_CREATED) {
            FMCP_LOGW("MH_DisableHook failed: %d", static_cast<int>(status));
        }
    }

    {
        std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
        for (auto& job : queue_) {
            job->cancelled = true;
            job->done = true;
        }
        queue_.clear();
        pending_ = 0;
        cv_.notify_all();
    }

    const bool idle = WaitIdle(2000);

    {
        std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
        hooked_ = false;
        stopping_ = false;
    }

    if (!idle) {
        FMCP_LOGW("ProcessEvent hook disabled, but game-thread calls are still active");
    }
    return idle;
}

void GameThread::Shutdown() {
    const bool idle = RemoveHook();
    if (g_mhInitialized && idle) {
        MH_Uninitialize();
        g_mhInitialized = false;
    } else if (g_mhInitialized) {
        FMCP_LOGW("Skipping MH_Uninitialize while game-thread calls are active");
    }
}

bool GameThread::Hooked() const {
    return hooked_.load();
}

uintptr_t GameThread::Target() const {
    std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
    return target_;
}

uintptr_t GameThread::DirectTarget() const {
    std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
    return target_;
}

size_t GameThread::Pending() const {
    return pending_.load();
}

uint64_t GameThread::ExecutedJobs() const {
    return executed_.load();
}

int GameThread::TimeoutMs() const {
    std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
    return timeoutMs_;
}

void GameThread::SetDirectTarget(uintptr_t target) {
    std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
    target_ = target;
}

void GameThread::Configure(int timeoutMs, int maxQueued, int jobsPerPump, int pumpBudgetUs) {
    std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
    timeoutMs_ = timeoutMs > 0 ? timeoutMs : 5000;
    maxQueued_ = maxQueued > 0 ? maxQueued : 1;
    jobsPerPump_ = jobsPerPump > 0 ? jobsPerPump : 8;
    pumpBudgetUs_ = pumpBudgetUs > 0 ? pumpBudgetUs : 1500;
}

GameThreadStatus GameThread::Run(const std::function<void()>& job, std::string* error) {
    if (!job) {
        if (error) *error = "empty job";
        return GameThreadStatus::Cancelled;
    }

    if (pumpThreadId_.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == static_cast<uint32_t>(GetCurrentThreadId())) {
        try {
            job();
        } catch (const std::exception& e) {
            if (error) *error = e.what();
            return GameThreadStatus::Cancelled;
        }
        return GameThreadStatus::Ok;
    }

    if (!hooked_.load()) {
        return GameThreadStatus::NotInstalled;
    }

    auto entry = std::make_shared<Job>();
    entry->fn = job;

    int timeout = 5000;
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
        timeout = timeoutMs_;
        if (queue_.size() >= static_cast<size_t>(maxQueued_)) {
            if (error) *error = "game-thread queue is full";
            return GameThreadStatus::QueueFull;
        }
        queue_.push_back(entry);
        pending_.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_release);
    }

    std::unique_lock lock(mutex_);
    const bool completed = cv_.wait_for(lock, std::chrono::milliseconds(timeout),
                                        [&] { return entry->done; });
    if (entry->cancelled) {
        if (error) *error = "game-thread job was cancelled";
        return GameThreadStatus::Cancelled;
    }
    if (!completed) {
        if (error) *error = "game-thread job timed out; it may still execute";
        return GameThreadStatus::Timeout;
    }
    return GameThreadStatus::Ok;
}

uint64_t GameThread::InvokeProcessEvent(uintptr_t object, uintptr_t function, void* params) {
    using PeFn = uint64_t (*)(uintptr_t, uintptr_t, void*);

    void* fn = nullptr;
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
        fn = original_ ? original_ : reinterpret_cast<void*>(target_);
    }

    if (!fn) {
        return 0;
    }
    return reinterpret_cast<PeFn>(fn)(object, function, params);
}

bool GameThread::WaitIdle(int timeoutMs) {
    const uint64_t deadline = NowUs() + static_cast<uint64_t>(timeoutMs) * 1000;
    while ((pending_.load() != 0 || activeCalls_.load() != 0) && NowUs() < deadline) {
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(1));
    }
    return pending_.load() == 0 && activeCalls_.load() == 0;
}

uint64_t GameThread::HookThunk(uintptr_t object, uintptr_t function, void* params) {
    auto& self = Get();
    const uint32_t depth = self.activeCalls_.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_acq_rel) + 1;

    using PeFn = uint64_t (*)(uintptr_t, uintptr_t, void*);
    void* original = nullptr;
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(self.mutex_);
        original = self.original_;
    }
    const uint64_t result = original
        ? reinterpret_cast<PeFn>(original)(object, function, params)
        : 0;

    if (depth == 1 && self.pumpThreadId_.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == 0 &&
        self.pending_.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != 0) {
        self.Pump();
    }
    self.activeCalls_.fetch_sub(1, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
    return result;
}

void GameThread::Pump() {
    const uint32_t currentThread = static_cast<uint32_t>(GetCurrentThreadId());
    uint32_t expected = 0;
    if (!pumpThreadId_.compare_exchange_strong(expected, currentThread,
                                               std::memory_order_acq_rel,
                                               std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        return;
    }

    struct PumpGuard {
        std::atomic<uint32_t>& id;
        ~PumpGuard() { id.store(0, std::memory_order_release); }
    } pumpGuard{pumpThreadId_};

    int jobs = 0;
    int budget = 0;
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
        jobs = jobsPerPump_;
        budget = pumpBudgetUs_;
    }

    const uint64_t start = NowUs();

    while (jobs-- > 0) {
        std::shared_ptr<Job> job;
        {
            std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
            if (queue_.empty()) {
                break;
            }
            job = queue_.front();
            queue_.pop_front();
            pending_.fetch_sub(1, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
        }

        if (job && !job->cancelled) {
            try {
                job->fn();
                executed_.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            } catch (const std::exception& e) {
                FMCP_LOGE("Game-thread job threw: %s", e.what());
            } catch (...) {
                FMCP_LOGE("Game-thread job threw an unknown exception");
            }
        }

        {
            std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
            job->done = true;
        }
        cv_.notify_all();

        if (budget > 0 && NowUs() - start >= static_cast<uint64_t>(budget)) {
            break;
        }
    }

}

}
```

`src/ue/game_thread.h`:

```h
#pragma once

#include <atomic>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdint>
#include <deque>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>

namespace fmcp::ue {

enum class GameThreadStatus {
    Ok,
    Timeout,
    NotInstalled,
    QueueFull,
    Cancelled
};

class GameThread {
public:
    static GameThread& Get();

    bool Install(uintptr_t processEvent, int timeoutMs, int maxQueued, int jobsPerPump,
                 int pumpBudgetUs, std::string* error);
    bool RemoveHook();
    void Shutdown();

    [[nodiscard]] bool Hooked() const;
    [[nodiscard]] uintptr_t Target() const;
    [[nodiscard]] uintptr_t DirectTarget() const;
    [[nodiscard]] size_t Pending() const;
    [[nodiscard]] uint64_t ExecutedJobs() const;
    [[nodiscard]] int TimeoutMs() const;

    void SetDirectTarget(uintptr_t target);
    void Configure(int timeoutMs, int maxQueued, int jobsPerPump, int pumpBudgetUs);

    GameThreadStatus Run(const std::function<void()>& job, std::string* error = nullptr);
    uint64_t InvokeProcessEvent(uintptr_t object, uintptr_t function, void* params);
    bool WaitIdle(int timeoutMs);

private:
    GameThread() = default;
    ~GameThread();

    struct Job {
        std::function<void()> fn;
        bool done = false;
        bool cancelled = false;
    };

    static uint64_t HookThunk(uintptr_t object, uintptr_t function, void* params);
    void Pump();

    mutable std::mutex mutex_;
    std::condition_variable cv_;
    std::deque<std::shared_ptr<Job>> queue_;
    std::atomic<uint32_t> pending_{0};
    std::atomic<bool> hooked_{false};
    std::atomic<bool> stopping_{false};
    std::atomic<uint64_t> executed_{0};
    std::atomic<uint32_t> activeCalls_{0};
    std::atomic<uint32_t> pumpThreadId_{0};
    uintptr_t target_ = 0;
    void* original_ = nullptr;
    int timeoutMs_ = 5000;
    int maxQueued_ = 32;
    int jobsPerPump_ = 8;
    int pumpBudgetUs_ = 1500;
};

}
```

`src/ue/globals.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "ue/context.h"

#include "core/log.h"
#include "core/memory.h"
#include "core/modules.h"
#include "core/scanner.h"
#include "core/strings.h"

#include <windows.h>

namespace fmcp::ue {

namespace {

uintptr_t ResolveGlobalSlot(uintptr_t moduleBase, size_t moduleSize, const GlobalSpec& spec,
                            const char* label, std::string* error) {
    if (spec.resolve.empty() || spec.resolve == "off" || spec.resolve == "none") {
        return 0;
    }

    if (spec.resolve == "offset" || spec.resolve == "rva") {
        if (spec.offset == 0) {
            if (error) *error = str::Format("%s offset is zero", label);
            return 0;
        }
        if (spec.offset >= moduleSize) {
            if (error) *error = str::Format("%s offset is outside the module", label);
            return 0;
        }
        return moduleBase + static_cast<uintptr_t>(spec.offset);
    }

    if (spec.resolve == "signature" || spec.resolve == "pattern") {
        std::string parseError;
        auto pattern = scan::ParsePattern(spec.signature, &parseError);
        if (!pattern) {
            if (error) *error = str::Format("%s signature parse failed: %s", label, parseError.c_str());
            return 0;
        }
        scan::Request request;
        request.start = moduleBase;
        request.end = moduleBase + moduleSize;
        request.pattern = std::move(*pattern);
        request.maxResults = 4;
        request.maxBytes = moduleSize;
        const auto result = scan::Search(request);
        if (!result.matches.empty()) {
            return result.matches.front();
        }
        if (error) *error = str::Format("%s signature did not match", label);
        return 0;
    }

    if (error) *error = str::Format("%s uses unsupported resolve mode '%s'", label, spec.resolve.c_str());
    return 0;
}

bool ApplyDecode(uintptr_t& value, const std::string& chain, std::string* error) {
    if (chain.empty() || chain == "none" || chain == "plain") {
        return true;
    }

    for (const auto& rawStep : str::Split(chain, ',')) {
        const size_t colon = rawStep.find(':');
        const std::string op = str::ToLower(str::Trim(
            colon == std::string::npos ? rawStep : rawStep.substr(0, colon)));
        const std::string arg = colon == std::string::npos ? std::string{} : str::Trim(rawStep.substr(colon + 1));

        uint64_t number = 0;
        if (!arg.empty()) {
            const auto parsed = str::ParseUint(arg);
            if (!parsed) {
                if (error) *error = "invalid decode argument: " + rawStep;
                return false;
            }
            number = *parsed;
        }

        const uint64_t v = static_cast<uint64_t>(value);
        if (op == "add") {
            value = static_cast<uintptr_t>(v + number);
        } else if (op == "sub") {
            value = static_cast<uintptr_t>(v - number);
        } else if (op == "xor") {
            value = static_cast<uintptr_t>(v ^ number);
        } else if (op == "and") {
            value = static_cast<uintptr_t>(v & number);
        } else if (op == "or") {
            value = static_cast<uintptr_t>(v | number);
        } else if (op == "not") {
            value = static_cast<uintptr_t>(~v);
        } else if (op == "rotl") {
            value = static_cast<uintptr_t>(_rotl64(v, static_cast<int>(number & 63)));
        } else if (op == "rotr") {
            value = static_cast<uintptr_t>(_rotr64(v, static_cast<int>(number & 63)));
        } else if (op == "swap32") {
            value = static_cast<uintptr_t>(_byteswap_ulong(static_cast<uint32_t>(v)));
        } else if (op == "swap64") {
            value = static_cast<uintptr_t>(_byteswap_uint64(v));
        } else {
            if (error) *error = "unknown decode operation: " + op;
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

}

uintptr_t UeContext::ReadGlobalRaw(uintptr_t slot, std::string* error) {
    if (!slot) {
        if (error) *error = "global slot is unresolved";
        return 0;
    }
    if (!mem::IsReadable(slot, sizeof(uintptr_t))) {
        if (error) *error = "global slot is not readable";
        return 0;
    }
    const uintptr_t value = mem::ReadOr<uintptr_t>(slot, 0);
    if (!value) {
        if (error) *error = "global value is null";
        return 0;
    }
    return value;
}

uintptr_t UeContext::ReadGlobalBySpec(const GlobalSpec& spec, uintptr_t slot, std::string* error) {
    uintptr_t value = ReadGlobalRaw(slot, error);
    if (!value) {
        return 0;
    }
    if (!ApplyDecode(value, spec.decode, error)) {
        return 0;
    }
    return value;
}

uintptr_t UeContext::ReadGlobalValue(const std::string& name, int depth, std::string* error) {
    if (depth > 8) {
        if (error) *error = "global chain is too deep or cyclic";
        return 0;
    }

    const Config& config = Config::Get();
    const GlobalSpec* spec = nullptr;

    if (name == "gworld" || name == "gworld_slot") {
        spec = &config.ue.gworld;
    } else if (name == "gengine" || name == "gengine_slot") {
        spec = &config.ue.gengine;
    } else {
        const auto it = config.ue.extra_globals.find(name);
        if (it == config.ue.extra_globals.end()) {
            if (error) *error = "unknown global: " + name;
            return 0;
        }
        spec = &it->second;
    }

    if (spec->resolve == "chain") {
        std::string baseName = spec->from.empty() ? "gengine" : spec->from;
        if (baseName == name) {
            if (error) *error = name + " chain refers to itself";
            return 0;
        }

        uintptr_t value = ReadGlobalValue(baseName, depth + 1, error);
        if (!value) {
            if (error && error->empty()) *error = "chain base " + baseName + " is null";
            return 0;
        }

        for (size_t i = 0; i < spec->chain.size(); ++i) {
            const uint64_t offset = spec->chain[i];
            if (offset > 0x10000000) {
                if (error) *error = str::Format("%s chain offset %zu is implausible", name.c_str(), i);
                return 0;
            }
            if (!mem::IsReadable(value + static_cast<uintptr_t>(offset), sizeof(uintptr_t))) {
                if (error) *error = str::Format("%s chain hop %zu is unreadable", name.c_str(), i);
                return 0;
            }
            const uintptr_t next = mem::ReadOr<uintptr_t>(value + static_cast<uintptr_t>(offset), 0);
            if (!next) {
                if (error) *error = str::Format("%s chain hop %zu is null", name.c_str(), i);
                return 0;
            }
            value = next;
        }

        if (!ApplyDecode(value, spec->decode, error)) {
            return 0;
        }
        return value;
    }

    uintptr_t slot = 0;
    if (name == "gworld" || name == "gworld_slot") {
        if (!gworld_slot_) {
            gworld_slot_ = ResolveGlobalSlot(module_base_, module_size_, *spec, "gworld", error);
        }
        slot = gworld_slot_;
    } else if (name == "gengine" || name == "gengine_slot") {
        if (!gengine_slot_) {
            gengine_slot_ = ResolveGlobalSlot(module_base_, module_size_, *spec, "gengine", error);
        }
        slot = gengine_slot_;
    } else {
        slot = ResolveGlobalSlot(module_base_, module_size_, *spec, name.c_str(), error);
    }

    return ReadGlobalBySpec(*spec, slot, error);
}

std::optional<uintptr_t> UeContext::ReadNamedGlobal(const std::string& name, std::string* error) {
    const uintptr_t value = ReadGlobalValue(name, 0, error);
    return value ? std::optional<uintptr_t>(value) : std::nullopt;
}

uintptr_t UeContext::GWorld(std::string* error) {
    return ReadNamedGlobal("gworld", error).value_or(0);
}

uintptr_t UeContext::GEngine(std::string* error) {
    return ReadNamedGlobal("gengine", error).value_or(0);
}

}
```

`src/ue/input.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "ue/input.h"

#include "core/log.h"
#include "core/strings.h"

#include <windows.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

namespace fmcp::input {

namespace {

uintptr_t g_window = 0;
std::string g_title;
std::string g_class;
DWORD g_pid = 0;

struct WindowSearch {
    DWORD pid = 0;
    HWND best = nullptr;
    long bestArea = 0;
    std::string bestTitle;
    std::string bestClass;
    RECT bestRect{};
};

BOOL CALLBACK EnumWindowsProc(HWND window, LPARAM param) {
    auto* search = reinterpret_cast<WindowSearch*>(param);
    DWORD pid = 0;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(window, &pid);
    if (pid != search->pid) {
        return TRUE;
    }
    if (!IsWindowVisible(window)) {
        return TRUE;
    }

    wchar_t title[512]{};
    GetWindowTextW(window, title, static_cast<int>(std::size(title)));
    wchar_t className[256]{};
    GetClassNameW(window, className, static_cast<int>(std::size(className)));

    RECT rect{};
    GetClientRect(window, &rect);
    const long area = (rect.right - rect.left) * (rect.bottom - rect.top);
    if (area < 64 * 48) {
        return TRUE;
    }

    const std::string titleText = str::Narrow(title);
    const std::string classText = str::Narrow(className);
    long score = area;
    if (str::IContains(classText, "UnrealWindow")) {
        score += 100000000;
    }
    if (str::IContains(titleText, "Fortnite")) {
        score += 50000000;
    }

    if (score > search->bestArea) {
        search->bestArea = score;
        search->best = window;
        search->bestTitle = titleText;
        search->bestClass = classText;
        search->bestRect = rect;
    }
    return TRUE;
}

bool EnsureForeground(bool allowBackground, std::string* error) {
    if (allowBackground) {
        return true;
    }
    if (IsForeground()) {
        return true;
    }
    if (ForceForeground(error) && IsForeground()) {
        return true;
    }
    if (error) {
        if (error->empty()) {
            *error = "game window is not foreground; focus it or pass allow_background=true";
        }
    }
    return false;
}

uint32_t VirtualKeyFromText(const std::string& text) {
    if (text.empty()) return 0;

    if (text.size() == 1) {
        const unsigned char c = static_cast<unsigned char>(text[0]);
        if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') return static_cast<uint32_t>(std::toupper(c));
        if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') return c;
        if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') return c;
    }

    const std::string key = str::ToLower(text);
    if (key.size() == 1) {
        return static_cast<uint32_t>(std::toupper(static_cast<unsigned char>(key[0])));
    }

    static const struct {
        const char* name;
        uint32_t vk;
    } keys[] = {
        {"backspace", VK_BACK}, {"tab", VK_TAB}, {"enter", VK_RETURN}, {"return", VK_RETURN},
        {"shift", VK_SHIFT}, {"lshift", VK_LSHIFT}, {"rshift", VK_RSHIFT},
        {"ctrl", VK_CONTROL}, {"control", VK_CONTROL}, {"lctrl", VK_LCONTROL}, {"rctrl", VK_RCONTROL},
        {"alt", VK_MENU}, {"lalt", VK_LMENU}, {"ralt", VK_RMENU}, {"win", VK_LWIN},
        {"escape", VK_ESCAPE}, {"esc", VK_ESCAPE}, {"space", VK_SPACE},
        {"capslock", VK_CAPITAL}, {"numlock", VK_NUMLOCK}, {"scrolllock", VK_SCROLL},
        {"pause", VK_PAUSE}, {"printscreen", VK_SNAPSHOT},
        {"up", VK_UP}, {"down", VK_DOWN}, {"left", VK_LEFT}, {"right", VK_RIGHT},
        {"home", VK_HOME}, {"end", VK_END}, {"pageup", VK_PRIOR}, {"pagedown", VK_NEXT},
        {"insert", VK_INSERT}, {"delete", VK_DELETE}, {"del", VK_DELETE},
        {"multiply", VK_MULTIPLY}, {"add", VK_ADD}, {"subtract", VK_SUBTRACT},
        {"divide", VK_DIVIDE}, {"decimal", VK_DECIMAL},
    };

    for (const auto& entry : keys) {
        if (key == entry.name) {
            return entry.vk;
        }
    }

    if (key.size() >= 2 && key[0] == 'f') {
        const auto number = str::ParseUint(key.substr(1));
        if (number && *number >= 1 && *number <= 24) {
            return VK_F1 + static_cast<uint32_t>(*number - 1);
        }
    }

    if (str::StartsWith(key, "vk:")) {
        const auto number = str::ParseUint(key.substr(3));
        if (number && *number <= 0xFF) {
            return static_cast<uint32_t>(*number);
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

bool IsExtendedKey(uint32_t vk, uint16_t scanCode) {
    switch (vk) {
    case VK_INSERT: case VK_DELETE: case VK_HOME: case VK_END:
    case VK_PRIOR: case VK_NEXT: case VK_LEFT: case VK_RIGHT:
    case VK_UP: case VK_DOWN: case VK_DIVIDE: case VK_RCONTROL:
    case VK_RMENU: case VK_LWIN: case VK_RWIN: case VK_APPS:
    case VK_SNAPSHOT:
        return true;
    default:
        return scanCode == 0;
    }
}

bool SendKeyInput(uint32_t vk, bool down, bool unicode, wchar_t character, bool useScanCode) {
    INPUT input{};
    input.type = INPUT_KEYBOARD;

    if (unicode) {
        input.ki.wScan = character;
        input.ki.dwFlags = KEYEVENTF_UNICODE | (down ? 0 : KEYEVENTF_KEYUP);
    } else {
        const uint16_t scan = static_cast<uint16_t>(MapVirtualKeyW(vk, MAPVK_VK_TO_VSC));
        if (useScanCode && scan != 0) {
            input.ki.wScan = scan;
            input.ki.dwFlags = KEYEVENTF_SCANCODE | (down ? 0 : KEYEVENTF_KEYUP);
            if (IsExtendedKey(vk, scan)) {
                input.ki.dwFlags |= KEYEVENTF_EXTENDEDKEY;
            }
        } else {
            input.ki.wVk = static_cast<WORD>(vk);
            input.ki.dwFlags = down ? 0 : KEYEVENTF_KEYUP;
        }
    }

    return SendInput(1, &input, sizeof(input)) == 1;
}

bool PostKeyMessage(uint32_t vk, bool down) {
    if (!g_window) {
        return false;
    }
    const uint16_t scan = static_cast<uint16_t>(MapVirtualKeyW(vk, MAPVK_VK_TO_VSC));
    const bool extended = IsExtendedKey(vk, scan);
    UINT message = down ? WM_KEYDOWN : WM_KEYUP;
    LPARAM lParam = 1 | (static_cast<LPARAM>(scan) << 16);
    if (extended) lParam |= (1ll << 24);
    if (!down) {
        lParam |= (1ll << 30) | (1ll << 31);
    }
    return PostMessageW(reinterpret_cast<HWND>(g_window), message, vk, lParam) != 0;
}

int ButtonFlag(const std::string& button, bool down) {
    const std::string lower = str::ToLower(button);
    if (lower == "left") return down ? MOUSEEVENTF_LEFTDOWN : MOUSEEVENTF_LEFTUP;
    if (lower == "right") return down ? MOUSEEVENTF_RIGHTDOWN : MOUSEEVENTF_RIGHTUP;
    if (lower == "middle") return down ? MOUSEEVENTF_MIDDLEDOWN : MOUSEEVENTF_MIDDLEUP;
    if (lower == "x1") return down ? MOUSEEVENTF_XDOWN : MOUSEEVENTF_XUP;
    if (lower == "x2") return down ? MOUSEEVENTF_XDOWN : MOUSEEVENTF_XUP;
    return 0;
}

uint32_t ButtonData(const std::string& button) {
    const std::string lower = str::ToLower(button);
    if (lower == "x1") return XBUTTON1;
    if (lower == "x2") return XBUTTON2;
    return 0;
}

bool SendMouse(const INPUT& base, DWORD flags, LONG dx, LONG dy, DWORD mouseData) {
    INPUT input = base;
    input.type = INPUT_MOUSE;
    input.mi.dx = dx;
    input.mi.dy = dy;
    input.mi.mouseData = mouseData;
    input.mi.dwFlags = flags;
    return SendInput(1, &input, sizeof(input)) == 1;
}

}

bool RefreshGameWindow() {
    WindowSearch search;
    search.pid = GetCurrentProcessId();
    EnumWindows(&EnumWindowsProc, reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(&search));
    if (!search.best) {
        return false;
    }

    g_window = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(search.best);
    g_title = std::move(search.bestTitle);
    g_class = std::move(search.bestClass);
    g_pid = search.pid;
    return true;
}

std::optional<WindowInfo> GameWindow(std::string* error) {
    if (!g_window && !RefreshGameWindow()) {
        if (error) *error = "game window was not found";
        return std::nullopt;
    }

    RECT rect{};
    GetClientRect(reinterpret_cast<HWND>(g_window), &rect);
    POINT topLeft{rect.left, rect.top};
    ClientToScreen(reinterpret_cast<HWND>(g_window), &topLeft);
    POINT bottomRight{rect.right, rect.bottom};
    ClientToScreen(reinterpret_cast<HWND>(g_window), &bottomRight);

    WindowInfo info;
    info.handle = g_window;
    info.pid = g_pid;
    info.title = g_title;
    info.className = g_class;
    info.left = topLeft.x;
    info.top = topLeft.y;
    info.right = bottomRight.x;
    info.bottom = bottomRight.y;
    info.visible = IsWindowVisible(reinterpret_cast<HWND>(g_window)) != FALSE;
    info.minimized = IsIconic(reinterpret_cast<HWND>(g_window)) != FALSE;
    info.foreground = IsForeground();
    return info;
}

bool IsForeground() {
    if (!g_window) {
        return false;
    }
    HWND foreground = GetForegroundWindow();
    if (!foreground) {
        return false;
    }
    if (reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(foreground) == g_window) {
        return true;
    }
    return GetAncestor(foreground, GA_ROOT) == reinterpret_cast<HWND>(g_window);
}

bool ForceForeground(std::string* error) {
    if (g_window && !IsWindow(reinterpret_cast<HWND>(g_window))) {
        g_window = 0;
    }
    if (!g_window) {
        if (error) *error = "game window was not found";
        return false;
    }

    HWND game = reinterpret_cast<HWND>(g_window);
    if (IsIconic(game)) {
        ShowWindow(game, SW_RESTORE);
    }

    if (IsForeground()) {
        return true;
    }

    const HWND foreground = GetForegroundWindow();
    const DWORD foregroundThread = foreground ? GetWindowThreadProcessId(foreground, nullptr) : 0;
    const DWORD gameThread = GetWindowThreadProcessId(game, nullptr);
    const DWORD currentThread = GetCurrentThreadId();

    bool attachedForeground = false;
    bool attachedGame = false;
    if (foregroundThread && foregroundThread != currentThread) {
        attachedForeground = AttachThreadInput(currentThread, foregroundThread, TRUE) != FALSE;
    }
    if (gameThread && gameThread != currentThread) {
        attachedGame = AttachThreadInput(currentThread, gameThread, TRUE) != FALSE;
    }

    BringWindowToTop(game);
    SetForegroundWindow(game);
    SetActiveWindow(game);
    SetFocus(game);

    if (attachedGame) AttachThreadInput(currentThread, gameThread, FALSE);
    if (attachedForeground) AttachThreadInput(currentThread, foregroundThread, FALSE);

    for (int i = 0; i < 20; ++i) {
        if (IsForeground()) {
            return true;
        }
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(25));
    }

    if (error) *error = "failed to bring the game window to the foreground";
    return false;
}

bool EnsureMouseFocus(bool allowBackground, std::string* error) {
    if (allowBackground && !IsForeground()) {
        if (error) *error = "mouse input requires the game window to be foreground";
        return false;
    }
    return EnsureForeground(false, error);
}

bool SendKey(const std::string& key, const std::string& action, int holdMs,
             bool allowBackground, std::string* error) {
    if (g_window && !IsWindow(reinterpret_cast<HWND>(g_window))) {
        g_window = 0;
    }
    if (!g_window && !RefreshGameWindow()) {
        if (error) *error = "game window was not found";
        return false;
    }

    uint32_t vk = 0;
    if (auto number = str::ParseUint(key)) {
        if (*number <= 0xFF) vk = static_cast<uint32_t>(*number);
    }
    if (!vk) {
        vk = VirtualKeyFromText(key);
    }
    if (!vk) {
        if (error) *error = "unknown key name: " + key;
        return false;
    }

    const std::string actionLower = str::ToLower(action);
    const bool background = allowBackground && !IsForeground();
    if (!EnsureForeground(allowBackground, error)) {
        return false;
    }

    auto sendDown = [&]() -> bool {
        return background ? PostKeyMessage(vk, true) : SendKeyInput(vk, true, false, 0, true);
    };
    auto sendUp = [&]() -> bool {
        return background ? PostKeyMessage(vk, false) : SendKeyInput(vk, false, false, 0, true);
    };

    if (actionLower == "down") {
        if (!sendDown()) {
            if (error) *error = "failed to send key down";
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    if (actionLower == "up") {
        if (!sendUp()) {
            if (error) *error = "failed to send key up";
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    if (actionLower != "press") {
        if (error) *error = "action must be press, down, or up";
        return false;
    }

    if (!sendDown()) {
        if (error) *error = "failed to send key down";
        return false;
    }

    const int delay = std::clamp(holdMs, 1, 10000);
    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(delay));
    if (!sendUp()) {
        if (error) *error = "failed to send key up (key may remain held)";
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool SendText(const std::string& text, bool allowBackground, std::string* error) {
    if (!EnsureForeground(allowBackground, error)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (allowBackground && !IsForeground()) {
        if (error) *error = "input_text requires the game window to be foreground";
        return false;
    }

    for (wchar_t c : str::Widen(text)) {
        if (c == L'\n') {
            if (!SendKeyInput(VK_RETURN, true, false, 0, true) ||
                !SendKeyInput(VK_RETURN, false, false, 0, true)) {
                if (error) *error = "failed to send enter";
                return false;
            }
            continue;
        }
        if (!SendKeyInput(0, true, true, c, false) || !SendKeyInput(0, false, true, c, false)) {
            if (error) *error = "failed to send unicode character";
            return false;
        }
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(2));
    }
    return true;
}

bool MouseMoveRelative(int dx, int dy, bool allowBackground, std::string* error) {
    if (!EnsureMouseFocus(allowBackground, error)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (!SendMouse(INPUT{}, MOUSEEVENTF_MOVE, dx, dy, 0)) {
        if (error) *error = "SendInput mouse move failed";
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool MouseMoveAbsolute(int x, int y, bool allowBackground, std::string* error) {
    if (!EnsureMouseFocus(allowBackground, error)) {
        return false;
    }

    const int left = GetSystemMetrics(SM_XVIRTUALSCREEN);
    const int top = GetSystemMetrics(SM_YVIRTUALSCREEN);
    const int width = std::max(GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXVIRTUALSCREEN), 1);
    const int height = std::max(GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYVIRTUALSCREEN), 1);

    const LONG nx = static_cast<LONG>((static_cast<int64_t>(x - left) * 65535) / std::max(width - 1, 1));
    const LONG ny = static_cast<LONG>((static_cast<int64_t>(y - top) * 65535) / std::max(height - 1, 1));

    SetCursorPos(x, y);
    if (!SendMouse(INPUT{}, MOUSEEVENTF_MOVE | MOUSEEVENTF_ABSOLUTE | MOUSEEVENTF_VIRTUALDESK,
                   nx, ny, 0)) {
        if (error) *error = "SendInput absolute mouse move failed";
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool MouseButton(const std::string& button, const std::string& action, bool allowBackground,
                 std::string* error) {
    if (!EnsureMouseFocus(allowBackground, error)) {
        return false;
    }

    const std::string actionLower = str::ToLower(action);
    const int downFlag = ButtonFlag(button, true);
    const int upFlag = ButtonFlag(button, false);
    if (!downFlag || !upFlag) {
        if (error) *error = "button must be left, right, middle, x1, or x2";
        return false;
    }

    const uint32_t data = ButtonData(button);
    auto send = [&](bool down) {
        const DWORD flags = static_cast<DWORD>(down ? downFlag : upFlag);
        return SendMouse(INPUT{}, flags, 0, 0, data);
    };

    if (actionLower == "down") {
        if (!send(true)) {
            if (error) *error = "SendInput mouse down failed";
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
    if (actionLower == "up") {
        if (!send(false)) {
            if (error) *error = "SendInput mouse up failed";
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
    if (actionLower != "click") {
        if (error) *error = "action must be click, down, or up";
        return false;
    }

    if (!send(true)) {
        if (error) *error = "SendInput mouse down failed";
        return false;
    }
    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(25));
    if (!send(false)) {
        if (error) *error = "SendInput mouse up failed";
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool MouseWheel(int delta, bool allowBackground, std::string* error) {
    if (!EnsureMouseFocus(allowBackground, error)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (!SendMouse(INPUT{}, MOUSEEVENTF_WHEEL, 0, 0, static_cast<DWORD>(delta))) {
        if (error) *error = "SendInput wheel failed";
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

}
```

```h
#pragma once

#include <cstdint>
#include <string>

namespace fmcp::ue {

struct Layout {
    int object_vtable = 0x00;
    int object_flags = 0x08;
    int object_internal_index = 0x0C;
    int object_class = 0x10;
    int object_name = 0x18;
    int object_outer = 0x20;
    int fname_size = 8;

    int ufield_next = 0x28;
    int ustruct_super = 0x30;
    int ustruct_children = 0x38;
    int ustruct_child_properties = 0x78;
    int ustruct_properties_size = 0x40;
    int ustruct_min_alignment = 0x44;
    int uclass_class_cast_flags = 0xB8;
    int uclass_class_default_object = 0x00;

    int ffield_class = 0x08;
    int ffield_owner = 0x10;
    int ffield_next = 0x18;
    int ffield_name = 0x20;
    int ffieldclass_name = 0x00;

    int fproperty_array_dim = 0x30;
    int fproperty_element_size = 0x34;
    int fproperty_flags = 0x38;
    int fproperty_offset = 0x44;

    int ufunction_flags = 0xB0;
    int ufunction_parms_size = 0xB6;
    int ufunction_return_offset = 0xB8;
    int ufunction_func = 0xC0;

    int bool_field_size = 0x70;
    int bool_byte_offset = 0x71;
    int bool_byte_mask = 0x72;
    int bool_field_mask = 0x73;

    int property_payload = 0x70;

    bool fortnite_property_decoders = false;
    bool large_world_coords = false;
    bool children_is_array = false;
    bool child_properties_is_array = false;

    [[nodiscard]] bool HasName() const { return object_name > 0 && fname_size >= 4; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool HasStructChain() const { return ustruct_super > 0 && ustruct_children > 0; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool HasPropertyChain() const { return ustruct_child_properties > 0 && ffield_next > 0 && ffield_name > 0; }
};

Layout LayoutForProfile(std::string_view profile);

}
```

`src/ue/objects.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "ue/context.h"

#include "core/log.h"
#include "core/memory.h"
#include "core/strings.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

namespace fmcp::ue {

namespace {

#if defined(_MSC_VER)
__declspec(noinline)
#endif
bool InvokeGetObjectsOfClass(uintptr_t function, uintptr_t classObject, void* out,
                             bool includeDerived, uint32_t excludeFlags) {
    __try {
        using Fn = void (*)(uintptr_t, void*, bool, uint32_t, uint32_t);
        reinterpret_cast<Fn>(function)(classObject, out, includeDerived, excludeFlags, 0);
        return true;
    } __except (EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) {
        return false;
    }
}

}

uintptr_t UeContext::StructChildProperties(uintptr_t structObject) const {
    if (!structObject || layout_.ustruct_child_properties <= 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    return mem::ReadOr<uintptr_t>(structObject + static_cast<uintptr_t>(layout_.ustruct_child_properties), 0);
}

uintptr_t UeContext::StructChildren(uintptr_t structObject) const {
    if (!structObject || layout_.ustruct_children <= 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    return mem::ReadOr<uintptr_t>(structObject + static_cast<uintptr_t>(layout_.ustruct_children), 0);
}

uintptr_t UeContext::StructSuper(uintptr_t structObject) const {
    if (!structObject || layout_.ustruct_super <= 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    return mem::ReadOr<uintptr_t>(structObject + static_cast<uintptr_t>(layout_.ustruct_super), 0);
}

uintptr_t UeContext::FieldNext(uintptr_t field) const {
    if (!field || layout_.ffield_next <= 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    return mem::ReadOr<uintptr_t>(field + static_cast<uintptr_t>(layout_.ffield_next), 0);
}

UeContext::ObjectQuery UeContext::ObjectsOfClass(uintptr_t classObject, bool includeDerived,
                                                  uint32_t excludeFlags, size_t maxResults,
                                                  std::string* error) {
    ObjectQuery result;
    if (!IsValidObject(classObject)) {
        if (error) *error = "class object is invalid";
        return result;
    }

    maxResults = std::clamp<size_t>(maxResults, 1, 200000);

    if (get_objects_of_class_) {
        struct ArrayOut {
            uintptr_t data;
            int32_t num;
            int32_t max;
        };

        constexpr int32_t kCapacity = 262144;
        std::vector<uintptr_t> storage(static_cast<size_t>(kCapacity));
        ArrayOut out{reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(storage.data()), 0, kCapacity};

        if (!InvokeGetObjectsOfClass(get_objects_of_class_, classObject, &out, includeDerived,
                                     excludeFlags)) {
            if (error) *error = "GetObjectsOfClass faulted";
            FMCP_LOGW("GetObjectsOfClass faulted");
            return result;
        }

        if (out.num < 0 || out.num > 8000000 || !out.data) {
            if (error) *error = "native GetObjectsOfClass returned an invalid array";
            return result;
        }

        const bool engineAllocated = out.data != reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(storage.data());
        if (engineAllocated) {
            FMCP_LOGW("GetObjectsOfClass reallocated beyond %d entries; engine allocation will leak",
                      kCapacity);
        }

        const int32_t count = out.num;
        if (!mem::IsReadable(out.data, static_cast<size_t>(count) * sizeof(uintptr_t))) {
            if (error) *error = "native GetObjectsOfClass array is unreadable";
            return result;
        }

        result.total = static_cast<size_t>(count);
        result.objects.reserve(std::min<size_t>(result.total, maxResults));

        for (int32_t i = 0; i < count && result.objects.size() < maxResults; ++i) {
            const uintptr_t object = mem::ReadOr<uintptr_t>(
                out.data + static_cast<uintptr_t>(i) * sizeof(uintptr_t), 0);
            if (object && IsValidObject(object)) {
                result.objects.push_back(object);
            }
        }

        result.truncated = result.total > result.objects.size();
        return result;
    }

    if (!report_.objects) {
        if (error) *error = "neither get_objects_of_class nor an object array is configured";
        return result;
    }

    const Config& config = Config::Get();
    const int chunkBits = std::clamp(config.ue.objects.chunk_bits, 8, 24);
    const size_t chunkSize = static_cast<size_t>(1) << chunkBits;
    const int itemSize = std::clamp(config.ue.objects.item_size, 8, 0x200);
    const int itemOffset = config.ue.objects.item_object_offset;
    if (itemOffset < 0 || static_cast<size_t>(itemOffset) + sizeof(uintptr_t) > static_cast<size_t>(itemSize)) {
        if (error) *error = "invalid object item layout";
        return result;
    }

    const size_t maxObjects = static_cast<size_t>(std::max(config.ue.objects.max_objects, 0));
    const size_t chunkCount = (maxObjects + chunkSize - 1) / chunkSize;
    const int emptyStop = std::max(config.ue.objects.empty_chunk_stop, 1);
    int emptyRun = 0;

    constexpr size_t kChunkBlockItems = 4096;
    std::vector<uint8_t> buffer(static_cast<size_t>(itemSize) * kChunkBlockItems);

    for (size_t chunkIndex = 0; chunkIndex < chunkCount; ++chunkIndex) {
        uintptr_t chunk = 0;
        if (!mem::Read(objects_table_ + chunkIndex * sizeof(uintptr_t), chunk) ||
            !mem::IsCanonical(chunk)) {
            if (++emptyRun >= emptyStop) {
                break;
            }
            continue;
        }
        emptyRun = 0;

        for (size_t item = 0; item < chunkSize;) {
            const size_t count = std::min(kChunkBlockItems, chunkSize - item);
            const size_t bytes = count * static_cast<size_t>(itemSize);
            if (!mem::Read(chunk + item * static_cast<size_t>(itemSize), buffer.data(), bytes)) {
                item += count;
                continue;
            }

            for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
                const auto* base = buffer.data() + i * static_cast<size_t>(itemSize);
                uintptr_t object = 0;
                memcpy(&object, base + itemOffset, sizeof(object));
                if (!object || !IsValidObject(object)) {
                    continue;
                }

                const uint32_t flags = mem::ReadOr<uint32_t>(
                    object + static_cast<uintptr_t>(layout_.object_flags), 0);
                if (excludeFlags && (flags & excludeFlags) != 0) {
                    continue;
                }

                bool match = false;
                if (includeDerived) {
                    match = IsA(object, classObject);
                } else {
                    match = ClassOf(object) == classObject;
                }
                if (!match) {
                    continue;
                }

                ++result.total;
                if (result.objects.size() < maxResults) {
                    result.objects.push_back(object);
                } else {
                    result.truncated = true;
                    return result;
                }
            }

            item += count;
        }
    }

    return result;
}

UeContext::ObjectQuery UeContext::IterateObjects(size_t maxResults, std::string* error) {
    ObjectQuery result;
    if (!report_.objects) {
        if (error) *error = "object array is not configured";
        return result;
    }

    maxResults = std::clamp<size_t>(maxResults, 1, 200000);

    const Config& config = Config::Get();
    const int chunkBits = std::clamp(config.ue.objects.chunk_bits, 8, 24);
    const size_t chunkSize = static_cast<size_t>(1) << chunkBits;
    const int itemSize = std::clamp(config.ue.objects.item_size, 8, 0x200);
    const int itemOffset = config.ue.objects.item_object_offset;
    if (itemOffset < 0 || static_cast<size_t>(itemOffset) + sizeof(uintptr_t) > static_cast<size_t>(itemSize)) {
        if (error) *error = "invalid object item layout";
        return result;
    }

    const size_t maxObjects = static_cast<size_t>(std::max(config.ue.objects.max_objects, 0));
    const size_t chunkCount = (maxObjects + chunkSize - 1) / chunkSize;
    const int emptyStop = std::max(config.ue.objects.empty_chunk_stop, 1);
    int emptyRun = 0;

    constexpr size_t kChunkBlockItems = 4096;
    std::vector<uint8_t> buffer(static_cast<size_t>(itemSize) * kChunkBlockItems);

    for (size_t chunkIndex = 0; chunkIndex < chunkCount; ++chunkIndex) {
        uintptr_t chunk = 0;
        if (!mem::Read(objects_table_ + chunkIndex * sizeof(uintptr_t), chunk) ||
            !mem::IsCanonical(chunk)) {
            if (++emptyRun >= emptyStop) break;
            continue;
        }
        emptyRun = 0;

        for (size_t item = 0; item < chunkSize;) {
            const size_t count = std::min(kChunkBlockItems, chunkSize - item);
            const size_t bytes = count * static_cast<size_t>(itemSize);
            if (!mem::Read(chunk + item * static_cast<size_t>(itemSize), buffer.data(), bytes)) {
                item += count;
                continue;
            }

            for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
                const auto* base = buffer.data() + i * static_cast<size_t>(itemSize);
                uintptr_t object = 0;
                memcpy(&object, base + itemOffset, sizeof(object));
                if (!object || !IsValidObject(object)) {
                    continue;
                }
                ++result.total;
                if (result.objects.size() < maxResults) {
                    result.objects.push_back(object);
                } else {
                    result.truncated = true;
                    return result;
                }
            }

            item += count;
        }
    }

    return result;
}

}
```
